text:
Ta'aruf-e-Quran bi-zaban-e-Rahman:

Surah Baqarah ki tafsir ke shuru mein Huroof-e-Muqatta'at ki bahas guzar chuki hai. Is kitab ya'ani Quran Sharif ki yeh aayatein bahut wazih, khuli hui aur khoob saaf hain. Mubham cheezon ki haqeeqat khol deti hain, yahan par tilk ma'ane mein hazih ke hai. Chuke Arabi zaban nihayat kamil aur maqsad ko poori tarah wazih kar dene wali aur wus'at-o-kasrat wali hai, is liye yeh pakeeza-tar kitab is behtareen zaban mein afzal-tar Rasul ﷺ, rasool ke sardar farishte ki safarat mein, tamam rooye zameen ke behtareen maqam mein, waqton mein behtareen waqt mein nazil ho kar har ek tarah ke kamal ko pahunchi taaki tum har tarah soch samajh sako aur ise jaan lo. 

Hum behtareen qissa bayan farmate hain: Sahaba ne arz kiya ke Huzoor ﷺ agar koi waqia bayan farmate? Is par yeh aayat utri. Aur riwayat mein hai ke ek zamane tak Quran-e-Karim nazil hota gaya aur Aap sahaba ke samne tilawat farmate rahe, phir unhon ne kaha, "Huzoor ﷺ koi waqia bhi bayan ho jata toh?" Is par yeh aayatein utreen. Phir kuch waqt ke baad kaha, "Kash ke aap koi baat bayan farmate." Is par yeh (اَللّٰهُ نَزَّلَ اَحْسَنَ الْحَدِيْثِ كِتٰبًا مُّتَشَابِهًا مَّثَانِيَ ڰ تَــقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُوْدُ الَّذِيْنَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ۚ ثُمَّ تَلِيْنُ جُلُوْدُهُمْ وَقُلُوْبُهُمْ اِلٰى ذِكْرِاللّٰهِ ۭ ذٰلِكَ هُدَى اللّٰهِ يَهْدِيْ بِهٖ مَنْ يَّشَاۗءُ ۭ وَمَنْ يُّضْلِلِ اللّٰهُ فَمَا لَهٗ مِنْ هَادٍ) (39. Az-Zumar: 23) utri aur baat bayan hui. 

Rawish-e-kalam ka ek hi andaz dekh kar sahaba ne kaha, "Ya Rasulallah! Baat se upar ki aur Quran se neeche ki koi cheez hoti ya'ani waqia," is par yeh aayatein utreen. Phir unhon ne hadith ki khwahish ki, is par (Aayat Allahu Nazzala Al-Hadith...) utri. Pas qisse ke irade par behtareen qissa aur baat ke irade par behtareen baat nazil hui. 

Is jagah jahan ke Quran-e-Karim ki taarif ho rahi hai, aur yeh bayan hai ke yeh Quran aur sab kitabon se be-niyaz kar dene wala hai, munasib hai ke hum Musnad Ahmad ki is hadith ko bhi bayan kar dein jis mein hai ke Hadrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ko kisi Ahl-e-Kitab se ek kitab hath lag gayi thi, use lekar Aap hazir-e-Huzoor ﷺ hue aur Aap ke samne sunane lage. Aap sakht ghazab-nak ho gaye aur farmane lage, "Ahey Khattab ke ladke! Kya tum is mein mashghool ho kar behak jana chahte ho? Uski qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, ke main is ko nihayat roshan aur wazih taur par lekar aaya hoon. Tum in Ahl-e-Kitab se koi baat na poocho, mumkin hai ke woh sahih jawab dein aur tum unhein jhutla do, aur ho sakta hai ke woh ghalat jawab dein aur tum use sacha samajh lo. Suno! Us Allah ki qasam jis ke hath mein meri jaan hai, ke agar aaj khud Hadrat Musa Alaihis Salam bhi zinda hote toh unhein bhi siwaaye meri tabadari ke koi chara na tha." 

Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Hadrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ne Aap ﷺ se kaha ke Bani Quraiza qabila ke mere ek dost ne Taurat mein se chand jami’ baatein mujhe likh di hain, toh kya main unhein Aap ko sunaon? Aap ka chehra mutagayyar ho gaya.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Sabit ne kaha ke 'Aaye Umar! Kya tum Huzoor ﷺ ke chehre ko nahi dekh rahe?' Ab Hazrat Umar ki nigaah padi toh aap kehne lage hum Allah ke Rabb hone par, Islam ke deen hone par aur Muhammad ﷺ ke Rasool ﷺ hone par dil se razaamand hain. Ab aap ke chehre se gussa door hua aur farmaya: 'Us zaat-e-paak ki qasam jis ke haath mein Muhammad ﷺ ki jaan hai ke agar tum mein khud Hazrat Musa hote phir tum mujhe chhod kar un ki ittebaah mein lag jaate toh tum sab gumrah ho jaate, ummaton mein se mera hissa tum ho aur nabiyon mein se tumhara hissa main hoon.' 

Abu Yala mein hai ke Susa ka rehne wala qabeela Abdul Qais ka ek shakhs Janab Farooq-e-Azam R.A ke paas aaya. Aap ne us se poocha ke tera naam fulaan fulaan hai? Us ne kaha haan. Poocha toh Susa mein muqeem hai? Us ne kaha haan. Toh aap ke haath mein jo khosha tha usay maara. Us ne kaha: 'Amir-ul-Mumineen! Mera kya qasoor hai?' 

Aap ne farmaya: 'Baith ja, main batata hoon.' 

Phir Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim padh kar usi soorat ki (aayatein liman al-ghaafilin) tak padhein, teen martaba un aayaton ki tilawat ki aur teen martaba usay maara. Us ne phir poocha ke: 'Amir-ul-Mumineen! Mera qasoor kya hai?' 

Aap ne farmaya: 'Tu ne Daniyal ki ek kitab likhi hai.' 

Us ne kaha: 'Phir jo aap farmaayein, main karne ko tayyar hoon.' 

Aap ne farmaya: 'Ja aur garm paani aur safed rooi se usay bilkul mita de. Khabardar aaj ke baad se usay khud padhna na kisi aur ko padhana. Ab agar main is ke khilaaf suna ke tu ne khud isay padha ya kisi ko padhaya toh aisi sakht saza karunga ke ibrat bane.' 

Phir farmaya: 'Baith ja, ek baat sunta ja. Main ne jaakar Ahl-e-Kitab ki ek kitab likhi, phir usay chamde mein liye hue Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya. Aap ne mujh se poocha: "Tere haath mein yeh kya hai?" 

Main ne kaha: "Ek kitab hai ke hum ilm mein badh jaayen." 

Is par aap is qadar naraaz hue ke gusse ki wajah se aap ke rukhsaar par surkhī namoodar ho gayi, phir munadi ki gayi ke namaz jama karne wali hai. Usi waqt Ansar ne hathiyar nikaal liye ke kisi ne Huzoor ﷺ ko naraaz kar diya hai aur Mimbar-e-Nabawi ﷺ ke charon taraf woh log hathiyar-band baith gaye. 

Ab aap ne farmaya: "Logon! Main jaami' kalimaat diya gaya hoon aur kalimaat ke khaatim diya gaya hoon aur phir mere liye bahut hi ikhtisaar kiya gaya hai, main Allah ke deen ki baatein bahut safed aur numayan laya hoon. Khabardar tum behk na jaana. Gehrai mein utarne wale kahin tumhein behka na dein." 

Yeh sun kar Hazrat Umar khade ho gaye aur kehne lage: "Main toh Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Allah ke Rabb hone par, Islam ke deen hone par, aap ke Rasool ﷺ hone par dil se raazi hoon."'

Ab jo ﷺ mimbar se utre, is ke ek raawi Abdur Rahman bin Ishaq ko muhaddiseen zaeef kehte hain, Imam Bukhari un ki hadith ko sahih nahi likhte. Main kehta hoon is ka ek shahid aur sanad Hafiz Abu Bakr Ahmad bin Ibrahim Isma'ili laaye hain ke khilafat-e-Farooqi ke zamaane mein aap ne Muhsin ke chand aadmi bulaaye, un mein do shakhs woh the jinhon ne yahoodiyon se chand baatein muntakhib kar ke likh li thin.

Woh us majmoo'e ko bhi apne sath laye taake Hazrat se daryaft kar lein agar aap ne ijazat di to hum us mein usi jaisi aur batein bhi barha lein ge warna ise bhi phenk dein ge. Yahan aakar unho ne kaha ke Amir-ul-Mominein yahoodi se hum ba'z aisi batein sunte hain ke jin se hamare rongte khare ho jate hain to kya woh batein un se le lein ya bilkul hi na lein? Aap ne farmaya shayad tum ne un ki kuch batein likh rakhi hain? Suno main is mein faisla-kun waqia sunata hoon. Main Huzoor ﷺ ke zamane mein Khaibar gaya. Wahan ke ek yahoodi ki batein mujh ko bohat pasand aayin. Main ne us se darkhwast ki aur us ne woh batein mujhe likh dein. Main ne wapas aakar Huzoor ﷺ se zikr kiya aap ne farmaya jao woh le kar aao main khushi khushi chala gaya shayad Huzoor ﷺ ko mera yeh kaam pasand aa gaya tha. Lakar main ne us ko parhna shuru kiya. Ab jo zara si der ke baad main ne nazar uthai to dekha ke Huzoor ﷺ to sakht naraz hain. Meri zaban se to ek harf bhi na nikla aur mare khouf ke mera rawan rawan khara ho gaya. Meri yeh halat dekh kar ab aap ne un tehreeron ko utha liya aur un ka ek ek harf mitana shuru kiya aur zaban-e-mubarak se irshad farmate jate thay ke dekho khabardar un ki na manna. Yeh to gumraahi ke garhe mein ja pare hain aur yeh to doosron ko bhi behka rahe hain. Chunacha aap ne us sari tehreef ka ek harf bhi baqi na rakha. Yeh suna kar Hazrat Umar R.A ne farmaya ke agar tum ne bhi un ki batein likhi huwi hoton to main tumhein aisi saza karta jo auron ke liye ibrat ho jaye. Unho ne kaha Wallah hum hargaz ek harf bhi na likhein ge. Bahar aate hi jangal mein ja kar unho ne apni woh takhtiyan garha khood kar dafan kar dein. Maraseel-e-Abi Dawood mein bhi Hazrat Umar R.A se aisi hi riwayat hai Wallahu A'lam.

Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke Hadrat Umar bin Khattab R.A ne Aap ﷺ se kaha ke Bani Quraiza qabila ke mere ek dost ne Taurat mein se chand jami’ baatein mujhe likh di hain, toh kya main unhein Aap ko sunaon? Aap ka chehra mutagayyar ho gaya.

Hazrat Abdullah bin Sabit ne kaha ke 'Aaye Umar! Kya tum Huzoor ﷺ ke chehre ko nahi dekh rahe?' Ab Hazrat Umar ki nigaah padi toh aap kehne lage hum Allah ke Rabb hone par, Islam ke deen hone par aur Muhammad ﷺ ke Rasool ﷺ hone par dil se razaamand hain. Ab aap ke chehre se gussa door hua aur farmaya: 'Us zaat-e-paak ki qasam jis ke haath mein Muhammad ﷺ ki jaan hai ke agar tum mein khud Hazrat Musa hote phir tum mujhe chhod kar un ki ittebaah mein lag jaate toh tum sab gumrah ho jaate, ummaton mein se mera hissa tum ho aur nabiyon mein se tumhara hissa main hoon.' 

Abu Yala mein hai ke Susa ka rehne wala qabeela Abdul Qais ka ek shakhs Janab Farooq-e-Azam R.A ke paas aaya. Aap ne us se poocha ke tera naam fulaan fulaan hai? Us ne kaha haan. Poocha toh Susa mein muqeem hai? Us ne kaha haan. Toh aap ke haath mein jo khosha tha usay maara. Us ne kaha: 'Amir-ul-Mumineen! Mera kya qasoor hai?' 

Aap ne farmaya: 'Baith ja, main batata hoon.' 

Phir Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim padh kar usi soorat ki (aayatein liman al-ghaafilin) tak padhein, teen martaba un aayaton ki tilawat ki aur teen martaba usay maara. Us ne phir poocha ke: 'Amir-ul-Mumineen! Mera qasoor kya hai?' 

Aap ne farmaya: 'Tu ne Daniyal ki ek kitab likhi hai.' 

Us ne kaha: 'Phir jo aap farmaayein, main karne ko tayyar hoon.' 

Aap ne farmaya: 'Ja aur garm paani aur safed rooi se usay bilkul mita de. Khabardar aaj ke baad se usay khud padhna na kisi aur ko padhana. Ab agar main is ke khilaaf suna ke tu ne khud isay padha ya kisi ko padhaya toh aisi sakht saza karunga ke ibrat bane.' 

Phir farmaya: 'Baith ja, ek baat sunta ja. Main ne jaakar Ahl-e-Kitab ki ek kitab likhi, phir usay chamde mein liye hue Huzoor ﷺ ke paas aaya. Aap ne mujh se poocha: "Tere haath mein yeh kya hai?" 

Main ne kaha: "Ek kitab hai ke hum ilm mein badh jaayen." 

Is par aap is qadar naraaz hue ke gusse ki wajah se aap ke rukhsaar par surkhī namoodar ho gayi, phir munadi ki gayi ke namaz jama karne wali hai. Usi waqt Ansar ne hathiyar nikaal liye ke kisi ne Huzoor ﷺ ko naraaz kar diya hai aur Mimbar-e-Nabawi ﷺ ke charon taraf woh log hathiyar-band baith gaye. 

Ab aap ne farmaya: "Logon! Main jaami' kalimaat diya gaya hoon aur kalimaat ke khaatim diya gaya hoon aur phir mere liye bahut hi ikhtisaar kiya gaya hai, main Allah ke deen ki baatein bahut safed aur numayan laya hoon. Khabardar tum behk na jaana. Gehrai mein utarne wale kahin tumhein behka na dein." 

Yeh sun kar Hazrat Umar khade ho gaye aur kehne lage: "Main toh Ya Rasool Allah ﷺ! Allah ke Rabb hone par, Islam ke deen hone par, aap ke Rasool ﷺ hone par dil se raazi hoon."'

Ab jo ﷺ mimbar se utre, is ke ek raawi Abdur Rahman bin Ishaq ko muhaddiseen zaeef kehte hain, Imam Bukhari un ki hadith ko sahih nahi likhte. Main kehta hoon is ka ek shahid aur sanad Hafiz Abu Bakr Ahmad bin Ibrahim Isma'ili laaye hain ke khilafat-e-Farooqi ke zamaane mein aap ne Muhsin ke chand aadmi bulaaye, un mein do shakhs woh the jinhon ne yahoodiyon se chand baatein muntakhib kar ke likh li thin.

Woh us majmoo'e ko bhi apne sath laye taake Hazrat se daryaft kar lein agar aap ne ijazat di to hum us mein usi jaisi aur batein bhi barha lein ge warna ise bhi phenk dein ge. Yahan aakar unho ne kaha ke Amir-ul-Mominein yahoodi se hum ba'z aisi batein sunte hain ke jin se hamare rongte khare ho jate hain to kya woh batein un se le lein ya bilkul hi na lein? Aap ne farmaya shayad tum ne un ki kuch batein likh rakhi hain? Suno main is mein faisla-kun waqia sunata hoon. Main Huzoor ﷺ ke zamane mein Khaibar gaya. Wahan ke ek yahoodi ki batein mujh ko bohat pasand aayin. Main ne us se darkhwast ki aur us ne woh batein mujhe likh dein. Main ne wapas aakar Huzoor ﷺ se zikr kiya aap ne farmaya jao woh le kar aao main khushi khushi chala gaya shayad Huzoor ﷺ ko mera yeh kaam pasand aa gaya tha. Lakar main ne us ko parhna shuru kiya. Ab jo zara si der ke baad main ne nazar uthai to dekha ke Huzoor ﷺ to sakht naraz hain. Meri zaban se to ek harf bhi na nikla aur mare khouf ke mera rawan rawan khara ho gaya. Meri yeh halat dekh kar ab aap ne un tehreeron ko utha liya aur un ka ek ek harf mitana shuru kiya aur zaban-e-mubarak se irshad farmate jate thay ke dekho khabardar un ki na manna. Yeh to gumraahi ke garhe mein ja pare hain aur yeh to doosron ko bhi behka rahe hain. Chunacha aap ne us sari tehreef ka ek harf bhi baqi na rakha. Yeh suna kar Hazrat Umar R.A ne farmaya ke agar tum ne bhi un ki batein likhi huwi hoton to main tumhein aisi saza karta jo auron ke liye ibrat ho jaye. Unho ne kaha Wallah hum hargaz ek harf bhi na likhein ge. Bahar aate hi jangal mein ja kar unho ne apni woh takhtiyan garha khood kar dafan kar dein. Maraseel-e-Abi Dawood mein bhi Hazrat Umar R.A se aisi hi riwayat hai Wallahu A'lam.

Behtareen qissa Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke walid Hazrat Yaqub bin Ishaq bin Ibrahim Alaihimas Salam hain. Chunacha hadith-e-shareef mein hai ke "Kareem bin Kareem bin Kareem bin Kareem Yusuf bin Yaqub bin Ishaq bin Ibrahim (A.S) hain." (Bukhari). Aanplaceholder ﷺ se sawal hua ke sab logon mein zyada buzurg kaun hai? Aapne farmaya jis ke dil mein Allah ka dar sab se zyada ho. Unhon ne kaha hamara maqsood aisa aam jawab nahi hai. Aapne farmaya phir sab logon mein zyada buzurg Hazrat Yusuf hain jo khud nabi thay, jin ke walid nabi thay jin ke dada nabi thay, jin ke pardada nabi aur Khalil thay. Unhon ne kaha hum yeh bhi nahi poochte. Aapne farmaya phir kya tum Arab ke qabeelon ki nisbat yeh sawal karte ho? Unhon ne kaha ji haan. Aapne farmaya suno jahiliyat ke zamaney mein jo mumtaz aur shareef thay, woh islam laney ke baad bhi waise hi shareef hain, jab ke unhon ne deeni samajh hasil kar li ho. (Bukhari). Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain nabiyon ke khwab Allah ki wahi hote hain. Mufassireen ne kaha hai ke yahan gyarah sitaron se murad Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke gyarah bhai hain aur suraj chand se murad aap ke walid aur walda hain. Is khwab ki tabeer khwab dekhne ke chalis saal baad zahir hui. Baaz kehte hain assi baras ke baad zahir hui. Jab ke aap ne apne maan baap ko takht-e-shahi par bithaya, aur gyarah bhai aap ke samne sajday mein gir paray. Us waqt aap ne farmaya ke mere meharban baap yeh dekhiye aaj Allah Ta'ala ne mere khwab ko sachcha kar dikhaya. Ek riwayat mein hai ke Bustana nami yahudiyon ka ek zabardast alim tha. Us ne Aanplaceholder ﷺ se un gyarah sitaron ke naam daryaft kiye. Aap khamosh rahay. Jibrail (A.S) ne aasman se nazil ho kar aap ko naam bataye aap ne use bulwaya aur farmaya agar main tujhe in ke naam bata dun to tu musalman ho jayega us ne ikrar kiya to aap ne farmaya sun in ke naam yeh hain: Jariyan, Tariq, Ziyal, Zual-Katfain, Qabil, Wasshab, Amoodan, Faliq, Misbah, Farouh, Fargh. Yahudi ne kaha haan haan Allah ki qasam in sitaron ke yehi naam hain. (Ibn Jarir). Yeh riwayat Dalail-e-Bayhaqi mein aur Abu Yala, Bazzar aur Ibn Abi Hatim mein bhi hai. Abu Yala mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ne jab yeh khwab apne walid sahab se bayan kiya to aap ne farmaya "Yeh sachcha khwab hai yeh pura ho kar rahega." Aap farmate hain suraj se murad baap hain aur chand se murad maan hain. Lekin is riwayat ki sanad mein Hukam bin Zaheer Fazari munfarid hain jinhe baaz imamoun ne zaeef kaha hai aur aksar ne unhe matrook kar rakha hai, yehi Hasan Yusuf ki riwayat ke rawi hain. Unhe chaaron hi zaeef kehte hain.

Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki Ta'beer aur Hidayat

Hazrat Yusuf ka yeh khwab sun kar is ki ta'beer ko samne rakh kar Hazrat Yaqub Alaihis Salam ne takeed kardi ke ise bhaiyon ke samne na dohrana kyunki is khwab ki ta'beer yeh hai ke aur bhai aap ke samne past honge yahan tak ke woh aap ki izrat-o-ta'zeem ke liye aap ke samne apni bahut hi lachari aur aajizi zahir karenge is liye bahut hi mumkin hai ke is khwab ko sun kar is ki ta'beer ko samne rakh kar Shaitan ke behkaye mein aa kar abhi se woh tumhari dushmani mein lag jayen. Aur hasad ki wajah se koi na-maqool tareeq-e-kar karne lag jayen aur kisi heele se tujhe past karne ki fikar mein lag jayen.

Chanache Rasool Allah ﷺ ki taleem bhi yehi hai. Farmate hain tum log koi accha khwab dekho to khair ise bayan kar do aur jo shakhs koi bura khwab dekhe to jis karwat par ho woh karwat badal de aur bayen taraf teen martaba thuthkar de aur is ki burai se Allah ki panah talab kare aur kisi se is ka zikr na kare. Is soorat mein ise woh khwab koi nuqsaan na dega.

Musnad Ahmad waghera ki hadees mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain khwab ki ta'beer jab tak na li jaye woh goya parind ke paon par hai. Haan jab is ki ta'beer bayan ho gayi phir woh ho jata hai. Isi se yeh hukm bhi liya ja sakta hai ke naemat ko chupana chahiye. Jab tak ke woh az-khud acchi tarah hasil na ho jaye aur zahir na ho jaye, jaise ke ek hadees mein hai: Zarooraton ke poora karne par un ke chupane se bhi madad liya karo kyunki har woh shakhs jise koi naemat mile log is ke hasad ke darpey ho jate hain.

Bsharat aur Naseehat

Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) apne lakht-e-jigar Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ko unhein milne wale martabon ki khabar dete hain ke jis tarah khwab mein us ne tumhein yeh fazilat dikhayi isi tarah woh tumhein nubuwwat ka buland martaba ata farmaye ga. Aur tumhein khwab ki tabeer sikha de ga. Aur tumhein apni bharpoor nemat de ga yaani nubuwwat. Jaise ke is se pehle woh Ibrahim Khaleelullah (Alaihis Salam) ko aur Hazrat Ishaq (Alaihis Salam) ko bhi ata farma chuka hai jo tumhare dada aur pardada thay. Allah Ta'ala is se khoob waqif hai ke nubuwwat ke la-iq kaun hai?

Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ke khandan ka taaruf: Fi-l-waqi' Hazrat Yusuf aur unke bhaiyon ke waqiyat is qabil hain ki unka daryaft karne wala unse bahut si ibratein hasil kar sake aur naseehtein le sake. Hazrat Yusuf ke ek hi maan se dusre bhai Banyamin the baaki sab bhai dusri maan se the. Yeh sab aapas mein kehte hain ki wallah abajaan hum se zyada un dono ko chahte hain. Tajjub hai ki hum par jo jama'at hain unko tarjeeh dete hain jo sirf do hain. Yaqeenan yeh to walid sahib ki sareeh ghalati hai.

Yeh yaad rahe ki Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ke bhaiyon ki nabuwat par dar-asal koi daleel nahi aur ayat ka tarz-e-bayan to bilkul is ke khilaf par hai. Baaz logon ka bayan hai ki is waqie ke baad unhe nabuwat mili lekin yeh cheez bhi mohtaj-e-daleel hai aur daleel mein ayat-e-quurani: (Qooloo amanna billahi wa ma unzila ilayna wa ma unzila ila Ibraheema wa Isma'eela wa Ishaqa wa Ya'qooba wal-asbati wa ma ootiya Moosa wa 'Isa wa ma ootiya an-nabiyyoona min rabbihim la nufarriqu baina ahadin minhum wa nahnu lahu muslimoon) (2. Al-Baqarah: 136) mein se lafz asbaat pesh karna bhi ihtimal se zyada wuquat nahi rakhta. Is liye ki baton-e-Bani Israel ko asbaat kaha jata hai jaise ki Arab ko qabail kaha jata hai aur Ajam ko sho'oub kaha jata hai.

Pas ayat mein sirf itna hi hai ki Bani Israel ke asbaat par wahi-e-ilahi nazil ho gayi, unhe is liye ijmalan zikr kiya gaya ki yeh bahut the lekin har sibt baradaran-e-Yusuf mein se ek ki nasl thi. Pas is ki koi daleel nahi ki khas un bhaiyon ko Allah Ta'ala ne khilat-e-nabuwat se nawaza tha, wallah a'lam.

Phir aapas mein kehte hain ek kaam karo, na rahe baans na baje bansuri, Yusuf ka paap hi kaato, na yeh ho na hamari rah ka kanta bane, hum hi hum nazar aayein aur abaa ki mohabbat sirf hamare hi saath rahe. Ab ise baap se hatane ki do sooratein hain, ya to ise maar hi dalo ya kahin aisi door-daraaz jagah phenk aao ki ek ko dusre ko khabar hi na ho aur yeh wardat kar ke phir nek ban jana, tauba kar lena, Allah muaaf karne wala hai.

Yeh sun kar ek ne mashwara diya jo sab se bada tha, uska naam Rabeel tha, koi kehta hai Yahuda tha, koi kehta hai Sham'oon tha. Us ne kaha bhai yeh to naan-insafi hai, be-wajh, be-qusoor sirf adawat mein aakar khoon-e-nahaq gardan par lena to theek nahi. Yeh bhi kuch Allah ki hikmat thi, Rab ko manzoor hi na tha in mein qatl-e-Yusuf ki quwwat hi na thi. Manzoor-e-rab to yeh tha ki Yusuf ko nabi banaye, badshah banaye aur unhe aajizi ke saath uske samne khada kare. Pas unke dil Rabeel ki raaye se naram ho gaye aur taye hua ki ise kisi ghair-abad kuwe ki teh mein phenk dein.

Qatadah kehte hain yeh Bait-ul-Maqdas ka kuwa tha, unhe yeh khayal hua ki mumkin hai musafir wahan se guzrein aur woh ise apne qafile mein le jayen, phir kahan yeh aur kahan hum? Jab gud diye kaam nalta ho to zehar kyun do?

Bighair qatal kiye maqsood hasil hota hai toh kyun haath khoon se alood karo. Inke gunah ka tasawwur toh karo. Yeh rishtedari ke todne, baap ki na-farmani karne, chhote par zulm karne, be-gunah ko nuqsan pahunchane, bade boodhe ko satane aur haqdar ka haq kaatne, hurmat-o-fazilat ke khilaf karne, buzurgi ko talne aur apne baap ko dukh pahunchane aur use uske kaleje ki thandak aur aankhon ke sukh se hamesha ke liye door karne aur boodhe baap, Allah ke ladle paighambar ko is budhape mein na-qabil-e- برداشت (bardasht) sadma pahunchane aur is be-samajh bachche ko apne meharban baap ki pyar bhari nigahon se hamesha ojhal karne ke darpe hain. Allah ke do nabiyon ko dukh dena chahte hain. Mahboob aur muhib mein tafriqa dalna chahte hain, sukh ki janon ko dukh mein dalna chahte hain. Phool se nazuk be-zaban bachche ko uske mushfiq meharban boodhe baap ki narm-o-garm godi se alag karte hain. Allah inhen bakhshe aah shaitan ne kaisi ulti padhai hai. Aur unhon ne bhi kaisi badi par kamar bandhi hai.

Us ne kaha bhai yeh to naan-insafi hai, be-wajh, be-qusoor sirf adawat mein aakar khoon-e-nahaq gardan par lena to theek nahi. Yeh bhi kuch Allah ki hikmat thi, Rab ko manzoor hi na tha in mein qatl-e-Yusuf ki quwwat hi na thi. Manzoor-e-rab to yeh tha ki Yusuf ko nabi banaye, badshah banaye aur unhe aajizi ke saath uske samne khada kare. Pas unke dil Rabeel ki raaye se naram ho gaye aur taye hua ki ise kisi ghair-abad kuwe ki teh mein phenk dein.

Qatadah kehte hain yeh Bait-ul-Maqdas ka kuwa tha, unhe yeh khayal hua ki mumkin hai musafir wahan se guzrein aur woh ise apne qafile mein le jayen, phir kahan yeh aur kahan hum? Jab gud diye kaam nalta ho to zehar kyun do?

Bighair qatal kiye maqsood hasil hota hai toh kyun haath khoon se alood karo. Inke gunah ka tasawwur toh karo. Yeh rishtedari ke todne, baap ki na-farmani karne, chhote par zulm karne, be-gunah ko nuqsan pahunchane, bade boodhe ko satane aur haqdar ka haq kaatne, hurmat-o-fazilat ke khilaf karne, buzurgi ko talne aur apne baap ko dukh pahunchane aur use uske kaleje ki thandak aur aankhon ke sukh se hamesha ke liye door karne aur boodhe baap, Allah ke ladle paighambar ko is budhape mein na-qabil-e- برداشت (bardasht) sadma pahunchane aur is be-samajh bachche ko apne meharban baap ki pyar bhari nigahon se hamesha ojhal karne ke darpe hain. Allah ke do nabiyon ko dukh dena chahte hain. Mahboob aur muhib mein tafriqa dalna chahte hain, sukh ki janon ko dukh mein dalna chahte hain. Phool se nazuk be-zaban bachche ko uske mushfiq meharban boodhe baap ki narm-o-garm godi se alag karte hain. Allah inhen bakhshe aah shaitan ne kaisi ulti padhai hai. Aur unhon ne bhi kaisi badi par kamar bandhi hai.

Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ke khandan ka taaruf: Fi-l-waqi' Hazrat Yusuf aur unke bhaiyon ke waqiyat is qabil hain ki unka daryaft karne wala unse bahut si ibratein hasil kar sake aur naseehtein le sake. Hazrat Yusuf ke ek hi maan se dusre bhai Banyamin the baaki sab bhai dusri maan se the. Yeh sab aapas mein kehte hain ki wallah abajaan hum se zyada un dono ko chahte hain. Tajjub hai ki hum par jo jama'at hain unko tarjeeh dete hain jo sirf do hain. Yaqeenan yeh to walid sahib ki sareeh ghalati hai.

Yeh yaad rahe ki Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ke bhaiyon ki nabuwat par dar-asal koi daleel nahi aur ayat ka tarz-e-bayan to bilkul is ke khilaf par hai. Baaz logon ka bayan hai ki is waqie ke baad unhe nabuwat mili lekin yeh cheez bhi mohtaj-e-daleel hai aur daleel mein ayat-e-quurani: (Qooloo amanna billahi wa ma unzila ilayna wa ma unzila ila Ibraheema wa Isma'eela wa Ishaqa wa Ya'qooba wal-asbati wa ma ootiya Moosa wa 'Isa wa ma ootiya an-nabiyyoona min rabbihim la nufarriqu baina ahadin minhum wa nahnu lahu muslimoon) (2. Al-Baqarah: 136) mein se lafz asbaat pesh karna bhi ihtimal se zyada wuquat nahi rakhta. Is liye ki baton-e-Bani Israel ko asbaat kaha jata hai jaise ki Arab ko qabail kaha jata hai aur Ajam ko sho'oub kaha jata hai.

Pas ayat mein sirf itna hi hai ki Bani Israel ke asbaat par wahi-e-ilahi nazil ho gayi, unhe is liye ijmalan zikr kiya gaya ki yeh bahut the lekin har sibt baradaran-e-Yusuf mein se ek ki nasl thi. Pas is ki koi daleel nahi ki khas un bhaiyon ko Allah Ta'ala ne khilat-e-nabuwat se nawaza tha, wallah a'lam.

Phir aapas mein kehte hain ek kaam karo, na rahe baans na baje bansuri, Yusuf ka paap hi kaato, na yeh ho na hamari rah ka kanta bane, hum hi hum nazar aayein aur abaa ki mohabbat sirf hamare hi saath rahe. Ab ise baap se hatane ki do sooratein hain, ya to ise maar hi dalo ya kahin aisi door-daraaz jagah phenk aao ki ek ko dusre ko khabar hi na ho aur yeh wardat kar ke phir nek ban jana, tauba kar lena, Allah muaaf karne wala hai.

Manzoor-e-rab to yeh tha ki Yusuf ko nabi banaye, badshah banaye aur unhe aajizi ke saath uske samne khada kare. Pas unke dil Rabeel ki raaye se naram ho gaye aur taye hua ki ise kisi ghair-abad kuwe ki teh mein phenk dein.

Allah ke do nabiyon ko dukh dena chahte hain. Mahboob aur muhib mein tafriqa dalna chahte hain, sukh ki janon ko dukh mein dalna chahte hain. Phool se nazuk be-zaban bachche ko uske mushfiq meharban boodhe baap ki narm-o-garm godi se alag karte hain. Allah inhen bakhshe aah shaitan ne kaisi ulti padhai hai. Aur unhon ne bhi kaisi badi par kamar bandhi hai.

Bare bhai ki rai par itfaq. Bare bhai Rubin ke samjhane par sab bhaiyon ne is rai par itfaq karliya ke Yusuf ko le jayen aur kisi ghair abad kuwein mein dal ayen. Yeh tay karne ke baad baap ko dhoka dene aur bhai ko phusla kar le jane aur is par aafat dhane ke liye sab mil kar baap ke paas aye. Bawajood-e-ke thay bad-andesh, bad-khwah, bura chahne wale lekin baap ko apni baaton mein phansane ke liye aur apni gehri sazish mein unhein uljhane ke liye pehle hi jaal bichhate hain ke aba ji akhir kya baat hai jo ap humein Yusuf ke bare mein ameen nahi jante? Hum to us ke bhai hain, us ki khair-khwahiyan hum se ziyada kaun kar sakta hai? (Yarta'u wa yal'abu wa inna lahu la-hafizun 12) (12. Yusuf: 12) ki dusri qira'at (ayat yarta'u wa nal'abu) bhi hai. Baap se kehte hain ke bhai Yusuf ko kal hamare sath sair ke liye bhejiye. Un ka ji khush hoga, do ghari khel-kood lenge, hans bol lenge, azadi se chal phir lenge. Ap be-fikr rahiye hum sab us ki puri hifazat karenge. Har waqt dekh-bhal rakhenge. Ap hum par itimad kijiye hum us ke nigehban hain.

Ap be-fikr rahiye hum sab us ki puri hifazat karenge. Har waqt dekh-bhal rakhenge. Ap hum par itimad kijiye hum us ke nigehban hain.

Anjaane khatre ka izhaar Nabi Allah Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) apne beton ki is talab ka ke bhai Yusuf ko hamare sath sair ke liye bhejiye jawab dete hain ke tumhein maloom hai mujhe is se bohat mohabbat hai. Tum ise le jaoge mujh par is ki itni dair ki judai bhi shaq guzregi. Hazrat Yaqub ki is barhi hui mohabbat ki waja yeh thi ke Aap Hazrat Yusuf ke chehre par khair ke nishaan dekh rahe the. Nubuwwat ka noor peshani se zahir tha. Akhlaq ki pakeezgi ek ek baat se ayan thi, surat ki khoobi, seerat ki achhai ka bayan thi, Allah ki taraf se dono baap beton par salat-o-salam ho. Dusri waja yeh bhi hai ke mumkin hai tum apni bakriyon ke charane chgane aur dusre kaamon mein mashghool raho aur Allah na kare koi bheriya aakar is ka kaam tamam kar jaye aur tumhein pata bhi na chale. Ah Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ki isi baat ko unhon ne le liya aur dimagh mein basa liya ke yehi theek uzr hai, Yusuf ko alag kar ke abba ke samne yehi mongharat ghar denge. Isi waqt baat banai aur jawab diya ke abba aap ne kya khoob socha. Hamari jamaat ki jamaat qawi aur taqatwar mojood ho aur hamare bhai ko bheriya kha jaye? Bilkul namumkin hai. Agar aisa ho jaye to phir to hum sab bekaar nikmay ajiz nuqsan wale hi hue.

Agar aisa ho jaye to phir to hum sab bekaar nikmay ajiz nuqsan wale hi hue.

Bhai apne mansuba mein kamyab ho gaye. Samjha bujha kar bhaiyon ne baap ko raazi kar hi liya. Aur Hazrat Yusuf ko lekar chale jangal mein ja kar sab ne is baat par ittefaq kiya ki Yusuf ko kisi ghair abad kuwe ki teh mein daal dein. Halanki baap se yeh keh kar le gaye the ki is ka ji bahelega, hum ise izzat ke sath le jayenge. Har tarah khush rakhenge. Is ka ji behal jayega aur yeh raazi khushi rahega. Yahan aate hi ghaddari shuru kardi aur lutf yeh hai ki sab ne ek sath dil sakht kar liya. Baap ne un ki baton mein aakar apne lakht-e-jigar ko un ke supurd kardiya. Jaate hue seene se laga kar pyaar puchkar kar duayein de kar rukhsat kiya. Baap ki ankhon se hatte hi un sab ne bhai ko ezaayein deni shuru karden, bura bhala kehne lage aur chanta chatool se bhi baaz na rahe. Marte peete bura bhala kehte, us kuwe ke paas pahunche aur hath paon rassi se jakad kar kuwe mein girana chaha. Aap ek ek ke daman se chimtate hain aur ek ek se raham ki darkhwast karte hain lekin har ek jhidak deta hai aur dhakka de kar maar peet kar hata deta hai, mayus ho gaye sab ne mil kar mazboot bandha aur kuwe mein latka diya, aap ne kuwe ka kinara hath se tham liya lekin bhaiyon ne ungliyon par maar maar kar use bhi hath se chuda liya. Aadhi door aap pahunche honge ki unhon ne rassi kaat di. Aap teh mein ja gire, kuwe ke darmiyan ek pathar tha jis par akar khade ho gaye. Ain is museebat ke waqt, ain is sakhti aur tangi ke waqt Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki jaanib wahi ki ki aap ka dil mutmain ho jaye, aap sabr-o-bardasht se kaam lein aur anjam ka aap ko ilm ho jaye. Wahi mein farmaya gaya ki ghamgeen na ho, yeh na samajh ke yeh museebat door na hogi. Sun, Allah Ta'ala tujhe is sakhti ke baad asani dega. Is takleef ke baad rahat milegi. In bhaiyon par Allah tujhe ghalba dega. Yeh go tujhe past karna chahte hain lekin Allah ki chahat hai ki woh tujhe buland kare. Yeh jo kuch aaj tere sath kar rahe hain waqt aayega ki tu unhe un ke is kartoot ko yaad dilayega aur yeh nadamat se sar jhukaye hue honge, apne qasoor sun rahe honge. Aur unhe yeh bhi maloom na hoga ki tu woh hai. Chunacha Hazrat Ibn Abbas R.H se marwi hai ki jab baradaran-e-Yusuf Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ke paas pahunche to aap ne to unhe pehchan liya lekin yeh na pehchan sake. Us waqt aap ne ek pyala mangwaya aur apne hath par rakh kar use ungli se thonka. Awaz nikli hi thi us waqt aap ne farmaya lo yeh jam to kuch keh raha hai aur tumhare mutaliq hi kuch khabar de raha hai. Yeh keh raha hai tumhara ek Yusuf naami sautela bhai tha. Tum use baap ke paas se le gaye aur use kuwe mein phenk diya. Phir use ungli maari aur zara si dair kaan laga kar farmaya lo yeh keh raha hai ki phir tum us ke kurte par jhoota khoon laga kar baap ke paas gaye aur wahan ja kar un se keh diya ki tere ladke ko bhediye ne kha liya.

Ab toh yeh hairan ho gaye aapas mein kehne lage haye bura hua bhaanda phoot gaya is jaam ne toh tamam sachi sachi baatein baadshah se keh dien. Pas yahi hai jo aap ko kuwein mein wahi hui ke un ke is ke kartut ko toh unhein un ke beshauri mein jataye ga.

Bhaiyon ki wapsi aur maazrat. Chup chaap nanhe bhaiya par, Allah ke masoom Nabi par, baap ki aankh ke tare par zulm-o-sitam ke pahad tod kar raat hue baap ke paas surkh-roo hone aur apni hamdardi zahir karne ke liye ghamzada ho kar rote hue pahuche aur apne malal ka Yusuf ke na hone ka sabab yeh bayan kiya ki hum ne teer-andazi aur daur shuru ki. Chote bhai ko asbab ke paas chhoda. Ittefaq ki baat hai usi waqt bhediya aa gaya aur bhai ko luqma bana liya. Cheer-phaad kar kha gaya. Phir baap ko apni baat sahi taur par jachane aur theek bawar karane ke liye paani se pehle band bandhte hain ki hum agar aap ke nazdeek sache hi hote tab bhi yeh waqea aisa hai ki aap hamein sacha manne mein tamul karte. Phir jab ke pehle hi se aap ne apna ek khatka zahir kiya ho aur khilaf-e-zahir waqea mein hi ittefaqan aisa hi ho bhi jaye to zahir hai ki aap us waqt to woh hamein sacha maan hi nahi sakte. Hain to hum sache hi lekin aap bhi hum par aitbaar na karne mein ek had tak haq bajaane hain. Kyunki yeh waqea hi aisa anokha hai hum khud hairaan hain ki ho kya gaya yeh toh tha zubani khel ek kaam bhi usi ke sath kar aaye the yaani bakri ke ek bache ko zibah kar ke uske khoon se Hazrat Yusuf ka pairahan daghdaar kar diya ke ba-taur shahadat ke abaa ke samne pesh karenge ke dekho yeh hain Yusuf bhai ke khoon ke dhabbe unke kurte par. Lekin Allah ki shaan chor ke paon kahan? Sab kuch toh kiya lekin kurta phaadna bhool gaye. Iske liye baap par sab makar khul gaya. Lekin Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne zabt kiya aur saaf lafzon mein go na kaha taham beton ko bhi pata chal gaya ki abaa ji ko hamari baat jachi nahi farmaya ke tumhare dil ne yeh toh ek baat bana di hai. Khair main toh tumhari is mazboohi harkat par sabr hi karunga. Yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala apne rahm-o-karam se is dukh ko taal de. Tum jo ek jhooti baat mujh se bayan kar rahe ho aur ek mahal cheez par mujhe yaqeen dila rahe ho aur is par main Allah se madad talab karta hoon aur uski madad shamil-e-haal rahe toh doodh ka doodh aur pani ka pani alag ho jayega. Ibn Abbas ka qaul hai ke kurta dekh kar aap ne yeh bhi farmaya tha ke taajub hai bhediya Yusuf ko kha gaya uska pairahan khoon-alood ho gaya magar kahin se zara bhi na phata. Khair main sabr karunga. Jismein koi shikayat na ho na koi ghabraahat ho. Kehte hain ke teen cheezon ka naam sabr hai apni museebat ka kisi se zikr na karna. Apne dil ka dukhda kisi ke samne na rona aur sath hi apne nafs ko paak na samajhna. Imam Bukhari (ؒ) is mauqe par Hazrat Aisha (ؓ) ke is waqea ki poori hadith ko bayan kiya hai jismein aap par tuhmat lagaye jaane ka zikr hai. Ismein aap ne farmaya hai Wallahi meri aur tumhari misaal Hazrat Yusuf ke baap ki si hai ke unhon ne farmaya tha ab sabr hi behtar hai aur tumhari in baaton par Allah hi se madad chahi gayi hai.

Kyunki yeh waqea hi aisa anokha hai hum khud hairaan hain ki ho kya gaya yeh toh tha zubani khel ek kaam bhi usi ke sath kar aaye the yaani bakri ke ek bache ko zibah kar ke uske khoon se Hazrat Yusuf ka pairahan daghdaar kar diya ke ba-taur shahadat ke abaa ke samne pesh karenge ke dekho yeh hain Yusuf bhai ke khoon ke dhabbe unke kurte par. Lekin Allah ki shaan chor ke paon kahan? Sab kuch toh kiya lekin kurta phaadna bhool gaye. Iske liye baap par sab makar khul gaya. Lekin Allah ke Nabi (ﷺ) ne zabt kiya aur saaf lafzon mein go na kaha taham beton ko bhi pata chal gaya ki abaa ji ko hamari baat jachi nahi farmaya ke tumhare dil ne yeh toh ek baat bana di hai. Khair main toh tumhari is mazboohi harkat par sabr hi karunga. Yahan tak ke Allah Ta'ala apne rahm-o-karam se is dukh ko taal de. Tum jo ek jhooti baat mujh se bayan kar rahe ho aur ek mahal cheez par mujhe yaqeen dila rahe ho aur is par main Allah se madad talab karta hoon aur uski madad shamil-e-haal rahe toh doodh ka doodh aur pani ka pani alag ho jayega. Ibn Abbas ka qaul hai ke kurta dekh kar aap ne yeh bhi farmaya tha ke taajub hai bhediya Yusuf ko kha gaya uska pairahan khoon-alood ho gaya magar kahin se zara bhi na phata. Khair main sabr karunga. Jismein koi shikayat na ho na koi ghabraahat ho. Kehte hain ke teen cheezon ka naam sabr hai apni museebat ka kisi se zikr na karna. Apne dil ka dukhda kisi ke samne na rona aur sath hi apne nafs ko paak na samajhna. Imam Bukhari (ؒ) is mauqe par Hazrat Aisha (ؓ) ke is waqea ki poori hadith ko bayan kiya hai jismein aap par tuhmat lagaye jaane ka zikr hai. Ismein aap ne farmaya hai Wallahi meri aur tumhari misaal Hazrat Yusuf ke baap ki si hai ke unhon ne farmaya tha ab sabr hi behtar hai aur tumhari in baaton par Allah hi se madad chahi gayi hai.

Kunwein se Bazar-e-Misr tak:
Bhai to Hazrat Yusuf ko kunwein mein daal kar chal diye. Yahan teen din aap ko usi andhere kunwein mein akele guzar gaye. Muhammad bin Ishaq ka bayan hai ke is kunwein mein gira kar bhai tamasha dekhne ke liye is ke aas paas hi din bhar phirte rahe ke dekhein woh kya karta hai aur us ke sath kya kya kiya jata hai? Qudrat Allah ki ke ek qafila wahin se guzra. Unhon ne apne saqqa ko pani ke liye bheja. Us ne usi kone mein dol dala, Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ne us ki rassi ko mazboot tham liya aur bajaye pani ke aap bahar nikle. Woh aap ko dekh kar bagh bagh ho gaya, reh na saka ba-awaz-e-buland keh utha ke lo SubhanAllah yeh to naujawan bacha agya. Doosri qirat is ki ya bushra-i bhi hai. Sudai kehte hain Bushra saqqa ke bhejne wale ka naam bhi tha, us ne is ka naam le kar pukar kar khabar di ke mere dol mein to ek bacha aya hai. Lekin Sudai ka yeh qaul ghareeb hai. Is tarah ki qirat par bhi wahi mani ho sakte hain, is ki izafat apne nafs ki taraf hai aur ya-e-izafat saqit hai. Isi ki ta'eed qirat ya bushra-i se hoti hai jaise arab kehte hain ya nafs-i isbri aur ya ghulam-i iqbal izafat ke harf ko saqit kar ke. Us waqt kasra dena bhi jaiz hai aur rafa dena bhi. Pas woh usi qabeel se hai aur doosri qirat is ki tafseer hai. Wallahu A'lam.

In logon ne aap ko bahaishiyat-e-poonji ke chhupa liya qafile ke aur logon par is raaz ka zahir na kiya balke keh diya ke hum ne kunwein ke paas ke logon se ise kharida hai, unhon ne hamein ise de diya hai taake woh bhi apna hissa na milayen. Ek qaul yeh bhi hai ke is se murad yeh bhi hai ke baradaran-e-Yusuf ne shinakhat chhupai aur Hazrat Yusuf ne bhi apne aap ko zahir na kiya ke aisa na ho yeh log kahin mujhe qatal hi na kardein. Is liye chup chaap bhaiyon ke hathon aap bik gaye. Saqqa se unhon ne kaha, us ne awaz de kar bula liya, unhon ne oune paune Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ko un ke hath bech dala. 

Allah kuch in ki is harkat se be-khabar na tha, woh khoob dekh bhaal raha tha, woh qadir tha ke us waqt is bheed ko zahir kar de lekin us ki hikmaten usi ke sath hain, us ki taqeer yunhi yaani jari hui thi. Khalq-o-amr isi ka hai, woh Rabb-ul-Alameen barkaton wala hai. Is mein An-Hazrat (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ko bhi ek tarah taskeen di gayi hai ke main dekh raha hoon ke qoum aap ko dukh de rahi hai, main qadir hoon ke aap ko un se chhurha dun, unhein gharat kar dun lekin mere kaam hikmat ke sath hain, dair hai andher nahi, be-fikr raho, anqareeb ghalib karunga aur rafta rafta un ko past kar dunga. Jaise ke Yusuf aur un ke bhaiyon ke darmiyan meri hikmat ka hath kaam karta raha. Yahan tak ke aakhir anjam Hazrat Yusuf ke samne unhein jhukna pada aur un ke martabe ka iqrar karna pada. 

Bohat thode mol par bhaiyon ne unhein bech diya. Naqis cheez ke badle bhai jaisa bhai de diya. Aur is ki bhi unhein koi parwah na thi balke agar un se bilkul bila qeemat manga jata to bhi de dete.

Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke matlab yeh hai ke qafle walon ne ise bohat kam qeemat par khareeda. Lekin yeh kuch zyada durust nahi is liye ke unhon ne to ise dekh kar khushiyan manai thiyan aur ba-tor poonji ise posheeda kar diya tha. Pas agar unhe is ki be-raghbati hoti to woh aisa kyun karte? Pas tarjeeh usi baat ko hai ke yahan murad bhaiyon ka Hazrat Yusuf ko gire hue narkh par bech dalna hai. Najas se murad haram aur zulm bhi hai. Lekin yahan woh murad nahi li gayi. Kyunke is qeemat ki hurmat ka ilm to har aik ko hai. Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) Nabi bin Nabi bin Nabi Khalil-ur-Rehman (Alaihis Salam) thay. Pas aap to Karim bin Karim bin Karim bin Karim thay. Pas yahan murad nuqsan kam, thori aur khoti balke baraye naam qeemat par bech dalna hai bawajood is ke woh zulm-o-haram bhi tha. Bhai ko bech rahe hain aur woh bhi koriyon ke mol. Chand darhamon ke badle bees ya ba-is ya chalis darham ke badle. Yeh daam le kar aapas mein baant liye. Aur is ki unhe koi parwah na thi, unhe nahi maloom tha ke Allah ke haan in ki kya qandar hai? Woh kya jaante thay ke yeh Allah ke Nabi banne wale hain. Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah) kehte hain ke itna sab kuch karne par bhi sabr na huwa, qafle ke peechhe ho liye aur unse kehne lage dekho is ghulam mein bhaag nikalne ki aadat hai, ise mazboot baandh do, kahin tumhare haathonn se bhi bhaag na jaye. Isi tarah baandhe baandhe Misr tak pahuche aur wahan aap ko bazar mein le ja kar bechne lage. Us waqt Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ne farmaya mujhe jo lega woh khush ho jaye ga. Pas Shah-e-Misr ne aap ko khareed liya woh tha bhi musalman.

Teesray Hadrat Siddique-e-Akbar R.A ke aap ne duniya se rukhsat hote huwe khilafat Hadrat Umar R.A jaise shakhs ko sonpi.

Zulaikha ki badniyati se ilzaam tak. Aziz-e-Misr jis ne Aap ko kharida tha aur bahut achhi tarah aulaad ke misl rakha tha, apni ghar wali se bhi takeedan kaha tha ki inhein kisi tarah takleef na ho, izzat-o-ikram se inhein rakho. Us aurat ki niyat mein khot aa jati hai, jamal-e-Yusuf par freefta ho jati hai, darwaze bheid kar ban sanwar kar bure kaam ki taraf Yusuf ko bulati hai lekin Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) badi sakhti se inkaar kar ke use mayous kar dete hain. Aap farmate hain ki tera khawand mera sardar hai. Us waqt Ahl-e-Misr ke muhaware mein bado ke liye yehi lafz bola jata tha. Aap farmate hain tumhare khawand ki mujh par meharbani hai, woh mere sath suluk-o-ehsan se pesh aate hain, phir kaise mumkin hai ki main un ki khiyanat karun. Yaad rakho cheez ko ghair jagah rakhne wale bhalai se mehroom ho jate hain. 

(Aayat: Hait Laka) ko baaz log suryani zaban ka lafz kahte hain, baaz qibti zaban ka, baaz ise ghareeb lafz batlate hain. Kisai isi qirat ko pasand karte the aur kahte the Ahl-e-Hauran ka ye lughat hai jo Hijaz mein aa gaya hai. Ahl-e-Hauran ke ek aalim ne kaha hai ki ye hamara lughat hai. Imam Ibn-e-Jarir ne is ki shahadat mein sher bhi pesh kiya hai. Is ki doosri qirat He'at bhi hai, pehli qirat ke ma'ane to aa-o ke the, is ke ma'ane mein tere liye taiyar hoon. Baaz log is qirat ka inkaar hi karte hain. Ek qirat He'at bhi hai, ye qirat ghareeb hai, aam Madni logo ki yehi qirat hai. Is par bhi shahadat mein sher pesh kiya jata hai. 

Ibn-e-Masood (R.A) farmate hain: Qariyon ki qiratein qareeb qareeb hain, pas jis tarah tum sikhaye gaye ho padhte raho, gehrai se aur ikhtilaf se aur la'an ta'an se aur aitraz se bacho. Is lafz ke yehi ma'ane hain ki aa aur samne ho waghera. Phir Aap ne is lafz ko padha, kisi ne kaha ise doosri tarah bhi padhte hain, Aap ne farmaya durust hai magar main ne to jis tarah sekha hai usi tarah padhunga, yani Hait na ke He'at. Ye lafz tazkeer, tanees, wahid, tasniya, jama sab ke liye yaksan hota hai. Jaise (Aayat: Hait laka, Hait lakum, Hait lakuma, Haita lakum, Hait lakunna, Hait lahunna).

Yوسف Alaihis Salam ke taqaddus ka sabab salaf ki ek jama'at se to is ayat ke bare mein woh marwi hai jo Ibn Jarir vaghairah laye hain aur kaha gaya hai ke Yوسف Alaihis Salam ka qasd us aurat ke sath sirf nafs ka khatka tha. Baghwi ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal ka farman hai ke jab mera koi banda neki ka irada kare to tum us ki neki likh lo. Aur jab us neki ko kar guzray to us jaisi das guni neki likh lo. Aur agar kisi burai ka irada kare aur phir use na kare to us ke liye neki likh lo. Kyunke us ne meri wajah se us burai ko chora hai. Aur agar us burai ko hi kar guzray to us ke barabar use likh likh lo. Is hadith ke alfaz aur bhi kai ek hain asl Bukhari, Muslim mein bhi hai. Ek qaul hai ke Hazrat Yوسف ne use marne ka qasd kiya tha. Ek qaul hai ke use biwi banane ki tamanna ki thi. Ek qaul hai ke aap qasd karte agar dalil na dekhte lekin chunke dalil dekh li qasd nahi farmaya. Lekin is qaul mein arabi zaban ki haisiyat se kalam hai jise Imam Ibn Jarir vaghairah ne bayan farmaya hai. Yeh to thay aqwal qasd-e-Yوسف ke mutalliq. Woh dalil jo aap ne dekhi us ke mutalliq bhi aqwal mulahiza farmaiye. Kehte hain apne walid Hazrat Ya'qub ko dekha ke goya woh apni ungli munh mein dale khare hain. Aur Hazrat Yوسف ke seene par aap ne hath mara. Kehte hain apne sardar ki khayali tasveer samne aagayi. Kehte hain aap ki nazar chat ki taraf uth gayi dekhte hain ke us par yeh ayat likhi hui hai (ayat la taqrabuz zina innahu kana fahishatan wa maqtan wa sa'a sabeela). Khabardar zina ke qareeb bhi na bhatakna woh bari behayai ka aur Allah ke ghazab ka kaam hai aur woh bara hi bura rasta hai. Kehte hain teen aayatein likhi hui thi ek to (Wa inna 'alaykum lahaafizeen - 82. Al-Infitar: 10) tum par negahban muqarrar hain. Dusri (Wa ma takoonu fi sha'nin wa ma tatloominhu min qur'anin wa la ta'amaloona min 'amalin illa kunna 'alaykum shuhoodan iz tufeedoona feehi - 10. Yunus: 61) tum jis hal mein ho Allah tumhare sath hai. Teesri (Afaman huwa qa'imun 'ala kulli nafsin - 13. Ar-Ra'd: 33) Allah har shakhs ke har amal par hazir nazir hai kehte hain ke chaar aayatein likhi payi teen wahi jo upar hain aur ek hurmat-e-zina ki jo is se pehle hai. Kehte hain ke koi ayat deewar par mamanat-e-zina ke bare mein likhi hui payi. Kehte hain ek nishan tha jo aap ke irade se aap ko rok raha tha. Mumkin hai woh soorat-e-Ya'qub ho. Aur mumkin hai apne khareedne wale ki soorat ho. Aur mumkin hai ayat-e-qurani ho koi aisi saaf dalil nahi ke kisi khas ek cheez ke faisle par hum pahunch saken.

Pas bohot theek raah hamare liye yahi hai ke ise yunhi mutlaq chhor diya jaye jaise ke Allah ke farman mein bhi itlaq hai (usi tarah qasd ko bhi) phir farmata hai hum ne jis tarah us waqt ise ek daleel dikha kar burai se bacha liya, usi tarah us ke aur kaamon mein bhi hum us ki madad karte rahe aur ise buraiyon aur behayaiyon se mehfooz rakhte rahe. Woh tha bhi hamara barguzida pasandida behtareen aur mukhlis banda. Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se aap par durood o salam nazil hon.

Ilzaam ki mudafasat aur bachche ki gawahi:

Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) apne aap ko bachane ke liye wahan se darwaze ki taraf daure aur yeh aurat aap ko pakadne ke irade se aap ke peeche bhagi. Peeche se kurta us ke haath mein aa gaya. Zor se apni taraf ghaseeta. Jis se Hazrat Yusuf peeche ki taraf gir jaane ke qareeb ho gaye lekin aap ne aage ko zor laga kar daur jari rakhi is mein kurta peeche se bilkul be-tarah phat gaya aur dono darwaze par pahunch gaye dekhte hain ki aurat ka khawand maujood hai. Use dekhte hi us ne chaal chali aur foran hi sara ilzaam Yusuf ke sar thop diya aur apni paak damni balke ismat aur mazloomiyat jatane lagi. Sookha samna bana kar apne khawand se apni bapta aur phir pakeezgi bayaan karte hue kehti hai farmaiye huzoor aap ki biwi se jo bad-kaari ka irada rakhe is ki kya saza honi chahiye? Qaid-e-sakht ya buri maar se kam to hargiz koi saza is jurm ki nahi ho sakti.

Ab jab ke Hazrat Yusuf ne apni aabroo ko khatre mein dekha aur khiyanat ki bad-tareen tuhmat lagti dekhi toh apne upar se ilzaam hatane aur saaf aur sachi haqeeqat ke zahir kar dene ke liye farmaya ke haqeeqat yeh hai ki yehi mere peeche padi thi, mere bhagne par mujhe pakad rahi thi, yahan tak ke mera kurta bhi phaad diya. 

Us aurat ke qabeele se ek gawah ne gawahi di. Aur ma-saboot-o-daleel un se kaha ke phate hue pairhan ko dekh lo agar woh samne ke rukh se phata hua hai toh zahir hai ki aurat sachi hai aur yeh jhoota hai is ne ise apni taraf lana chaha is ne ise dhakke diye. Roka mana kiya hataya is mein samne se kurta phat gaya toh waqai qusoor-war mard hai aur aurat jo apni be-gunahi bayaan karti hai woh sachi hai fi-wal-waqiq is soorat mein woh sachi hai. Aur agar is ka kurta peeche se phata hua pao toh aurat ke jhoote aur mard ke sach hone mein shuba nahi. Zahir hai ki aurat is par maail thi yeh is se bhaga woh daudi, pakda, kurta haath mein aa gaya is ne apni taraf ghaseeta is ne apni jaanib khincha woh peeche ki taraf se phat gaya. 

Kehte hain yeh gawah bada aadmi tha jis ke munh par dadhi thi yeh Aziz-e-Misr ka khas aadmi tha aur poori umar ka mard tha. Aur Zulaikha ke chacha ka ladka tha, Zulaikha baadshah-e-waqt Rayyan bin Waleed ki bhanji thi, pas ek qaul toh is gawah ke mutalliq yeh hai. 

Dusra qaul yeh hai ki yeh ek chhota sa doodh peeta gahware mein jhoolta bachcha tha. Ibn-e-Jareer mein hai ki chaar chhote bachchon ne chhatpan mein hi kalaam kiya hai is poori hadees mein is bachche ka bhi zikr hai is ne Hazrat Yusuf Siddique ki paak damni ki shahadat di thi. 

Ibn-e-Abbas farmate hain chaar bachchon ne kalaam kiya hai: Firon ki ladki ki mashata ke ladke ne, Hazrat Yusuf ke gawah ne, Jareej ke sahib ne aur Hazrat Eisa bin Maryam (A.S) ne. 

Mujahid ne toh ek bilkul hi ghareeb baat kahi hai. Woh kehte hain woh sirf Allah ka hukum tha koi insan tha hi nahi. Usi tajweez ke mutabiq jab Zulaikha ke shohar ne dekha toh Hazrat Yusuf ke pairhan ko peeche ki jaanib se phata hua dekha.

Us ke nazdeek sabit hogaya ke Yusuf sacha hai aur us ki biwi jhooti hai, woh Yusuf-e-Siddique par tuhmat laga rahi hai, to besaakhta us ke munh se nikal gaya ke yeh to tum aurton ka fareeb hai. Is naujawan par tum tuhmat baandh rahi ho aur jhoota ilzaam rakh rahi ho. Tumhare chaltar to hain hi chakkar mein daal dene wale. Phir Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) se kehta hai ke aap is waqie ko bhool jaiye, jaane dijiye. Is naamuraad waqie ka phir se zikr hi na keejiye. Phir apni biwi se kehta hai ke tum apne gunah se istighfar karo. Narm aadmi tha, narm ikhlaq thay. Yun samajh lijiye ke woh jaan raha tha ke aurat mazoor samjhe jaane ke laiq hai, us ne woh dekha jis par sabr karna bohat mushkil hai. Is liye use hidayat kar di ke apne bure iraade se tauba kar. Saraasar tu hi khatawaar hai, kiya khud aur ilzaam dusron ke sar rakha.

Us ke nazdeek sabit hogaya ke Yusuf sacha hai aur us ki biwi jhooti hai, woh Yusuf-e-Siddique par tuhmat laga rahi hai, to besaakhta us ke munh se nikal gaya ke yeh to tum aurton ka fareeb hai. Is naujawan par tum tuhmat baandh rahi ho aur jhoota ilzaam rakh rahi ho. Tumhare chaltar to hain hi chakkar mein daal dene wale. Phir Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) se kehta hai ke aap is waqie ko bhool jaiye, jaane dijiye. Is naamuraad waqie ka phir se zikr hi na keejiye. Phir apni biwi se kehta hai ke tum apne gunah se istighfar karo. Narm aadmi tha, narm ikhlaq thay. Yun samajh lijiye ke woh jaan raha tha ke aurat mazoor samjhe jaane ke laiq hai, us ne woh dekha jis par sabr karna bohat mushkil hai. Is liye use hidayat kar di ke apne bure iraade se tauba kar. Saraasar tu hi khatawaar hai, kiya khud aur ilzaam dusron ke sar rakha.

Dastan-e-Ishq aur Haseenan-e-Misr: Is dastan ki khabar shahar mein hui, charche hone lage, chand shareef-zadiyon ne nihayat taajjub aur haqarat se is qisse ko dohraya ke dekho Azeez ki biwi hai aur ek ghulam par jaan de rahi hai, iski mohabbat ko apne dil mein jamaye hue hai. Shaghaf kehte hain had se guzri hui qatil mohabbat ko aur shaghaf isse kam darje ki hoti hai. Dil ke pardo ko auratein shaghaf kehti hain. Kehte hain ke Azeez ki biwi sareeh ghalti mein padi hui hai. In ghibaton ka pata Azeez ki biwi ko bhi chal gaya. Yahan lafz makr isliye bola gaya hai ke biqaul-e-ba'z khud in auraton ka yeh fi-al-waqi ek khula makr tha. Unhein to darasal Husn-e-Yousuf ke deedar ki tamanna thi yeh to sirf ek hila banaya tha. Azeez ki biwi bhi inki chaal samajh gayi aur phir ismein usne apni mazouri ki maslihat bhi dekhi to unke paas usi waqt bulawa bhej diya ke falan waqt aap ki mere haan dawat hai. Aur ek majlis, mehfil, aur baithak durust karli jismein phal aur mewa bahut tha. Usne tarash tarash kar cheel cheel kar khane ke liye ek ek tez chaqu sab ke haath mein de diya, yeh tha un auraton ke dhokhe ka jawab, unhone aitraaz kar ke Jamal-e-Yousuf dekhna chaha, usne aap ko mazoor zahir karne aur unke makr ko zahir karne ke liye unhein khud zakhmi kar diya aur khud in hi ke haath se Hazrat Yousuf (Alaihis Salam) se kaha ke aap aayein. Unhein apni malkika ka hukum manne se kaise inkar ho sakta tha? Usi waqt jis kamre mein the wahan se aa gaye. Auraton ki nigah jo aap ke chehre par padi to sab ki sab dehshat-zada reh gayin. Haibat-o-Jalal aur rub-e-husn se beh-khud ho gayin aur bajaye iske ke in tez chalne wali chhuriyon se phal katte unke haath aur ungliyan katne lagein. Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam kehte hain ke ziyafat baqaida pehle ho chuki thi ab to sirf mewa se tawazo ho rahi thi. Mewe haath mein the, chaqu chal rahe the, jo usne kaha Yousuf ko dekhna chahti ho? Sab yak-zaban ho kar bol uthin haan haan zaroor. Usi waqt Hazrat Yousuf se kahlwa bheja ke tashreef layiye. Aap aaye phir usne kaha jaiye aap chale gaye. Aate jaate samne se peeche se in sab auraton ne poori tarah aap ko dekha dekhte hi sab saktay mein aa gayin hosh-hawas jate rahe bajaye leemoon kaatne ke apne haath kaat liye. Aur koi ehsas tak na hua, haan jab Hazrat Yousuf chale gaye tab hosh aaya aur takleef mehsoos hui. Tab pata chala ke bajaye phal ke haath kaat liya hai. Is par Azeez ki biwi ne kaha dekha ek hi martaba ke jamal ne to tumhe aisa az-khud rafta kar diya phir batao mera kya haal hoga. Auraton ne kaha Wallah yeh insan nahi. Yeh to farishta hai aur farishta bhi bade martabe wala. Aaj ke baad hum kabhi tumhein malamat na karengi. In auraton ne Hazrat Yousuf jaisa to kahan inke qareeb inke mushabeh bhi koi shakhs nahi dekha tha. Aap ko aadha husn Qudrat ne ata farma rakha tha. Chunacha Mairaj ki hadis mein hai ke teesre aasman mein Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mulaqat Hazrat Yousuf (Alaihis Salam) se hui jinhein aadha husn diya gaya tha.

Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Yusuf aur aap ki walida sahibah ko aadha husn qudrat ki fayaziyon ne inayat farmaya tha. Aur riwayat mein tihai husn Yusuf ko aur aap ki walida ko diya gaya tha. Aap ka chehra bijli ki tarah roshan tha. Jab kabhi koi aurat aap ke paas kisi kaam ke liye aati to aap apna munh dhak kar us se baat karte ke kahin woh fitne mein nah parjaye aur riwayat mein hai ke husn ke teen hisse kiye gaye tamam logon mein do hisse taqseem kiye gaye aur aik hissa sirf aap ko aur aap ki maa ko diya gaya. Ya jin ki do tehaiyan is maa bete ko milin aur aik tehai mein duniya ke tamam log aur riwayat mein hai ke husn ke do hisse kiye gaye aik hisse mein Hazrat Yusuf aur aap ki walida Hazrat Sarah aur aik hisse mein duniya ke aur sab log. Suhaili mein hai ke aap ko Hazrat Adam ka aadha husn diya gaya tha. Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) ko apne haath se kamal soorat ka namuna banaya tha aur bahut hi haseen paida kiya tha. Aap ki aulad mein aap ka ham-pala koi nah tha aur Hazrat Yusuf ko un ka aadha husn diya gaya tha. Pas un aurton ne aap ko dekh kar hi kaha ke Ma'azAllah yeh insan nahi zi-izzat farishta hai. Ab Aziz ki biwi ne kaha batlao ab to tum mujhe uzr wali samjho gi? Is ka jamal-o-kamal kya aisa nahi ke sabr-o-bardasht chheen le? Main ne isay harchand apni taraf mail karna chaha lekin yeh mere qabze mein nahi aaya ab samajh lo ke jahan is mein yeh behtareen zahiri khoobi hai wahan ismat-o-iffat ki yeh batni khoobi bhi be-nazir hai. Phir dhamkane lagi ke agar meri baat yeh nah manega to isay qaid khana bhugatna padega. Aur main is ko bahut zaleel karungi. Us waqt Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ne un ke is dhong se Allah ki panah talib ki aur dua ki ke Ya Allah mujhe jeel khane jana pasand hai magar tu mujhe un ke bad-iradon se mehfooz rakh aisa nah ho ke main kisi burai mein phans jaun. Ae Allah tu agar mujhe bacha le tab to main bach sakta hoon warna mujh mein itni quwwat nahi. Mujhe apne kisi nafa nuqsan ka koi ikhtiyar nahi. Teri madad aur tere rahm-o-karam ke baghair nah main kisi gunah se ruk sakoon nah kisi neki ko kar sakoon. Ae Bari Ta'ala main tujh se madad talib karta hoon, tujhi par bharosa rakhta hoon. Tu mujhe mere nafs ke havale nah karde ke main un عورتوں ki taraf jhuk jaun aur jahilon mein se hojaun. Allah Ta'ala Kareem-o-Qadir ne aap ki dua qubool farma li aur aap ko baal-baal bacha liya, ismat-o-iffat ata farmai, apni hifazat mein rakha aur burai se aap bache hi rahe. Bajawud bharpoor jawani ke bajawud be-andaz husn-o-khoobi ke, bajawud har tarah ke kamal ke, jo aap mein tha, aap apni khwahish-e-nafs ki be-ja takmeel se bachte rahe. Aur us aurat ki taraf rukh bhi na kiya jo rais zadi hai. Rais ki biwi hai, un ki malik hai, phir bahut hi khubsoorat hai, jamal ke sath hi maal bhi hai, riyasat bhi hai, woh apni baat ke manne par inaam-o-ikram ka aur nah manne par jeel ka aur sakht saza ka hukum suna rahi hai.

Lekin aap ke dil mein Allah ke khauf ka samandar maujan hai, aap apne is duniyavi aaram ko aur is aish aur lazzat ko naam-e-Rabb par qurban karte hain aur qaid-o-band ko is par tarjeeh dete hain ki Allah ke azabon se bach jayen aur aakhirat mein sawab ke mustahiq ban jayen. Bukhari Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain saat qism ke log hain jinhein Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal apne saaye tale saya dega jis din koi saya siwa us ke saaye ke na hoga. 001 Musalman aadil badshah. 002 Woh jawan mard-o-aurat jis ne apni jawani Allah ki ibadat mein guzari. 003 Woh shakhs jis ka dil masjid mein atka hua ho jab masjid se nikle masjid ki dhun mein rahe yahan tak ki phir wahan jaye. 004 Woh do shakhs jo aapas mein mahz Allah ke liye mohabbat rakhte hain usi par jama hote hain aur usi par juda hote hain. 005 Woh shakhs jo sadqa deta hai lekin is poshidagi se ki dahine haath ke kharch ki khabar baayein haath ko nahi hoti. 006 Woh shakhs jise koi jah-o-mansab wali jamal-o-soorat wali aurat apni taraf bulaye aur woh keh de ki main Allah se darta hoon. 007 Woh shakhs jis ne tanhai mein Allah Ta'ala ko yaad kiya phir us ki dono aankhein beh nikli.

Us waqt Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ne un ke is dhong se Allah ki panah talib ki aur dua ki ke Ya Allah mujhe jeel khane jana pasand hai magar tu mujhe un ke bad-iradon se mehfooz rakh aisa nah ho ke main kisi burai mein phans jaun. Ae Allah tu agar mujhe bacha le tab to main bach sakta hoon warna mujh mein itni quwwat nahi. Mujhe apne kisi nafa nuqsan ka koi ikhtiyar nahi. Teri madad aur tere rahm-o-karam ke baghair nah main kisi gunah se ruk sakoon nah kisi neki ko kar sakoon. Ae Bari Ta'ala main tujh se madad talib karta hoon, tujhi par bharosa rakhta hoon. Tu mujhe mere nafs ke havale nah karde ke main un عورتوں ki taraf jhuk jaun aur jahilon mein se hojaun. Allah Ta'ala Kareem-o-Qadir ne aap ki dua qubool farma li aur aap ko baal-baal bacha liya, ismat-o-iffat ata farmai, apni hifazat mein rakha aur burai se aap bache hi rahe. Bajawud bharpoor jawani ke bajawud be-andaz husn-o-khoobi ke, bajawud har tarah ke kamal ke, jo aap mein tha, aap apni khwahish-e-nafs ki be-ja takmeel se bachte rahe. Aur us aurat ki taraf rukh bhi na kiya jo rais zadi hai. Rais ki biwi hai, un ki malik hai, phir bahut hi khubsoorat hai, jamal ke sath hi maal bhi hai, riyasat bhi hai, woh apni baat ke manne par inaam-o-ikram ka aur nah manne par jeel ka aur sakht saza ka hukum suna rahi hai.

Lekin aap ke dil mein Allah ke khauf ka samandar maujan hai, aap apne is duniyavi aaram ko aur is aish aur lazzat ko naam-e-Rabb par qurban karte hain aur qaid-o-band ko is par tarjeeh dete hain ki Allah ke azabon se bach jayen aur aakhirat mein sawab ke mustahiq ban jayen. Bukhari Muslim mein hai Rasool Allah (ﷺ) farmate hain saat qism ke log hain jinhein Allah Ta'ala Azzawajal apne saaye tale saya dega jis din koi saya siwa us ke saaye ke na hoga. 001 Musalman aadil badshah. 002 Woh jawan mard-o-aurat jis ne apni jawani Allah ki ibadat mein guzari. 003 Woh shakhs jis ka dil masjid mein atka hua ho jab masjid se nikle masjid ki dhun mein rahe yahan tak ki phir wahan jaye. 004 Woh do shakhs jo aapas mein mahz Allah ke liye mohabbat rakhte hain usi par jama hote hain aur usi par juda hote hain. 005 Woh shakhs jo sadqa deta hai lekin is poshidagi se ki dahine haath ke kharch ki khabar baayein haath ko nahi hoti. 006 Woh shakhs jise koi jah-o-mansab wali jamal-o-soorat wali aurat apni taraf bulaye aur woh keh de ki main Allah se darta hoon. 007 Woh shakhs jis ne tanhai mein Allah Ta'ala ko yaad kiya phir us ki dono aankhein beh nikli.

Dastan-e-Ishq aur Haseenan-e-Misr: Is dastan ki khabar shahar mein hui, charche hone lage, chand shareef-zadiyon ne nihayat taajjub aur haqarat se is qisse ko dohraya ke dekho Azeez ki biwi hai aur ek ghulam par jaan de rahi hai, iski mohabbat ko apne dil mein jamaye hue hai. Shaghaf kehte hain had se guzri hui qatil mohabbat ko aur shaghaf isse kam darje ki hoti hai. Dil ke pardo ko auratein shaghaf kehti hain. Kehte hain ke Azeez ki biwi sareeh ghalti mein padi hui hai. In ghibaton ka pata Azeez ki biwi ko bhi chal gaya. Yahan lafz makr isliye bola gaya hai ke biqaul-e-ba'z khud in auraton ka yeh fi-al-waqi ek khula makr tha. Unhein to darasal Husn-e-Yousuf ke deedar ki tamanna thi yeh to sirf ek hila banaya tha. Azeez ki biwi bhi inki chaal samajh gayi aur phir ismein usne apni mazouri ki maslihat bhi dekhi to unke paas usi waqt bulawa bhej diya ke falan waqt aap ki mere haan dawat hai. Aur ek majlis, mehfil, aur baithak durust karli jismein phal aur mewa bahut tha. Usne tarash tarash kar cheel cheel kar khane ke liye ek ek tez chaqu sab ke haath mein de diya, yeh tha un auraton ke dhokhe ka jawab, unhone aitraaz kar ke Jamal-e-Yousuf dekhna chaha, usne aap ko mazoor zahir karne aur unke makr ko zahir karne ke liye unhein khud zakhmi kar diya aur khud in hi ke haath se Hazrat Yousuf (Alaihis Salam) se kaha ke aap aayein. Unhein apni malkika ka hukum manne se kaise inkar ho sakta tha? Usi waqt jis kamre mein the wahan se aa gaye. Auraton ki nigah jo aap ke chehre par padi to sab ki sab dehshat-zada reh gayin. Haibat-o-Jalal aur rub-e-husn se beh-khud ho gayin aur bajaye iske ke in tez chalne wali chhuriyon se phal katte unke haath aur ungliyan katne lagein. Hazrat Zaid bin Aslam kehte hain ke ziyafat baqaida pehle ho chuki thi ab to sirf mewa se tawazo ho rahi thi. Mewe haath mein the, chaqu chal rahe the, jo usne kaha Yousuf ko dekhna chahti ho? Sab yak-zaban ho kar bol uthin haan haan zaroor. Usi waqt Hazrat Yousuf se kahlwa bheja ke tashreef layiye. Aap aaye phir usne kaha jaiye aap chale gaye. Aate jaate samne se peeche se in sab auraton ne poori tarah aap ko dekha dekhte hi sab saktay mein aa gayin hosh-hawas jate rahe bajaye leemoon kaatne ke apne haath kaat liye. Aur koi ehsas tak na hua, haan jab Hazrat Yousuf chale gaye tab hosh aaya aur takleef mehsoos hui. Tab pata chala ke bajaye phal ke haath kaat liya hai. Is par Azeez ki biwi ne kaha dekha ek hi martaba ke jamal ne to tumhe aisa az-khud rafta kar diya phir batao mera kya haal hoga. Auraton ne kaha Wallah yeh insan nahi. Yeh to farishta hai aur farishta bhi bade martabe wala. Aaj ke baad hum kabhi tumhein malamat na karengi. In auraton ne Hazrat Yousuf jaisa to kahan inke qareeb inke mushabeh bhi koi shakhs nahi dekha tha. Aap ko aadha husn Qudrat ne ata farma rakha tha. Chunacha Mairaj ki hadis mein hai ke teesre aasman mein Rasoolullah (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) ki mulaqat Hazrat Yousuf (Alaihis Salam) se hui jinhein aadha husn diya gaya tha.

Aur riwayat mein hai ke Hazrat Yusuf aur aap ki walida sahibah ko aadha husn qudrat ki fayaziyon ne inayat farmaya tha. Aur riwayat mein tihai husn Yusuf ko aur aap ki walida ko diya gaya tha. Aap ka chehra bijli ki tarah roshan tha. Jab kabhi koi aurat aap ke paas kisi kaam ke liye aati to aap apna munh dhak kar us se baat karte ke kahin woh fitne mein nah parjaye aur riwayat mein hai ke husn ke teen hisse kiye gaye tamam logon mein do hisse taqseem kiye gaye aur aik hissa sirf aap ko aur aap ki maa ko diya gaya. Ya jin ki do tehaiyan is maa bete ko milin aur aik tehai mein duniya ke tamam log aur riwayat mein hai ke husn ke do hisse kiye gaye aik hisse mein Hazrat Yusuf aur aap ki walida Hazrat Sarah aur aik hisse mein duniya ke aur sab log. Suhaili mein hai ke aap ko Hazrat Adam ka aadha husn diya gaya tha. Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Adam (Alaihis Salam) ko apne haath se kamal soorat ka namuna banaya tha aur bahut hi haseen paida kiya tha. Aap ki aulad mein aap ka ham-pala koi nah tha aur Hazrat Yusuf ko un ka aadha husn diya gaya tha. Pas un aurton ne aap ko dekh kar hi kaha ke Ma'azAllah yeh insan nahi zi-izzat farishta hai. Jail Khana aur Yusuf (A.S):
Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ki paak-damni ka raaz sab par khul gaya. Lekin taham un logon ne maslahat usi mein dekhi ke kuch muddat tak Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ko jail khane mein rakhein. Bahut mumkin hai ke is mein un sab ne yeh maslahat sochi ho ke logon mein yeh baat phail gayi hai ke Aziz ki biwi is ki chahat mein mubtala hai. Jab hum Yusuf ko qaid kar denge woh log samajh lenge ke qasoor usi ka tha usi ne koi aisi nigaah ki hogi. Yahi wajah thi ke jab Shah-e-Misr ne aap ko qaid khane se aazad karne ke liye apne paas bulwaya toh aap ne wahin se farmaya ke main na nikalunga jab tak meri baraat aur meri paak-damni saaf taur par zahir na hojaye aur aap hazraat is ki poori tehqeeq na kar lein jab tak Badshah ne har tarah ke gawah se balkeh khud Aziz ki biwi se poori tehqeeq na kar li aur aap ka be-qusoor hona, sari duniya par khul na gaya aap jail khane se baahar na nikle. Phir aap baahar aaye jab ke ek dil bhi aisa na tha jis mein Siddique-e-Akbar, Nabi-ullah paak-daman aur maasoom Rasul-ullah Hazrat Yusuf Alaihis Salatu Wassalam ki taraf se zara bhi bad-gumani ho. Qaid karne ki badi wajah yahi thi ke Aziz ki biwi ki ruswai na ho.

Jail khane mein Badshah ke bawarchi aur saqi se mulaqat. Ittefaq se jis roz Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ko jail khana jana pada, usi din Badshah ka saqi aur nan-bai bhi kisi jurm mein jail khane bhej diye gaye. Saqi ka naam Bendar tha aur bawarchi ka naam Buhlas tha. Un par ilzaam yeh tha ke unhon ne khane peene mein Badshah ko zehar dene ki saazish ki thi. Qaid khane mein bhi Nabi-ullah Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ki nekiyon ki kaafi shohrat thi. Sachai, amanat-dari, sakhawat, khush-khulqi, kasrat-e-ibadat, Allah-tarsi, ilm-o-amal, tabeer-e-khwab, ehsan-o-sulook waghera mein aap mashhoor ho gaye the. Jail khane ke qaidiyon ki bhalai, un ki khair-khwahi, un se maruwat-o-sulook, un ke sath bhalai aur ehsan, un ki dil-jooi aur dil-dari, un ke bemaron ki teemardari, khidmat aur dawa-daru bhi aap ka tashakhkhus tha. Yeh dono hi mulazim Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) se bahut hi mohabbat karne lage. Ek din kahne lage ke Hazrat humein aap se bahut hi mohabbat ho gayi hai. Aap ne farmaya Allah tumhein barkat de. Baat yeh hai ke mujhe to jis ne chaha koi na koi aafat hi mujh par laya. Phuphi ki mohabbat, baap ka pyar, azeez ki biwi ki chahat, sab mujhe yaad hai. Aur is ka nateeja meri hi nahi balki tumhari ankhon ke samne hai. Ab dono ne ek martaba khwab dekha. Saqi ne dekha ke woh angoor ka sheera nichod raha hai. Ibn Masood ki qirat mein khumra ke badle lafz anba hai, ahl-e-Oman angoor ko khamar kahte hain. Us ne dekha tha ke goya us ne angoor ki bail boyi hai, us mein khushe lage hain, us ne tode hain. Phir un ka sheera nichod raha hai ke Badshah ko pilaye. Yeh khwab bayan kar ke aarzu ki ke aap humein is ki tabeer batlaiye. Allah ke paighambar ne farmaya is ki tabeer yeh hai ke tumhein teen din ke baad jail khane se azad kar diya jayega aur tum apne kaam par yani Badshah ki saqi-gari mein lag jaoge. Doosre ne kaha janab maine khwab dekha hai ke main sar par roti uthaye huwe hoon aur parind-he aa aa kar is mein se kha rahe hain. Aksar mufassireen ke nazdeek mashhoor baat to yahi hai ke waqia un dono ne yahi khwab dekhe the aur un ki sahi tabeer Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) se daryaft ki thi. Lekin Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) se marwi hai ke dar-haqeeqat unhon ne koi khwab to nahi dekha tha. Lekin Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ki azmaish ke liye jhoote khwab bayan kar ke tabeer talab ki thi.

Jail khane mein khwabon ki tabeer ka silsila aur tabligh-e-tauhid

Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) apne dono qaidi sathiyon ko taskeen dete hain ke main tumhare dono khwabon ki sahi tabeer janta hoon aur iske batane mein mujhe koi bukhl nahi. Iske tabeer ke waqe hone se pehle hi main tumhe woh bata doon ga. Hazrat Yusuf ke is farman aur is wade se toh yeh zahir aisa maloom hota hai ke Hazrat Yusuf, tanhai ki qaid mein the, khane ke waqt khol diya jata tha aur ek dusre se mil sakte the isliye aap ne in se yeh wada kiya aur mumkin hai ke Allah ki taraf se thori thori kar ke dono khwabon ki puri tabeer batlai gayi ho. Ibn Abbas se yeh asar marwi hai go bahut gharib hai. 

Phir farmate hain mujhe yeh ilm Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se ata farma gaya hai. Woh yeh hai ke main ne in kafiron ka mazhab chor rakha hai jo na Allah ko manein na akhirat ko barhaq janein, main ne Allah ke paigambaron ke sachhe deen ko maan rakha hai aur usi ki tabadari karta hoon. Khud mere baap dada Allah ke rasool the: Ibrahim, Ishaq, Yaqub alaihis salatu wassalam. 

Fi-al-waqia jo bhi rah-e-rast par istiqamat se chale, hidayat ka piro rahe, Allah ke rasoolon ki itbaa ko lazim pakar le, gumraahon ki rah se munh pher le, Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala iske dil ko purnoor aur iske sene ko mamoor kar deta hai, isey ilm-o-irfan ki daulat se mala mal kar deta hai, isey bhulai mein logon ka peshwa kar deta hai ke aur duniya ko woh neki ki taraf bulata rehta hai. 

Hum jab ke rah-e-rast dikha diye gaye, tauhid ki samajh de diye gaye, shirk ki burai bata diye gaye, phir humein kaise yeh baat zeb deti hai ke hum Allah ke sath aur kisi ko bhi sharik kar lein? Yeh tauhid aur sachha deen aur yeh Allah ki wahdaniyat ki gawahi yeh khas Allah ka fazal hai jis mein hum tanha nahi balki Allah ki aur makhlooq bhi shamil hai. Haan, humein yeh bartari hai ke hamari janib yeh bar

Shahi Bawarchi aur Saqi ke Khwab ki Tabeer aur Paigham-e-Tauhid.

Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) se woh apne khwab ki tabeer poochne aaye hain. Aap ne unhe tabeer-e-khwab bata dene ka ikraar kar liya hai. Lekin is se pehle unhe tauhid ka wa'z suna rahe hain aur shirk se aur makhlooq-parasti se nafrat dila rahe hain. Farma rahe hain ki woh Allah wahid jis ne har cheez par qabza kar rakha hai, jis ke samne tamam makhlooq past-o-aajiz, lachar, be-bas hai. Jis ka sani, shareek aur sajhi koi nahi. Jis ki azmat-o-saltanat chappay chappay aur zarray zarray par hai, wohi aik behtar? Ya tumhare yeh khyali, kamzor aur nakaray bohat se mabood behtar? 

Phir farmaya ke tum jin jin ki pooja paat kar rahe ho, be-sanad hain. Yeh naam aur un ke liye ibadat yeh tumhari apni ghaddat hai. Zyada se zyada tum yeh keh sakte ho ke tumhare baap-daday bhi is marz ke mareez thay. Lekin koi daleel is ki tum la nahi sakte, balki is ki koi aqli daleel duniya mein Allah ne banai nahi. Hukm, tasarruf, qabza, qudrat, kul ki kul Allah Ta'ala hi ki hai. Us ne apne bando ko apni ibadat ka aur apne siwa kisi aur ki ibadat karne se baaz aane ka qatai aur hatmi hukm de rakha hai. Deen-e-Mustaqeem yehi hai ke Allah ki tauhid ho, us ke liye hi amal-o-ibadat ho. Isi Allah ka hukm, is par beshumar daleelin maujood hain. Lekin aksar log in baaton se na-waqif hain. Nadaan hain, tauhid-o-shirk ka farq nahi jaante. Is liye aksar shak ke daldal mein dhunsay rehte hain. Bawajood nabiyon ki chahat ke unhe yeh mansab nahi hota. 

Khwab ki tabeer se pehle is behs ke chehray ki aik khas maslihat yeh bhi thi ke un mein se aik ke liye tabeer nihayat buri thi, to aap ne chaha ke yeh use na poochein to behtar hai. Lekin is takalluf ki kya zaroorat hai? Khusoosan aise mauqe par jab ke Allah ke paighambar un se tabeer dene ka waada kar chuke hain. Yahan to sirf yeh baat hai ke unhone aap ki buzurgi-o-izzat dekh kar aap se aik baat poochhi. Aap ne is ke jawab se pehle unhe is se zyada behtar ki taraf tawajju dilai, aur Deen-e-Islam un ke samne ma-dalail pesh farmaya. Kyunke aap ne dekha tha ke un mein bhalai ke qubool karne ka mada hai. Baat ko sochenge. Jab aap apna farz ada kar chuke, ahkaam-e-Allah ki tabligh kar chuke, to ab baghair is ke ke woh dobara poochein, aap ne un ka jawab shuru kiya.

Khwab aur us ki ta'beer. Ab Allah ke barguzida paighambar un ke khwab ki ta'beer batla rahe hain lekin yeh nahi farmate ke téri khwab ki yeh ta'beer hai aur teray khwab ki yeh ta'beer hai taake aik ranjida na ho jaye aur maut se pehle us par maut ka bojh na par jaye. Balki mubham kar ke farmate hain tum do mein se aik to apne badshah ka saqi ban jaye ga yeh darasal yeh us ke khwab ki ta'beer hai jis ne shira-e-angoor tayyar karte apne tain dekha tha. Aur doosre jis ne apne sar par rotiyan dekhi thin. Us ke khwab ki ta'beer yeh di ke use sooli di jaye gi aur parindey us ka maghz khayenge. Phir sath hi farmaya ke yeh ab ho kar hi rahe ga. Is liye ke jab tak khwab ki ta'beer bayan na ki jaye woh mo'allaq rehta hai aur jab ta'beer ho chuki woh zahir ho jata hai. Kehte hain ke ta'beer sunne ke baad un dono ne kaha ke hum ne to darasal koi khwab dekha hi nahi. Aap ne farmaya ab to tumhare sawal ke mutabiq zahir ho kar hi rahe ga. Is se zahir hai ke jo shakhs khwah makhwah ka khwab ghar le aur phir us ki ta'beer bhi de di jaye to woh lazim ho jati hai. Wallahu A'lam. Musnad Ahmad mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain khwab goya parindey ke paon par hai jab tak us ki ta'beer na de di jaye jab ta'beer de di gayi phir woh waqi ho jata hai. Musnad Abu Ya'la mein marfoo'an marwi hai ke khwab ki ta'beer sab se pehle jis ne di us ke liye hai.

Ta'beer bata kar baadshah-e-waqt ko apni yaad-dahani ki تاکید jise Hazrat Yusuf ne uske khwab ki ta'beer ke mutabiq apne khayal mein jail khane se azad hone wala samjha tha us se dar-parda alag-i mein ke woh doosra yani bawarchi na sune farmaya ke baadshah ke samne zara mera zikr bhi kardena. Lekin yeh is baat ko bilkul hi bhool gaya. Yeh bhi ek shaitani chaal hi thi jis se Nabi Allah Alaihis Salam kayi saal tak qaid khane mein hi rahe. Pas theek qool yahi hai ke fa-ansahu mein ha ki zameer ka marja' nijat pane wala shakhs hi hai. Goya yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh zameer Hazrat Yusuf ki taraf phirti hai. Ibn Abbas se marfoo'an marwi hai ke Nabi Allah ﷺ ne farmaya agar Yusuf yeh kalma na kehte toh jail khane mein itni lambi muddat na guzaarte. Unhon ne Allah Ta'ala ke siva aur se kushaadgi chaahi. Yeh riwayat bahut hi zaeef hai. Is liye ke Sufiyan bin Wakee' aur Ibrahim bin Yazeed dono raawi zaeef hain. Hasan aur Qatadah se mursalan marwi hai. Go mursal hadeesein kisi mauqe par qabil-e-qubool bhi hon lekin aise aham muqamat par aisi mursal riwayatein hargiz ehtijaj ke qabil nahi hosakti hain Wallahu A'lam.

Bid' lafz teen se nau tak ke liye aata hai. Hazrat Wahab bin Munabbih ka bayan hai ke Hazrat Aiyub be-maari mein saat saal tak mubtala rahe aur Hazrat Yusuf qaid khane mein saat saal tak rahe aur Bakht Nassar ka azab bhi saat saal tak raha. Ibn Abbas kehte hain muddat-e-qaid barah saal thi. Zahhak kehte hain chaudah baras aap ne qaid khane mein guzaare.

Shah-e-Misr ka khawab aur talash-e-ta'beer mein Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) tak rasai:

Qudrat-e-Ilahi ne yeh muqarrar rakha tha ke Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) qaid-khanay se ba-izzat-o-ikram, pakeezgi, baraat aur ismat ke sath niklein. Iske liye qudrati yeh sabab banaya ke Shah-e-Misr ne aik khawab dekha jis se bhonchka sa ho gaya. Darbaar munaqiq kiya aur tamam umra, rusa, kahin, munajjim aur ulama ko khawab ki ta'beer bayaan karne walon ko jama kiya. Aur apna khawab bayaan kar ke in sab se ta'beer daryaft ki. Lekin kisi ki samajh mein kuch na aya. Aur sab ne lachar ho kar yeh keh kar taal diya ke yeh koi ba-qaida laiq-e-ta'beer sacha khawab nahi jis ki ta'beer ho sakay. Yeh to yunhi pareshan khawab, makhloot khayalat aur fazool tauhmat ka khaka hai. Iski ta'beer hum nahi jante.

Us waqt shahi saqi ko Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) yaad aa gaye ke woh ta'beer-e-khawab ke pooray mahir hain. Is ilm mein inko kafi maharat hai. Yeh wohi shakhs hai jo Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ke sath jail-khana bhugat raha tha, yeh bhi aur iska aik aur sathi bhi. Isi se Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ne kaha tha ke badshah ke paas mera zikr bhi karna. Lekin isay shaitan ne bhula diya tha. Aaj muddat-e-madeed ke baad isay yaad aa gaya aur isne sab ke samne kaha ke agar aapko iski ta'beer sunne ka shoq hai aur woh bhi sahih ta'beer to mujhe ijazat do. Yusuf Siddique (Alaihis Salam) jo qaid-khanay mein hain, unke paas jaun aur un se daryaft kar aaoon. Aap ne isay manzoor kiya aur isay Allah ke muharram Nabi (Alaihis Salam - *Note: Ibne Mas'ood/Saaqi context*) ke paas bheja. 

Imtah ki doosri qirat 'umtah' bhi hai. Iske ma'yani bhool ke hain. Yaani bhool jaane ke baad isay Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ka farman yaad aya. Darbaar se ijazat le kar yeh chala. Qaid-khanay pahunch kar Allah ke Nabi Ibne Nabi Ibne Nabi Ibne Nabi (Alaihis Salam) se kaha ke ay nire sachay Yusuf (Alaihis Salam)! Badshah ne is tarah ka aik khawab dekha hai. Isay ta'beer ka ishtiyaq hai. Tamam darbaar bhara hua hai. Sab ki nigahein lagi hui hain. Aap mujhe ta'beer batla dein to mein ja kar unhein sunaoon aur sab maloom kar lein.

Aap ne na to isay koi malamat ki ke tu ab tak mujhe bholay raha, bawajood mere kehne ke, tu ne aaj tak badshah se mera zikr bhi na kiya. Na is amr ki darkhwast ki ke mujhe jail-khane se azad kiya jaye, balki baghair kisi tamna ke izhar ke, baghair kisi ilzaam dene ke, khawab ki poori ta'beer suna di aur sath hi tadbeer bhi bata di.

Farmaya ke saat farba gayon se murad yeh hai ke saat saal tak barabar hajat ke mutabiq barish barasti rahegi. Khoob tarsali hogi. Ghalla, khet, baghat khoob phaleinge. Yahi murad saat hari baliyon se hai. Gaye bail hi halon mein jutte hain, un se zameen par kheti ki jati hai. Ab tarkib bhi bata di ke in saat barson mein jo anaj ghalla nikle, isay ba-taur zakhray ke jama kar lena aur rakhna bhi balon aur khushon samet taake sare-gale nahi, kharab na hon. Haan apni khane ki zaroorat ke mutabiq is mein se le lena. Lekin khyal rahe ke zara sa bhi ziyada na liya jaye sirf hajat ke mutabiq hi nikala jaye.

In saat barson ke guzarte hi ab jo qaht-saliyan shuru hongi woh barabar saat saal tak mutatir rahengi. Na barish barsegi na paidawar hogi. Yahi murad hai saat dubli gayon aur saat khushk khushon se hai ke in saat barson mein woh jama-shuda zakhira tum khate peete raho ge. Yaad rakhna in mein koi ghalla kheti na hogi. Woh jama-karda zakhira hi kaam aayega. Tum daane boyo ge lekin paidawar kuch bhi na hogi. Aap ne khwab ki poori tabeer dekar sath hi yeh khushkhabri bhi suna di ke in saat khushk-saliyon ke baad jo saal aayega woh bari barkaton wala hoga. Khoob barishein barsegi khoob ghalle aur khetiyan hongi. Rail-peel hojayegi aur tangi door hojayegi aur log hasb-e-adat zaitoon waghera ka tel nikalenge aur hasb-e-adat angoor ka shira nichorenge. Aur janwaroon ke than doodh se labrez hojayenge ke khoob doodh nikalein piyein.
