Woh jama-karda zakhira hi kaam aayega. Tum daane boyo ge lekin paidawar kuch bhi na hogi. Aap ne khwab ki poori tabeer dekar sath hi yeh khushkhabri bhi suna di ke in saat khushk-saliyon ke baad jo saal aayega woh bari barkaton wala hoga. Khoob barishein barsegi khoob ghalle aur khetiyan hongi. Rail-peel hojayegi aur tangi door hojayegi aur log hasb-e-adat zaitoon waghera ka tel nikalenge aur hasb-e-adat angoor ka shira nichorenge. Aur janwaroon ke than doodh se labrez hojayenge ke khoob doodh nikalein piyein.

Ta'beer ki Sadaqat aur Shah-e-Misr ka Yusuf (A.S) ko Wizarat saunpna. 

Khwab ki ta'beer maloom kar ke jab qasid palta aur us ne badshah ko tamam haqeeqat se muttala kiya, to badshah ko apne khwab ki ta'beer par yaqeen aagaya. Saath hi ise bhi maloom hogaya ke Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) bare hi alim o fazil shakhs hain. Khwab ki ta'beer mein to aap ko kamal hasil hai, saath hi aala akhlaq wale, husn-e-tadbeer wale aur khalq-e-khuda ka nafa chahne wale aur mahz be-tama' shakhs hain. Ab ise shauq huwa ke khud aap se mulaqat kare. Isi waqt hukum diya ke jao Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ko jail khane se aazad kar ke mere paas le aao. Dobara qasid aap ke paas aaya aur badshah ka paigham pahunchaya to aap ne farmaya: Main yahan se na nikalunga jab tak ke Shah-e-Misr aur uske darbari aur Ahl-e-Misr yeh na maloom kar lein ke mera qusoor kya tha? Aziz ki biwi ki nisbat jo baat mujh se mansoob ki gayi hai is mein sach kahan tak hai? Ab tak mera qaid-khana bhugatna waqiatan kisi haqeeqat ki bina par tha? Ya sirf zulm o ziyadti ki bina par? Tum apne badshah ke paas wapas ja kar mera yeh paigham pahunchao ke woh is waqie ki poori tehqeeq karein. 

Hadith-e-Sharif mein bhi Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke is sabr ki aur aap ki is sharafat o fazilat ki taarif aayi hai. Bukhari o Muslim waghera mein hai, Rasulullah (ﷺ) farmate hain ke shak ke haqdar hum ba-nisbat Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) ke baabat ziyada hain jab ke unhon ne farmaya tha: "Mere Rab mujhe apna murdon ka zinda karna ma-kaifiyat dikha" (yaani jab hum Allah ki is qudrat mein shak nahi karte to Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) jaleel-ul-qadr paighambar kaise shak kar sakte the? Pas aap ki yeh talab az-roe-mazeed itminan ke thi na ke az-roe-shak. Chunancha khud Quran mein hai ke aap ne farmaya: Yeh mere itminan-e-dil ke liye hai). Allah Hazrat Lut (A.S) par raham kare, woh kisi zor-awar jamaat ya mazboot qila ki panah mein aana chahne lage. Aur suno! Agar main Yusuf (A.S) ke barabar jail-khana bhugte hue hota aur phir qasid meri rihai ka paigham lata, to main to isi waqt jail khane se aazadi manzoor kar leta. 

Musnad Ahmad mein isi ayat-e-fazila ki tafseer mein manqool hai ke Rasulullah (ﷺ) ne farmaya: Agar main hota to isi waqt qasid ki baat maan leta aur koi uzr talash na karta. 

Musnad Abdur Razzaq mein hai, aap farmate hain: Wallah! Mujhe Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke sabr-o-karam par rah rah kar taajjub aata hai, Allah use bakhshe! Dekho to sahi, badshah ne khwab dekha hai, woh ta'beer ke liye muztarib hai, qasid aakar aap se ta'beer poochta hai, aap foran baghair kisi shart ke bata dete hain. Agar main hota to jab tak jail-khane se apni rihai na kara leta hargaz na batlata. Mujhe Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke sabr-o-karam par taajjub maloom ho raha hai. Allah unhein bakhshe ke jab un ke paas qasid un ki rihai ka paigham lekar pahunchta hai to aap farmate hain: Abhi nahi, jab tak ke meri pakeezgi, pak-damani aur be-qusoori sab par tehqeeq se khul na jaye. Agar main un ki jagah hota to main to daud kar darwaze par pahunchta. Yeh riwayat Mursal hai.

Ab baadshah ne tehqeeq karni shuru ki un aurton ko jinhein Aziz ki biwi ne apne haan dawat par jama kiya tha aur khud use bhi darbaar mein bulaya. Phir उन tamam aurton se pucha ke ziyafat wale din kya guzri thi? Sab bayan karo. Unho ne jawab diya ke Masha'Allah Yusuf par koi ilzaam nahi is par bes-o-pa تہمت hai. Wallah hum khoob jaanti hain ke Yusuf mein koi badi nahi is waqt Aziz ki biwi khud bhi bol uthi ke ab haq zahir ho gaya waqiya khul gaya. Haqeeqat nikhhar aayi mujhe khud is amr ka ikraar hai. Ke waqai maine hi use phansana chaha tha. Us ne jo barwaqt kaha tha ke yeh aurat mujhe phsala rahi thi is mein woh bilkul sacha hai. Main is ka ikraar karti hoon aur apna qusoor aap bayan karti hoon taake mere khawand yeh baat bhi jaan lein ke maine us ki koi khayanat darasal nahi ki. Yusuf ki paakdamni ki wajah se koi shar aur burai mujh se zahoor mein nahi aayi. Badkaari se Allah Ta'ala ne mujhe bachaye rakha. Meri is ikraar se aur waqiye ke khul jaane se saaf zahir hai aur mere khawand jaan sakte hain ke main burai mein mubtala nahi hui. Yeh bilkul sach hai ke khayanat karne walon ki makariyon ko Allah Ta'ala farogh nahi deta. Un ki dagha baazi koi phal nahi laati. Alhamdulillah Allah Ta'ala ke fazl-o-karam aur us ke lutf-o-rahm se barwein paare ki tafseer khatam hui Allah Ta'ala qabool farmaye. Ameen.

Aziz-e-Misr ki biwi keh rahi hai ki main apni pakeezgi bayaan nahi kar rahi, apne aap ko nahi sarahti. Nafs-e-insani tamannaon aur buri baaton ka makhzan hai. Ismein aise jazbaat aur shauq uchalte rehte hain. Woh buraiyon par ubharta rehta hai. Usi ke phande mein phans kar maine Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ko apni taraf mail karna chaha. Magar jise Allah chahe nafs ki burai se mehfooz rakh leta hai. Is liye ki Allah bada Ghafoor-o-Raheem hai. Bakhshish karna, maafi dena uski abdi aur lazmi sifat hai. Yeh qaul Aziz-e-Misr ki aurat ka hi hai. Yehi baat mashhoor hai aur zyada laaiq hai aur waqie ke bayaan se bhi zyada munasib hai. Aur kalaam ke maani ke sath bhi zyada muwafiq hai. Amma Mawardi (R.H) ne apni tafseer mein ise waarid kiya hai. Aur Allama Abul Abbas Hazrat Imam Ibn Taymiyyah (R.H) ne to ise ek mustaqil tasneef mein bayaan farmaya hai aur iski poori taaeed ki hai. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ki yeh qaul Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ka hai. "Liyalam" se is doosri aayat ke khatam tak unhi ka farmaan hai. Ibn Jareer aur Ibn Abi Hatim ne to sirf yehi ek qaul naqal kiya hai. Chunacha Ibn Jareer mein Ibn Abbas (R.A) se marwi hai ki baadshah ne auraton ko jama kar ke jab unse poocha ki kya tumne Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ko behlaya phuslaya tha? To unho ne jawab diya ki Hashallah, humne ismein koi burai nahi dekhi. Us waqt Aziz-e-Misr ki biwi ne iqraar kiya ki waaqi haq to yehi hai. To Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ne farmaya, yeh sab is liye tha ki meri amanat-o-diyanat ka yaqeen ho jaye. Hazrat Jibrail (A.S) ne aap se farmaya, woh din bhi yaad hai? Ke aap ne kuch irada kar liya tha? Tab aap ne farmaya, main apne nafs ki baraat to nahi kar raha? Beshak nafs buraiyon ka hukum deta hai. Al-Gharz ek qaul yeh bhi hai ki yeh kalaam Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ka hai. Lekin pehla qaul yaani is kalaam ka Aziz ki biwi ka kalaam hona hi zyada qawi aur zyada zahir hai. Is liye ki ooper se unhi ka kalaam chala aa raha hai jo baadshah ke samne sab ki maujoodgi mein ho raha tha. Us waqt to Hazrat Yusuf Alaihis Salam wahan maujood hi na the. Is tamam qisse ke khul jaane ke baad baadshah ne aap ko bulwaya.

Jab Badshah ke samne Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ki beganahi khul gayi toh khush ho kar kaha ke unhein mere paas bula lao ke main unhein apne khaas musheeron mein karloon. Chunache aap tashreef laaye. Jab woh aap se mila, aap ki soorat dekhi. Aap ki baatein sakeen, aap ke akhlaq dekhe toh dil se girweda hogaya aur besakhta uski zuban se nikal gaya ke aaj se aap hamare haan moazzaz aur motabar hain. Us waqt aap ne ek khidmat apne liye pasand farmaee aur uski ahleeyat zahir ki. Insan ko yeh jaiz bhi hai ke jab woh anjaan logon mein ho toh apni qabiliyat boqt-e-zaroorat bayaan kar de. Us khawab ki bina par jis ki tabeer aap ne di thi. Aap ne yehi aarzu ki ki zameen ki paidawar ghalla waghaira jo jama kiya jata hai us par mujhe muqarrar kiya jaye taake main muhafizat karoon neez apne ilm ke mutabiq amal kar sakoon taake riaaya ko qaht-e-sali ki museebat ke waqt qadre aafiyat mil sake. Badshah ke dil par toh aap ki amanat-dari, sachai, saleeqa-mandi aur kamil ilm ka sikka baith chuka tha usi waqt us ne is darkhwast ko manzoor karliya.

Zameen-e-Misr mein yun Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ki taraqqi hui. Ab unke ikhtiyar mein tha ki jis tarah chahein tasarruf karein. Jahan chahein makanat tameer karein. Ya is tanhai aur qaid ko dekhiye ya ab is ikhtiyar aur azadi ko dekhiye. Sach hai Rab jise chahein apni Rahmat ka jitna hissa chahein de. Sabiron ka phal la kar hi rehta hai. Bhaiyon ka dukh saha, Allah ki na-safarmani se bachne ke liye Aziz-e-Misr ki aurat se bigaad li aur qaid-khane ki museebatein bardasht kiin. Pas Rahmat-e-Ilahi ka haath badha aur sabr ka ajr mila. Nek-karon ki nekiyan kabhi zaye nahi jaatein. Phir aise ba-iman taqwa wale akhirat mein bade darje aur aala sawab pate hain. Yahan yeh mila, wahan ke milne ki to kuch na poochhiye. Hazrat Sulaiman (A.S) ke bare mein bhi Quran mein aya hai ki yeh duniya ki daulat-o-sultanat hum ne tujhe apne ehsan se di hai aur Qayamat ke din bhi tere liye hamare haan achhi mehmani hai. Uske baad jab aam qaht-sali shuru hui aur log ek ek daane ko tarsne lage toh Aap ne mohtajon ko dena shuru kiya, yeh qaht ilaqa-e-Misr se nikal kar Kanaan waghera shahron mein bhi phail gaya tha. Aap har beroni shakhsh ko oont bhar kar ghalla ata farmaya karte the. Aur khud Aap ka lashkar balke khud badshah bhi din bhar mein sirf ek hi martaba dopehar ke waqt ek aadh niwala kha lete the aur ahl-e-Misr ko pet bhar kar khilate the, pas us zamane mein yeh baat ek rahmat-e-Rab thi. 

Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Aap ne pehle saal maal ke badle ghalla becha. Doosre saal saaman-o-asbab ke badle, teesre saal bhi aur chauthe saal bhi. Phir khud logon ki jaan aur unki aulad ke badle. Pas khud log, unke bachche aur unki kul malkiyat aur maal ke Aap malik ban gaye. Lekin uske baad Aap ne sab ko azad kar diya aur unke maal bhi unke hawale kar diye. Yeh riwayat Bani Israel ki hai jise hum sach jhoot nahi keh sakte. 

Yahan yeh bayan ho raha hai ke in aane walon mein baradaran-e-Yusuf bhi the. Jo baap ke hukum se aaye the. Unhe maloom hua tha ke Aziz-e-Misr maal-e-mata' ke badle ghalla dete hain, toh Aap ne apne das beton ko yahan bheja aur Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ke sagey bhai Binyamin ko, jo Aap ke baad Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ke nazdeek bahut hi pyare the, apne paas rok liya. Jab yeh qafila Allah ke Nabi (Alaihis Salam) ke paas pahuncha toh Aap ne toh ek hi nigah mein sab ko pehchan liya lekin unmein se ek bhi Aap ko na pehchan saka. Isliye ke Aap unse bachpan hi mein juda ho gaye the. Bhaiyon ne Aap ko saudagaron ke hath bech dala tha, unhe kya khabar thi ke phir kya hua. Aur yeh toh zehen mein bhi na aa sakta tha ke woh bachcha jise bahisiyat-e-ghulam becha tha, aaj wahi Aziz-e-Misr ban kar baitha hai. 

Idhar Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ne tarz-e-guftugu bhi aisa ikhtiyar kiya ke unhe wehm bhi na ho. Unse poocha ke tum log mere mulk mein kaise aa gaye? Unhone kaha yeh sun kar ke Aap ghalla ata farmate hain. Aap ne farmaya mujhe toh shak hota hai ke kahin tum jasoos na ho? Unhone kaha Ma'azAllah hum jasoos nahi. Farmaya tum rehne wale kahan ke ho? Kaha Kanaan ke aur hamare walid sahab ka naam Yaqub Nabiullah hai. Aap ne poocha tumhare siwa unke aur larke bhi hain? Unhone kaha haan hum barah bhai the. Hum mein jo sab se chhota tha aur hamare baap ki aankhon ka tara tha, woh toh halak ho gaya. Usi ka ek bhai aur hai, use baap ne hamare sath nahi bheja balke apne paas hi rok liya hai ke isse zara Aap ko itminan aur tasalli rahe. 

In baaton ke baad Aap ne hukum diya ki unhe sarkari mehman samjha jaye aur har tarah khatir-madarat ki jaye aur achchi jagah thehraya jaye.

Ab jab unhein ghalla diya jane laga aur un thaliye bhar diye gaye aur jitne janwar un ke sath thay woh jitna ghalla utha sakte thay bhar diya toh farmaya dekho apni sadaqat ke izhar ke liye apne us bhai ko jise tum is martaba apne sath na laye ab agar ao toh lete ana dekho main ne tum se acha sulook kiya hai aur tumhari bari khatir tawazi ki hai is tarah raghbat dila kar phir dhamka bhi diya ki agar dobara ke ane mein use sath na laye toh main tumhe ek dana anaj ka na dunga balki tumhe apne nazeeq bhi na ane dunga. Unhon ne wade kiye ki hum unhein keh sun kar lalach dikha kar har tarah poori koshish karenge ki apne us bhai ko bhi layein taaki badshah ke samhain hum jhoote na padein. Sudi R.H toh kehte hain ki ap ne toh un se rahan rakh liya ki jab lao ge toh yeh pao ge. Lekin yeh baat kuch ji ko lagti nahi is liye ki ap ne toh unhein wapsi ki bari raghbat dilai aur bohat kuch tamna zahir ki. Jab bhai koch ki taiyariyan karne lage toh Hazrat Yusuf A.S ne apne chalak chakron se ishara kiya ki jo asbab yeh laye thay aur jis ke awaz unhon ne hum se ghalla liya hai woh unhein wapas kar do lekin is khubsurati se ki unhein maloom tak na ho. Un ke kajawon aur boron mein un ki tamam cheezein rakh do. Mumkin hai is ki wajah yeh ho ke ap ko khayal hua ho ke ab ghar mein kya hoga jise le kar yeh ghalla lene ke liye ayen. Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke ap ne apne baap aur bhai se anaj ka kuch muwawza lena munasib na samjha ho aur yeh bhi qareen-e-qiyas hai ke ap ne yeh khayal farmaya ho ke jab yeh apna asbab kholenge aur yeh cheezein is mein payenge toh zaroori hai ki hamari yeh cheezein humein wapas dene ko ayen toh is bahane hi bhai se mulaqat ho jayegi.

Usi ka ek bhai aur hai, use baap ne hamare sath nahi bheja balke apne paas hi rok liya hai ke isse zara Aap ko itminan aur tasalli rahe. 

In baaton ke baad Aap ne hukum diya ki unhe sarkari mehman samjha jaye aur har tarah khatir-madarat ki jaye aur achchi jagah thehraya jaye.

Ab jab unhein ghalla diya jane laga aur un thaliye bhar diye gaye aur jitne janwar un ke sath thay woh jitna ghalla utha sakte thay bhar diya toh farmaya dekho apni sadaqat ke izhar ke liye apne us bhai ko jise tum is martaba apne sath na laye ab agar ao toh lete ana dekho main ne tum se acha sulook kiya hai aur tumhari bari khatir tawazi ki hai is tarah raghbat dila kar phir dhamka bhi diya ki agar dobara ke ane mein use sath na laye toh main tumhe ek dana anaj ka na dunga balki tumhe apne nazeeq bhi na ane dunga. Unhon ne wade kiye ki hum unhein keh sun kar lalach dikha kar har tarah poori koshish karenge ki apne us bhai ko bhi layein taaki badshah ke samhain hum jhoote na padein. Sudi R.H toh kehte hain ki ap ne toh un se rahan rakh liya ki jab lao ge toh yeh pao ge. Lekin yeh baat kuch ji ko lagti nahi is liye ki ap ne toh unhein wapsi ki bari raghbat dilai aur bohat kuch tamna zahir ki. Jab bhai koch ki taiyariyan karne lage toh Hazrat Yusuf A.S ne apne chalak chakron se ishara kiya ki jo asbab yeh laye thay aur jis ke awaz unhon ne hum se ghalla liya hai woh unhein wapas kar do lekin is khubsurati se ki unhein maloom tak na ho. Un ke kajawon aur boron mein un ki tamam cheezein rakh do. Mumkin hai is ki wajah yeh ho ke ap ko khayal hua ho ke ab ghar mein kya hoga jise le kar yeh ghalla lene ke liye ayen. Aur yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke ap ne apne baap aur bhai se anaj ka kuch muwawza lena munasib na samjha ho aur yeh bhi qareen-e-qiyas hai ke ap ne yeh khayal farmaya ho ke jab yeh apna asbab kholenge aur yeh cheezein is mein payenge toh zaroori hai ki hamari yeh cheezein humein wapas dene ko ayen toh is bahane hi bhai se mulaqat ho jayegi.

Kahte hain ke Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ne wazir-e-Misr ban kar saat saal tak ghalle aur anaj ko behtareen taur par jama kiya. Aap har beroni shakhsh ko oont bhar kar ghalla ata farmaya karte the. Aur khud Aap ka lashkar balke khud badshah bhi din bhar mein sirf ek hi martaba dopehar ke waqt ek aadh niwala kha lete the aur ahl-e-Misr ko pet bhar kar khilate the, pas us zamane mein yeh baat ek rahmat-e-Rab thi. 

Yeh bhi marwi hai ke Aap ne pehle saal maal ke badle ghalla becha. Doosre saal saaman-o-asbab ke badle, teesre saal bhi aur chauthe saal bhi. Phir khud logon ki jaan aur unki aulad ke badle. Pas khud log, unke bachche aur unki kul malkiyat aur maal ke Aap malik ban gaye. Lekin uske baad Aap ne sab ko azad kar diya aur unke maal bhi unke hawale kar diye. Yeh riwayat Bani Israel ki hai jise hum sach jhoot nahi keh sakte.

Unhe maloom hua tha ke Aziz-e-Misr maal-e-mata' ke badle ghalla dete hain, toh Aap ne apne das beton ko yahan bheja aur Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ke sagey bhai Binyamin ko, jo Aap ke baad Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ke nazdeek bahut hi pyare the, apne paas rok liya. "Naktil" ki doosri qira'at "yaktil" bhi hai. Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ne farmaya ke bas wahi tum unke sath karoge jo isse pehle unke bhai Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke sath kar chuke ho ke yahan se le gaye aur wahan pahunch kar koi baat bana di. Yeh pehle bayaan ho chuka hai ke bhaiyon ki wapsi ke waqt Allah ke Nabi ne un ka maal-o-mataas un ke asbab ke sath poshida taur par wapis kar diya tha. Yahan ghar pahunch kar jab unhon ne kajawe khole aur asbab alag alag kiya toh apni cheezein joon ki toon wapis shuda payein toh apne walid se kehne lage lijiye ab aap ko aur kya chahiye. Asl tak toh Aziz-e-Misr ne hamein wapis kar di hai aur badle ka ghalla poora poora de diya hai. Ab toh aap bhai sahib ko zaroor hamare sath kar dijiye toh hum khandan ke liye ghalla bhi layenge aur bhai ki wajah se ek oont ka bojh aur bhi mil jayega kyunke Aziz-e-Misr har shakhs ko ek oont ka bojh hi dete hain. Aur aap ko unhein hamare sath karne mein taammul kyun hai? Hum us ki dekhbhal aur nigehdaasht poori tarah karenge. Yeh naap bahut hi aasaan hai yeh tha Allah ka Kalam ka tatimma aur Kalam ko achha karna. Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) in tamam baaton ke jawab mein farmate hain ke jab tak tum halfiya iqraar na karo ke apne is bhai ko apne hamrah mujh tak wapis pahunchaoge main ise tumhare sath bhejne ka nahi. Haan yeh aur baat hai ke Allah na kare tum sab hi ghar jaao aur chhoot na sako. Chunache beto ne Allah ko beech mein rakh kar mazboot ahd-o-paiman kiya. Ab Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ne yeh farma kar ke hamari is guftagu ka Allah wakeel hai, apne pyare bachhe ko un ke sath kar diya. Is liye ke qahat ke mare ghalle ki zaroorat thi aur baghair bheje chara na tha.

Chunki Allah ke Nabi ne Hadrat Yaqub (A.S) ko apne bachon par nazar lag jaane ka khatka tha kyunki woh sab achche, khoobsurat, tanumand, taqatwar, mazboot dida-ro naujawan thay is liye buwaqt-e-rukhsat un se farmate hain ki pyare bachon tum sab shehar ke ek darwaze se shehar mein na jana balki mukhtalif darwazon se ek ek do do kar ke jana. Nazar ka lag jana haq hai. Ghur-sawar ko yeh gira deti hai. Phir sath hi farmate hain ki yeh main janta hu aur mera iman hai ki yeh tadbeer taqdeer mein her-pehri nahi kar sakti. Allah ki qaza ko koi shakhs kisi tadbeer se badal nahi sakta. Allah ka chaha poora ho kar hi rehta hai. Hukam usi ka chalta hai. Kaun hai jo uske irade ko badal sake? Uske farman ko taal sake? Uski qaza ko lota sake? Mera bharosa usi par hai aur mujh par hi kya mauquf hai. Har ek tawakkal karne wale ko usi par tawakkal karna chahiye. Chanacha beton ne baap ki farman-bardari ki aur usi tarah kai ek darwazon mein bat gaye aur shehar mein pahuche. Is tarah woh Allah ki qaza ko lota nahi sakte thay haan Hadrat Yaqub (A.S) ne ek zahiri tadbeer poori ki ki is se woh nazar-e-bad se bach jayen. Woh zi-ilm thay, ilhami ilm un ke paas tha. Haan aksar log un baaton ko nahi jaante.

Baniyamin jo Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ke saghe bhai thay unhein lekar Aap ke aur bhai jab Misr pohanche, Aap ne sarkari mehmaan khane mein thehraya, bari izzat-o-takreem ki aur sila aur inaam-o-ikram diya, apne bhai se tanhai mein farmaya ke main tera bhai Yusuf hoon, Allah ne mujh par yeh inaam-o-ikram farmaya hai, ab tumhe chahiye ke bhaiyon ne jo sulook mere sath kiya hai, uska ranj na karo aur is haqeeqat ko bhi un par na kholo, main koshish mein hoon ke kisi na kisi tarah tumhe apne paas rok loon.

Jab aap apne bhaiyon ko hasb-e-aadat ek ek oont ghalle ka dene lage aur unka asbab ladne laga toh apne chalak mulazmon se chupke se ishara kardiya ke chandi ka shahi katora Bunyamin ke asbab mein chupke se rakh dein. Baaz ne kaha hai yeh katora sone ka tha. Isi mein pani piya jata tha aur isi se ghalla bhar ke diya jata tha balki waisa hi pyala Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) ke paas bhi tha. Pas aap ke mulazmeen ne hoshyari se woh pyala aap ke bhai Hazrat Bunyamin ki khurji mein rakh diya. Jab yeh chalne lage toh suna ke peechhe se munadi nida karta aa raha hai ke hey

Jawab diya ke Deen-e-Ibrahimi ke mutabiq iski saza yeh hai ke woh us shakhs ke supurd kar diya jaye, jis ka maal usne churaya hai, hamari shariat ka yahi faisla hai. Ab Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ka matlab poora ho gaya. Aap ne hukum diya ke inki talashi li jaye chunancha pehle bhaiyon ke asbab ki talashi li, halanki maloom tha ke inki khurjiyan khali hain lekin sirf is liye ke unhein aur doosre logon ko koi shubha na ho Aap ne yeh kaam kiya. Jab bhaiyon ki talashi ho chuki aur jam na mila toh ab Benjamin ke asbab ki talashi shuru hui chunke unke asbab mein rakhwaya tha is liye us mein se nikalna hi tha, nikalte hi hukum diya ke unhein rok liya jaye. Bhai ke shiley mein se jaam ka nikalna dekh kar baat banadi ke dekho isne chori ki thi aur yahi kiya iske bhai Yusuf ne bhi ek martaba isse pehle chori kar li thi. Woh waqiya yeh tha ki apne nana ka but chupke se utha laaye the aur use tod diya tha. Yeh bhi marwi hai ki Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ki ek badi bahan thin, jin ke paas apne walid Ishaq (Alaihis Salam) ka ek kamar patta tha jo khandan ke bade aadmi ke paas raha karta tha. Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) paida hote hi apni un phuphi sahiba ki parwarish mein the. Unhein Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) se kamal darje ki mohabbat thi. Jab aap kuch bade ho gaye toh Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ne aap ko le jana chaha. Bahan sahiba se darkhwast ki. Lekin bahan ne judai ko naqabil-e- برداشت (naqabil-e-bardasht) bayan kar ke inkar kar diya. Idhar aap ke walid sahab Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ke shauq ki bhi inteha na thi, zid par ad gaye. Aakhir bahan sahiba ne farmaya achha kuch dinon rehne do phir le jana. Isi asna mein ek din unhon ne wahi kamar patta Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ke kapdon ke niche chhupa diya, phir talash shuru ki. Ghar bhar chhan mara, na mila, shor macha, aakhir yeh tehra ki ghar mein jo hain, un ki talashiyan li jaayen. Talashiyan li gayin. Kisi ke paas ho toh nikle aakhir Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ki talashi li gayi, un ke paas se baramad hua. Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ko khabar di gayi. Aur Millat-e-Ibrahimi ke qanoon ke mutabiq aap apni phuphi ki tehweel mein kar diye gaye. Aur phuphi ne is tarah apne shauq ko poora kiya. Intiqal ke waqt tak Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ko na chhoda. Isi baat ka taana aaj bhai de rahe hain. Jis ke jawab mein Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ne chupke se apne dil mein kaha ke tum bade khana-kharab log ho, is ke bhai ki chori ka haal Allah khoob janta hai.

Jab Baniyamin ke paas se shahi maal baramad hua aur unke apne iqrar ke mutabiq woh shahi qaidi thahar chuke toh ab unhein ranj hone laga. Aziz-e-Misr ko parchane lage aur use rahem dilane ke liye kaha ki unke walid unke bade hi dildada hain. Zaeef aur budhe shakhs hain. Unka ek saga bhai pehle hi gum ho chuka hai, jiske sadme se woh pehle hi se choor hain, ab jab yeh sunenge toh dar hai ki zinda na bach saken. Aap hum mein se kisi ko unke qaim-maqam apne paas rakh lein aur ise chhod dein, aap bade mohsin hain, itni arz hamari qabul farma lein. 

Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ne jawab diya ki bhala yeh sangdili aur zulm kaise ho sakta hai ki kare koi bhare koi. Chor ko roka jayega na ke be-gunah ko. Na-karda gunah ko saza dena aur gunah-gar ko chhod dena yeh to sariq na-insafi aur bad-sulooki hai.

Jab baradaran-e-Yusuf apne bhai ke chhutkare se mayus ho gaye, unhein is baat ne shash-o-panch mein daal diya ke hum walid se sakht ahd-o-paiman kar ke aaye hain ke Baniamin ko aap ke huzoor mein pahucha denge. Ab yahan se yeh kisi tarah chhoot nahi sakte. Ilzam sabit ho chuka hamari apni qarar-dad ke mutabiq woh shahi qaidi thahar chuke ab batao kya kya jaye is aapas ke mashware mein bade bhai ne apna khayal in lafzon mein zahir kiya ke tumhein maloom hai ke is zabardast thos wade ke baad jo hum aba jaan se kar ke aaye hain, ab unhein munh dikhane ke qabil to nahi rahe na yeh hamare bas ki baat hai ke kisi tarah Baniamin ko shahi qaid se azad kar lein phir is waqt hamein apna pehla qusoor aur nadim kar raha hai jo Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ke bare mein hum se is se pehle sarzad ho chuka hai pas ab main to yahin ruk jata hoon. Yahan tak ke ya to walid sahab mera qusoor maaf farma kar mujhe apne paas hazir hone ki ijazat dein ya Allah Ta'ala mujhe koi faisla bujha de ke main ya to lad-bhid kar apne bhai ko lekar jaon ya Allah Ta'ala koi aur surat bana de. Kaha gaya hai ke in ka naam Rubail tha ya Yahuda tha yahi the ke Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ko jab aur bhaiyon ne qatal karna chaha tha unhon ne roka tha. Ab yeh apne aur bhaiyon ko mashwara dete hain ke tum aba ji ke paas jao. Unhein haqeeqat-e-hal se matla karo. Un se kaho ke hamein kya khabar thi ke yeh chori kar lenge aur chori ka maal un ke paas mojood hai hum se to masle ki surat poochhi gayi hum ne bayan kar di. Aap ko hamari baat ka yaqeen na ho to Ahl-e-Misr se daryaft farma lijiye jis qafle ke sath hum aaye hain us se pooch lijiye. Ke hum ne sadaqat, amanat, hifazat mein koi kasar nahi utha rakhi. Aur hum jo kuch arz kar rahe hain, woh bilkul rasti par mabni hai.

Bhaiyon ki zubani yeh khabar sun kar Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ne wahi farmaya jo is se pehle us waqt farmaya tha jab unho ne pairahan-e-yusuf khoon alood paish kar ke apni ghadhi hui kahani sunai thi ke sabr hi behtar hai. Aap samjhe ke usi ki tarah yeh baat bhi un ki apni banai hui hai. Beto se yeh farma kar ab apni umeed zahir ki jo Allah se thi ke bohat mumkin hai ke bohat jald Allah Ta'ala mere teenon bachon ko mujh se mila de yaani Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ko, Bunyamin ko aur aap ke bare sahibzade Rubail ko jo misr mein thehar gaye the is umeed par ke agar moqa lag jaye toh Bunyamin ko khufiya tor par nikal le jayen ya mumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala khud hukm de aur yeh is ki razamandi ke sath wapas loten. Farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala Aleem hai meri halat ko khoob jaan raha hai. Hakeem hai is ki qaza-o-qadar aur is ka koi kaam hikmat se khali nahi hota. 

Ab aap ke is naye ranj ne purana ranj bhi taza kar diya aur Hazrat Yusuf ki yaad dil mein chutkiyan lene lagi. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain "Inna lillahi..." padhne ki hidayat sirf isi ummat ko ki gayi hai is nemat se agli ummaten ma apne nabiyon ke mahroom thin. Dekhiye Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) bhi aise moqa par aayat (Ya Asafa ‘ala Yusufa wabiyaddat ‘ainahu min al-huzni fahuwa kazimun) (12. Yusuf: 84) kehte hain. Aap ki aankhen jati rahi thin. Gham ne aap ko nabina kar diya tha aur zuban khamosh thi. Makhlooq mein se kisi se shikayat-o-shikwa nahi karte the. Ghamgin aur andoh-gin raha karte the. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ne janab-e-bari mein arz ki ke log tujh se yeh keh kar dua mangte hain ke aye Ibrahim aur Ishaq aur Yaqub ke Rabb! Tu toh aisa kar ke in teen namo mein chautha naam mera bhi shamil ho jaye. Jawab mila ke aye Dawood! Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) aag mein dale gaye aur sabr kiya, teri aazayish abhi aisi nahi hui. Ishaq (A.S) ne khud apni qurbani manzoor kar li aur apna gala katwane baith gaye, tujh par yeh baat bhi nahi aayi. Yaqub (A.S) se main ne un ke lakht-e-jigar ko alag kar diya us ne bhi sabr kiya, tere sath yeh waqiya bhi nahi hua. 

Yeh riwayat mursal hai aur is mein nakarat bhi hai, is mein bayan hua hai ke Zabiullah Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) the lekin sahi baat yeh hai ke Hazrat Ismail (A.S) the. Is riwayat ke rawi Ali bin Zaid bin Jud'an aksar munkar aur ghareeb riwayatein bayan kiya karte hain. Wallahu A'lam. 

Bohat mumkin hai ke Ahnaf bin Qais (R.H) ne yeh riwayat Bani Israel se li ho, jaise Ka'ab, Wahab waghera. Wallahu A'lam. 

Bani Israel ki riwayaton mein yeh bhi hai ke Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ne Hazrat Yusuf ko is moqa par jab ke Bunyamin qaid mein the, ek khat likha tha jis mein unhein raham dilane ke liye likha tha ke hum museebat-zada log hain. Mere dada Hazrat Ibrahim aag mein dale gaye. Mere walid Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) zibah ke sath aazmaye gaye. Main khud firaq-e-yusuf mein mubtala hoon. Lekin yeh riwayat bhi sanad sabith nahi.

Aap ne farmaya Yusuf ko ro ro kar aankhein kho baitha aur Benjamin ke sadme ne kamar tor di. Usi waqt Hazrat Jibrael (A.S) aaye aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala aap ko salam ke baad kehta hai ke meri shikayein dusron ke samne karne se aap sharmate nahi? Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ne usi waqt farmaya ke meri pareshani aur gham ki shikayat Allah hi ke samne hai. Hazrat Jibrael (A.S) ne farmaya aap ki shikayat ka Allah ko khoob ilm hai. Yeh hadith bhi ghareeb hai aur is mein bhi nakarat hai.

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ke ek mukhlis dost ne ek martaba aap se pucha ke aap ki beenai kaise jati rahi? aur aap ki kamar kaise kubri ho gayi? Aap ne farmaya Yusuf ko ro ro kar aankhein kho baitha aur Benjamin ke sadme ne kamar tor di. Usi waqt Hazrat Jibrael (A.S) aaye aur farmaya Allah Ta'ala aap ko salam ke baad kehta hai ke meri shikayein dusron ke samne karne se aap sharmate nahi? Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ne usi waqt farmaya ke meri pareshani aur gham ki shikayat Allah hi ke samne hai. Hazrat Jibrael (A.S) ne farmaya aap ki shikayat ka Allah ko khoob ilm hai. Yeh hadith bhi ghareeb hai aur is mein bhi nakarat hai.

Bhaiyon ki zubani yeh khabar sun kar Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ne wahi farmaya jo is se pehle us waqt farmaya tha jab unho ne pairahan-e-yusuf khoon alood paish kar ke apni ghadhi hui kahani sunai thi ke sabr hi behtar hai. Aap samjhe ke usi ki tarah yeh baat bhi un ki apni banai hui hai. Beto se yeh farma kar ab apni umeed zahir ki jo Allah se thi ke bohat mumkin hai ke bohat jald Allah Ta'ala mere teenon bachon ko mujh se mila de yaani Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ko, Bunyamin ko aur aap ke bare sahibzade Rubail ko jo misr mein thehar gaye the is umeed par ke agar moqa lag jaye toh Bunyamin ko khufiya tor par nikal le jayen ya mumkin hai ke Allah Ta'ala khud hukm de aur yeh is ki razamandi ke sath wapas loten. Farmate hain ke Allah Ta'ala Aleem hai meri halat ko khoob jaan raha hai. Hakeem hai is ki qaza-o-qadar aur is ka koi kaam hikmat se khali nahi hota. 

Ab aap ke is naye ranj ne purana ranj bhi taza kar diya aur Hazrat Yusuf ki yaad dil mein chutkiyan lene lagi. Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair (R.H) farmate hain "Inna lillahi..." padhne ki hidayat sirf isi ummat ko ki gayi hai is nemat se agli ummaten ma apne nabiyon ke mahroom thin. Dekhiye Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) bhi aise moqa par aayat (Ya Asafa ‘ala Yusufa wabiyaddat ‘ainahu min al-huzni fahuwa kazimun) (12. Yusuf: 84) kehte hain. Aap ki aankhen jati rahi thin. Gham ne aap ko nabina kar diya tha aur zuban khamosh thi. Makhlooq mein se kisi se shikayat-o-shikwa nahi karte the. Ghamgin aur andoh-gin raha karte the. 

Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke Hazrat Dawood (A.S) ne janab-e-bari mein arz ki ke log tujh se yeh keh kar dua mangte hain ke aye Ibrahim aur Ishaq aur Yaqub ke Rabb! Tu toh aisa kar ke in teen namo mein chautha naam mera bhi shamil ho jaye. Jawab mila ke aye Dawood! Hazrat Ibrahim (A.S) aag mein dale gaye aur sabr kiya, teri aazayish abhi aisi nahi hui. Ishaq (A.S) ne khud apni qurbani manzoor kar li aur apna gala katwane baith gaye, tujh par yeh baat bhi nahi aayi. Yaqub (A.S) se main ne un ke lakht-e-jigar ko alag kar diya us ne bhi sabr kiya, tere sath yeh waqiya bhi nahi hua. 

Yeh riwayat mursal hai aur is mein nakarat bhi hai, is mein bayan hua hai ke Zabiullah Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) the lekin sahi baat yeh hai ke Hazrat Ismail (A.S) the. Is riwayat ke rawi Ali bin Zaid bin Jud'an aksar munkar aur ghareeb riwayatein bayan kiya karte hain. Wallahu A'lam. 

Bohat mumkin hai ke Ahnaf bin Qais (R.H) ne yeh riwayat Bani Israel se li ho, jaise Ka'ab, Wahab waghera. Wallahu A'lam.

Mere dada Hazrat Ibrahim aag mein dale gaye. Mere walid Hazrat Ishaq (A.S) zibah ke sath aazmaye gaye. Main khud firaq-e-yusuf mein mubtala hoon. Lekin yeh riwayat bhi sanad sabith nahi.

Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam / A.S) apne beton ko hukum farma rahe hain ki tum idhar udhar jao aur Hazrat Yusuf aur Baniamin ki talash karo. Arabi mein 'tahassus' ka laafz bhalai ki justuju ke liye bola jata hai aur burai ki totol ke liye 'tajassus' ka laafz bola jata hai. Saath mein farmate hain ki Allah ki zaat se mayus na hona chahiye, uski rehmat se mayus wahi hote hain jin ke dilon mein kufr hota hai. Tum talash band na karo, Allah se nek ummeed rakho aur apni koshish jari rakho. 

Chanacha yeh log chale, phir Misr pahunche, Hazrat Yusuf ke darbar mein hazir hue, wahan apni khasta hali zahir ki ki qaht-e-sali ne hamare khandan ko sata rakha hai, hamare paas kuch nahi raha, jis se ghalla khareedte. Ab raddi, wahi, naqis, bekar, khoti aur qeemat na banne wali kuch yunhi si rakhi rakhai cheezein lekar aap ke paas aaye hain. Go yeh badla nahi kaha ja sakta na qeemat banti hai, lekin taham hamari khwahish hai ki aap hamein wahi dijiye jo sachi, sahi aur poori qeemat par diya karte hain. Hamare bojh bhar dijiye, hamari khurjiyan pur kar dijiye. 

Ibn Masood (R.A) ki qirat mein (FAWFI LANA AL-KAYLA WA TASADDAQ ALAYNA INNA LALLAHA YAJZIL-MUTASADDAQIN) (Surah Yusuf: 88) ke badle 'fawqir' ka laafz bana hai yani hamare oont ghalle se lad dijiye aur hum par sadqa kijiye, hamare bhai ko rehai dijiye. Ya yeh matlab hai ki yeh ghalla hamein hamare is maal ke badle nahi balki ba-taur khairat dijiye. 

Hazrat Sufiyan bin Uyainah (Rahimahullah / R.H) se sawal hota hai ki hamare Nabi (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) se pehle bhi kisi Nabi par sadqa haram hua hai? To aap ne yahi ayat parh kar istadlal kiya ki nahi hua. Hazrat Mujahid (Rahimahullah / R.H) se sawal hua ki kya kisi shakhs ka apni dua mein yeh kehna makrooh hai ki "Ya Allah mujh par sadqa kar"? Farmaya haan, isliye ki sadqa woh karta hai jo talib-e-sawab ho.

Jab bhai Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke paas is aajizi aur bebasi ki halat mein pahuche, apne tamam dukh rone lage, apne walid ki aur apne ghar walon ki museebatein bayaan kiin, to Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ka dil bhar aaya, raha na gaya. Apne sir se taaj utaar diya aur bhaiyon se kaha: Kuch apne kartoot yaad bhi hain ke tumne Yusuf ke sath kya kiya? Aur uske bhai ke sath kya kiya? Woh nari jahalat ka karishma tha, isi liye baaz salaf farmate hain ke Allah ka har gunehgaar jahil hai. Quran farmata hai, ayat: (Thumma inna Rabbaka lilladzina 'amilu as-su'a bijahalatin). 

Bozahir yeh maloom hota hai ke pehli do dafa ki mulaqat mein Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ko apne aap ko zahir karne ka hukm Allah na tha. Ab ki martaba hukm ho gaya. Aap ne mamla saaf kar diya. Jab takliif barh gayi, sakhti zyada ho gayi, to Allah Ta'ala ne rahat de di aur kushadgi ata farma di. Jaise irshad hai ke sakhti ke sath asani hai, yaqeenan sakhti ke sath asani hai. 

Ab bhai chaunk pare, kuch is wajah se ke taaj utaarne ke baad peshani ki nishani dekh li aur kuch is qisam ke sawalat, kuch halaat, kuch agle waqeat sab samne aa gaye. Taham apna shak door karne ke liye poocha ke kya aap hi Yusuf hain? Aap ne is sawal ke jawab mein saaf keh diya ke haan, main khud Yusuf hoon aur yeh mera saga bhai hai, Allah Ta'ala ne hum par fazl o karam kiya, bichharne ke baad mila diya, tafraqa ke baad ijtima' kar diya. Taqwa aur sabr raigaan nahi jate, nek-kaari be-phal laaye nahi rehti. 

Ab to bhaiyon ne Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ki fazilat aur buzurgi ka ikraar kar liya ke waqai soorat-o-seerat dono اعتبار (aitbaar) se aap hum par fuqiyyat rakhte hain. Mulk o maal ke aitbaar se bhi Allah ne aap ko hum par fazliyat de rakhi hai. Isi tarah baaz ke nazdeek nubuwwat ke aitbaar se bhi, kyunke Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) nabi the aur yeh bhai nabi na the. Is ikraar ke baad apni khata-kari ka bhi ikraar kiya. 

Usi waqt Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ne farmaya: Main aaj ke din ke baad se tumhein tumhari yeh khata yaad bhi na dilaunga, main tumhe koi daant-dupat karna nahi chahta, na tum par ilzaam rakhta hoon, na tum par izhar-e-khafgi karta hoon, balki meri dua hai ke Allah bhi tumhein maaf farmaye, woh Arham-ur-Rahimein hai. Bhaiyon ne uzr pesh kiya, aapne qabool farma liya, Allah tumhari parda-poshi kare aur tumne jo kiya hai use bakhsh de.

Jab bhai Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke paas is aajizi aur bebasi ki halat mein pahuche, apne tamam dukh rone lage, apne walid ki aur apne ghar walon ki museebatein bayaan kiin, to Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ka dil bhar aaya, raha na gaya. Apne sir se taaj utaar diya aur bhaiyon se kaha: Kuch apne kartoot yaad bhi hain ke tumne Yusuf ke sath kya kiya? Aur uske bhai ke sath kya kiya? Woh nari jahalat ka karishma tha, isi liye baaz salaf farmate hain ke Allah ka har gunehgaar jahil hai. Quran farmata hai, ayat: (Thumma inna Rabbaka lilladzina 'amilu as-su'a bijahalatin). 

Bozahir yeh maloom hota hai ke pehli do dafa ki mulaqat mein Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ko apne aap ko zahir karne ka hukm Allah na tha. Ab ki martaba hukm ho gaya. Aap ne mamla saaf kar diya. Jab takliif barh gayi, sakhti zyada ho gayi, to Allah Ta'ala ne rahat de di aur kushadgi ata farma di. Jaise irshad hai ke sakhti ke sath asani hai, yaqeenan sakhti ke sath asani hai. 

Ab bhai chaunk pare, kuch is wajah se ke taaj utaarne ke baad peshani ki nishani dekh li aur kuch is qisam ke sawalat, kuch halaat, kuch agle waqeat sab samne aa gaye. Taham apna shak door karne ke liye poocha ke kya aap hi Yusuf hain? Aap ne is sawal ke jawab mein saaf keh diya ke haan, main khud Yusuf hoon aur yeh mera saga bhai hai, Allah Ta'ala ne hum par fazl o karam kiya, bichharne ke baad mila diya, tafraqa ke baad ijtima' kar diya. Taqwa aur sabr raigaan nahi jate, nek-kaari be-phal laaye nahi rehti. 

Ab to bhaiyon ne Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ki fazilat aur buzurgi ka ikraar kar liya ke waqai soorat-o-seerat dono اعتبار (aitbaar) se aap hum par fuqiyyat rakhte hain. Mulk o maal ke aitbaar se bhi Allah ne aap ko hum par fazliyat de rakhi hai. Isi tarah baaz ke nazdeek nubuwwat ke aitbaar se bhi, kyunke Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) nabi the aur yeh bhai nabi na the. Is ikraar ke baad apni khata-kari ka bhi ikraar kiya. 

Usi waqt Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ne farmaya: Main aaj ke din ke baad se tumhein tumhari yeh khata yaad bhi na dilaunga, main tumhe koi daant-dupat karna nahi chahta, na tum par ilzaam rakhta hoon, na tum par izhar-e-khafgi karta hoon, balki meri dua hai ke Allah bhi tumhein maaf farmaye, woh Arham-ur-Rahimein hai. Bhaiyon ne uzr pesh kiya, aapne qabool farma liya, Allah tumhari parda-poshi kare aur tumne jo kiya hai use bakhsh de.

Chunki Allah ke Rasool Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) apne ranj-o-gham mein rote rote nabina ho gaye thay, is liye Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) apne bhaiyon se kehte hain ki mera yeh kurta lekar tum abba ke paas jao, ise unke munh par dalte hi Insha'Allah unki nigah roshan ho jayegi. Phir unhe aur apne gharane ke tamam aur logon ko yahin mere paas le aao. Idhar yeh qafila Misr se nikla, idhar Allah Ta'ala ne Hazrat Yaqub (Alaihis Salam) ko Hazrat Yusuf ki khushbu pahuncha di toh aap ne apne un bachon se jo aap ke paas thay farmaya ki mujhe to mere pyare farzand Yusuf ki khushbu aa rahi hai lekin tum to mujhe satra bahtra kam-aqal buddha keh kar meri is baat ko bawar nahi karne ke. Abhi qafila Canaan se aath din ke faasle par tha jo behukm-e-Ilahi hawa ne Hazrat Yaqub ko Hazrat Yusuf ke pairahan ki khushbu pahuncha di. Us waqt Hazrat Yusuf (Alaihis Salam) ki gumshudgi ki muddat assi saal ki guzar chuki thi aur qafila assi farsakh aap se door tha. Lekin bhaiyon ne kaha aap to Yusuf ki mohabbat mein ghalati mein pade hue hain na gham aap ke dil se door ho na aap ko tasalli ho. Unka yeh kalma bada sakht tha kisi layak aulaad ko layak nahi ki apne baap se yeh kahe na kisi ummati ko layak hai ki apne Nabi se yeh kahe.

Kehte hain ke Pairahan-e-Yousuf (Alaihis Salam) Hazrat Yaqoob (Alaihis Salam) ke bare sahibzade Yehuda laye the. Is liye ke unhon ne hi pehle jhoot moot woh kurta pesh kiya tha. Jise khoon alood kar ke laye the aur baap ko yeh samjhaya tha ke Yousuf ka khoon hai, ab badle ke liye yeh kurta bhi yahi laye ke burai ke badle bhalai hojaye buri khabar ke badle khushkhabri hojaye. Aate hi baap ke munh par dala. Isi waqt Hazrat Yaqoob (Alaihis Salam) ki aankhein khul gayin aur bachon se kehne lage dekho main to hamesha tum se kaha karta tha ke Allah ki baaz woh baatein main janta hoon jin se tum mahz bekhabar ho. Main tum se kaha karta tha ke Allah Ta'ala mere Yousuf ko zaroor mujh se milayega, abhi thode dinon ka zikr hai ke main ne tum se kaha tha ke mujhe aaj mere Yousuf ki khushboo aa rahi hai. Baap jawab mein farmate hain ke mujhe is se inkar nahi aur mujhe apne Rab se yeh bhi umeed hai ke woh tumhari khataen maaf farma dega is liye ke woh bakhshishon aur meharbaniyon wala hai tauba karne walon ki tauba qubool farma liya karta hai main subh sehar ke waqt tumhare liye istighfar karunga. Ibn Jareer mein hai ke Hazrat Umar (R.A) masjid mein aate to sunte ke koi keh raha hai ke Allah tu ne pukara, main ne maan liya tu ne hukum diya main baja laya, yeh sehar ka waqt hai, pas tu mujhe bakhsh de, Aap ne kaan laga kar ghaor kiya to maloom huwa ke Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood (R.A) ke ghar se yeh aawaz aa rahi hai. Aap ne un se poochha unhon ne kaha yahi woh waqt hai jis ke liye Hazrat Yaqoob (Alaihis Salam) ne apne beton se kaha tha ke main tumhare liye thodi der baad istighfar karunga. Hadees mein hai ke yeh raat Jumuma ki raat thi. Ibn Jareer mein hai Huzoor (ﷺ / Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam) farmate hain ke murad is se yeh hai ke jab Jumuma ki raat aa jaye. Lekin yeh hadees ghareeb hai. Balki is ke marfoo hone mein bhi kalam hai wallahu alam.

Bhaiyon par Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ne apne aap ko zahir kar ke farmaya tha ke abba ji ko aur ghar ke sab logon ko yahin le aao. Bhaiyon ne yahi kiya, is buzurg qafle ne Canaan se koch kiya jab Misr ke qareeb pahunche toh Nabiyullah Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) bhi aap ke sath the. Yeh bhi marwi hai ke khud Shah-e-Misr bhi istiqbal ke liye chale aur hukm-e-shahi se shahar ke tamam amir umra aur arkan-e-daulat bhi aap ke sath the. Yeh marwi hai ke khud Shah-e-Misr bhi istiqbal ke liye shahar se bahar aaya tha. Is ke baad jo jagah dene waghera ka zikr hai is ki baabat baaz mufassirin ka qaul hai ke is ki ibarat mein taqdeem-o-taakheer hai yaani aap ne un se farmaya tum Misr mein chalo, Insha'Allah pur-amn aur be-khatar rahoge ab shahar mein dakhile ke baad aap ne apne walidain ko apne paas jagah di aur unhein oonche takht par bithaya. Lekin Imam Ibn Jareer (R.H) ne is ki tardeed ki hai aur farmaya hai ke is mein Suddi (R.H) ka qaul bilkul theek hai jab pehli hi mulaqat hui toh aap ne unhein apne paas kar liya aur jab shahar ka darwaza aaya toh farmaya ab itminan ke sath yahan chaliye. Lekin is mein bhi ek baat reh gayi hai. 'Iwa' asal mein manzil mein jagah dene ko kehte hain jaise 'Awu ilaihi akhahu' mein hai. Aur hadith mein bhi hai 'Man awa muhdithan' pas koi wajah nahi ke hum is ka matlab yeh bayan na karein ke un ke aa jaane ke baad unhein jagah dene ke baad aap ne un se farmaya ke tum amn ke sath Misr mein dakhil ho yaani yahanqaht waghera ki museebaton se mehfooz ho kar ba-aram raho seho, mashhoor hai ke aur jo qaht-sali ke saal baqi the, woh Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ki tashreef-awri ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala ne door kar diye. Jaise ke Ahl-e-Makkah ki qaht-sali se tang aa kar Abu Sufyan ne aap se shikayat ki aur bahut roye pite aur sifarish chahi. Abdur Rahman kehte hain Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ki walda ka toh pehle hi intiqal ho chuka tha. Us waqt aap ke walid sahab ke hamrah aap ki khala sahiba aayi theen. Lekin Imam Ibn Jareer aur Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq (R.H) ka qaul hai ke aap ki walda khud hi zinda maujood theen, un ki maut par koi sahih daleel nahi aur Quran-e-Kareem ke zahiri alfaaz is baat ko chahte hain ke aap ki walda majida zinda maujood theen, yahi baat theek bhi hai. Aap ne apne walidain ko apne sath takht-e-shahi par bitha liya. Us waqt maan-baap bhi aur gyarah bhai kul ke kul aap ke samne sajde mein gir pade. Aap ne farmaya abba ji lijiye mere khwab ki taabeer zahir ho gayi yeh hain gyarah sitare aur yeh hain suraj chand jo mere samne sajde mein hain. In ki shariat mein yeh jaayiz tha ke badon ko salam ke sath sajda karte the balke Hazrat Adam (A.S) se Hazrat Isa (A.S) tak yeh baat jaayiz hi rahi lekin is Millat-e-Muhammadiya mein Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne kisi aur ke liye siwaye apni zaat-e-pak ke sajde ko mutlaqan haram kar diya. Aur Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala ne ise apne liye hi مخصوص kar liya. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) waghera ke qaul ka mahasil mazmoon yahi hai.

Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke حضرت معاذ (R.A) Mulk-e-Sham gaye, wahan unhon ne dekha ke Shami log apne baron ko sajde karte hain, yeh jab lautey to unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ko sajda kiya. Aap (ﷺ) ne poocha, "He Ma'az yeh kya baat hai?" Aap ne jawab diya ke "Maine Ahl-e-Sham ko dekha ke woh apne baron aur buzurgon ko sajda karte hain, to aap to iske sab se zyada mustahiq hain." Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Agar main kisi ke liye sajde ka hukum deta to aurat ko hukum deta ke woh apne khawand ke samne sajda kare," ba-sabab iske bohat bare haq ke jo is par hai. Aur Hadith mein hai ke حضرت سلمان (R.A) ne apne Islam ke ibtedai zamane mein raste mein Huzoor (ﷺ) ko dekh kar aap ke samne sajda kiya, to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Salman mujhe sajda na karo. Sajda us Allah ko karo jo hamesha ki zindagi wala hai, jo kabhi na marega."

Al-Gharz chunke us shariyat mein jaiz tha isliye unhon ne sajda kiya to aap ne farmaya, "Lijiye Abba ji mere khwab ka zuhoor ho gaya. Mere Rab ne ise sacha kar dikhaya. Iska anjam zahir ho gaya." Chunanche aur aayat mein Qiyamat ke din ke liye bhi yahi lafz bola gaya hai, aayat: (Yuma Ya'ti Taweeluhu).

Pas yeh bhi Allah ka mujh par ek ehsaan-e-azeem hai ke usne mere khwab ko sacha kar dikhaya aur jo maine sote sote dekha tha, Alhamdulillah mujhe jaagne mein bhi usne dikha diya. Aur ehsaan uska yeh bhi hai ke usne mujhe qaidkhane se nijat di aur tum sab ko sehra se yahan la kar mujhse mila diya. Aap chunke janwaron ke palne wale thay, isliye umuman Badiya mein hi qiyam rehta tha, Filisteen bhi Sham ke jangalon mein hai aksar auqat padao raha karta tha. Kehte hain ke yeh Aulaj mein Hasmi ke niche raha karte thay aur maweshi paltey thay, oont bakriyan waghera sath rehti thin.

Phir farmate hain iske baad ke "Shaitan ne hum mein phoot dalwa di thi, Allah Ta'ala jis kaam ka irada karta hai, uske waise hi asbab muhayya kar deta hai aur use aasan aur sahal kar deta hai. Woh apne bandon ki maslihaton ko khoob janta hai apne afaal aqwal qaza-o-qadar mukhtar-o-murad mein woh ba-hikmat hai."

Sulaiman ka qoul hai ke khwab ke dekhne aur uski taweel ke zahir hone mein chaalees saal ka waqfa tha. Abdullah bin Shaddad farmate hain khwab ki tabeer ke waqe hone mein is se zyada zamana lagta bhi nahi yeh aakhri muddat hai. حضرت حسن (R.H) se riwayat hai ke baap bete assi baras ke baad mile. Tum khyal to karo ke zameen par حضرت یعقوب (A.S) se zyada Allah ka koi mehboob banda na tha, phir bhi itni muddat unhe firaq-e-Yusuf mein guzri, har waqt ankhon se aansu jari rehte aur dil mein gham ki moujein uthtin aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh muddat terasi saal ki thi.

Farmate hain jab حضرت یوسف (A.S) kunwein mein dale gaye us waqt aap ki umr satra saal ki thi. Assi baras tak aap baap ki nazron se ojhal rahe. Phir mulaqat ke baad teis baras zinda rahe aur ek sau bees baras ki umr mein intiqal kiya. Baqoul Qatada (R.H) tripan baras ke baad baap beta mile.

Aik qaul hai ke atharah saal aik dusre se duur rahe aur aik qaul hai ke chaalis saal ki judai rahi aur phir Misr mein baap se milne ke baad satrah saal zindah rahe. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A farmate hain ke Bani Israel jab Misr pohnche hain un ki tadad sirf tressath ki thi aur jab yahan se nikle hain us waqt un ki tadad aik lakh sattar hazaar ki thi. Masruq kehte hain aane ke waqt yeh ma'a mard o aurat teen sau nau thay, Abdullah bin Shaddad ka qaul hai ke jab yeh log aaye kul chheyaasi thay yaani mard aurat burhe bachhe sab mila kar aur jab nikle hain us waqt un ki ginti chhe lakh se upar upar thi.

Lekin Imam Ibn Jareer (R.H) ne is ki tardeed ki hai aur farmaya hai ke is mein Suddi (R.H) ka qaul bilkul theek hai jab pehli hi mulaqat hui toh aap ne unhein apne paas kar liya aur jab shahar ka darwaza aaya toh farmaya ab itminan ke sath yahan chaliye. Lekin is mein bhi ek baat reh gayi hai. 'Iwa' asal mein manzil mein jagah dene ko kehte hain jaise 'Awu ilaihi akhahu' mein hai. Aur hadith mein bhi hai 'Man awa muhdithan' pas koi wajah nahi ke hum is ka matlab yeh bayan na karein ke un ke aa jaane ke baad unhein jagah dene ke baad aap ne un se farmaya ke tum amn ke sath Misr mein dakhil ho yaani yahanqaht waghera ki museebaton se mehfooz ho kar ba-aram raho seho, mashhoor hai ke aur jo qaht-sali ke saal baqi the, woh Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ki tashreef-awri ki wajah se Allah Ta'ala ne door kar diye. Jaise ke Ahl-e-Makkah ki qaht-sali se tang aa kar Abu Sufyan ne aap se shikayat ki aur bahut roye pite aur sifarish chahi. Abdur Rahman kehte hain Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ki walda ka toh pehle hi intiqal ho chuka tha. Us waqt aap ke walid sahab ke hamrah aap ki khala sahiba aayi theen. Lekin Imam Ibn Jareer aur Imam Muhammad bin Ishaq (R.H) ka qaul hai ke aap ki walda khud hi zinda maujood theen, un ki maut par koi sahih daleel nahi aur Quran-e-Kareem ke zahiri alfaaz is baat ko chahte hain ke aap ki walda majida zinda maujood theen, yahi baat theek bhi hai. Aap ne apne walidain ko apne sath takht-e-shahi par bitha liya. Us waqt maan-baap bhi aur gyarah bhai kul ke kul aap ke samne sajde mein gir pade. Aap ne farmaya abba ji lijiye mere khwab ki taabeer zahir ho gayi yeh hain gyarah sitare aur yeh hain suraj chand jo mere samne sajde mein hain. In ki shariat mein yeh jaayiz tha ke badon ko salam ke sath sajda karte the balke Hazrat Adam (A.S) se Hazrat Isa (A.S) tak yeh baat jaayiz hi rahi lekin is Millat-e-Muhammadiya mein Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala ne kisi aur ke liye siwaye apni zaat-e-pak ke sajde ko mutlaqan haram kar diya. Aur Allah Subhanahu wa Ta'ala ne ise apne liye hi مخصوص kar liya. Hazrat Qatadah (R.H) waghera ke qaul ka mahasil mazmoon yahi hai.

Hadith-e-Sharif mein hai ke حضرت معاذ (R.A) Mulk-e-Sham gaye, wahan unhon ne dekha ke Shami log apne baron ko sajde karte hain, yeh jab lautey to unhon ne Huzoor (ﷺ) ko sajda kiya. Aap (ﷺ) ne poocha, "He Ma'az yeh kya baat hai?" Aap ne jawab diya ke "Maine Ahl-e-Sham ko dekha ke woh apne baron aur buzurgon ko sajda karte hain, to aap to iske sab se zyada mustahiq hain." Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Agar main kisi ke liye sajde ka hukum deta to aurat ko hukum deta ke woh apne khawand ke samne sajda kare," ba-sabab iske bohat bare haq ke jo is par hai. Aur Hadith mein hai ke حضرت سلمان (R.A) ne apne Islam ke ibtedai zamane mein raste mein Huzoor (ﷺ) ko dekh kar aap ke samne sajda kiya, to Aap (ﷺ) ne farmaya, "Salman mujhe sajda na karo. Sajda us Allah ko karo jo hamesha ki zindagi wala hai, jo kabhi na marega."

Al-Gharz chunke us shariyat mein jaiz tha isliye unhon ne sajda kiya to aap ne farmaya, "Lijiye Abba ji mere khwab ka zuhoor ho gaya. Mere Rab ne ise sacha kar dikhaya. Iska anjam zahir ho gaya." Chunanche aur aayat mein Qiyamat ke din ke liye bhi yahi lafz bola gaya hai, aayat: (Yuma Ya'ti Taweeluhu).

Pas yeh bhi Allah ka mujh par ek ehsaan-e-azeem hai ke usne mere khwab ko sacha kar dikhaya aur jo maine sote sote dekha tha, Alhamdulillah mujhe jaagne mein bhi usne dikha diya. Aur ehsaan uska yeh bhi hai ke usne mujhe qaidkhane se nijat di aur tum sab ko sehra se yahan la kar mujhse mila diya. Aap chunke janwaron ke palne wale thay, isliye umuman Badiya mein hi qiyam rehta tha, Filisteen bhi Sham ke jangalon mein hai aksar auqat padao raha karta tha. Kehte hain ke yeh Aulaj mein Hasmi ke niche raha karte thay aur maweshi paltey thay, oont bakriyan waghera sath rehti thin.

Phir farmate hain iske baad ke "Shaitan ne hum mein phoot dalwa di thi, Allah Ta'ala jis kaam ka irada karta hai, uske waise hi asbab muhayya kar deta hai aur use aasan aur sahal kar deta hai. Woh apne bandon ki maslihaton ko khoob janta hai apne afaal aqwal qaza-o-qadar mukhtar-o-murad mein woh ba-hikmat hai."

Sulaiman ka qoul hai ke khwab ke dekhne aur uski taweel ke zahir hone mein chaalees saal ka waqfa tha. Abdullah bin Shaddad farmate hain khwab ki tabeer ke waqe hone mein is se zyada zamana lagta bhi nahi yeh aakhri muddat hai. حضرت حسن (R.H) se riwayat hai ke baap bete assi baras ke baad mile. Tum khyal to karo ke zameen par حضرت یعقوب (A.S) se zyada Allah ka koi mehboob banda na tha, phir bhi itni muddat unhe firaq-e-Yusuf mein guzri, har waqt ankhon se aansu jari rehte aur dil mein gham ki moujein uthtin aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh muddat terasi saal ki thi.

Farmate hain jab حضرت یوسف (A.S) kunwein mein dale gaye us waqt aap ki umr satra saal ki thi. Assi baras tak aap baap ki nazron se ojhal rahe. Phir mulaqat ke baad teis baras zinda rahe aur ek sau bees baras ki umr mein intiqal kiya. Baqoul Qatada (R.H) tripan baras ke baad baap beta mile.

Aik qaul hai ke atharah saal aik dusre se duur rahe aur aik qaul hai ke chaalis saal ki judai rahi aur phir Misr mein baap se milne ke baad satrah saal zindah rahe. Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A farmate hain ke Bani Israel jab Misr pohnche hain un ki tadad sirf tressath ki thi aur jab yahan se nikle hain us waqt un ki tadad aik lakh sattar hazaar ki thi. Masruq kehte hain aane ke waqt yeh ma'a mard o aurat teen sau nau thay, Abdullah bin Shaddad ka qaul hai ke jab yeh log aaye kul chheyaasi thay yaani mard aurat burhe bachhe sab mila kar aur jab nikle hain us waqt un ki ginti chhe lakh se upar upar thi.

Nubuwwat mil chuki, baadshahat ata ho gayi, dukh kat gaye, maan baap aur bhai sab se mulaqat ho gayi toh Allah Ta'ala se dua karte hain ke jaise yeh duniyawi niwamatein Tu ne mujh par poori ki hain, un niwAMaton ko akhirat mein poori farma, jab bhi maut aaye toh Islam par aur teri farmanbardari par aaye aur mein nek logon mein mila diya jaun aur nabiyon aur rasulon mein (Salawatullahi wa Salamuhu Alaihim Ajma'in). 

Bohat mumkin hai ke Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ki yeh dua buwaqt-e-wafat ho. Jaise ke Bukhari-o-Muslim mein Hazrat Aishah Siddiqah (R.A) se sabit hai ke inteqal ke waqt Rasulullah ﷺ ne apni ungli uthai aur yeh dua ki ke "A Allah! Rafeeq-e-A'la mein mila de." Teen martaba Aap ne yehi dua ki. 

Haan, yeh bhi ho sakta hai ke Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ki is dua ka maqsud yeh ho ke jab bhi wafat aaye Islam par aaye aur nekon mein mil jaun. Yeh nahi ke usi waqt Aap ne yeh dua apni maut ke liye ki ho. Is ki bilkul wohi misal hai jo koi kisi ko dua dete hue kehta hai ke "Allah tujhe Islam par maut de." Is se yeh murad nahi hoti ke abhi hi tujhe maut aa jaye. Ya jaise hum mangte hain ke "Allah hamein tere deen par hi maut aaye" ya hamari yehi dua ke "Allah mujhe Islam par maar aur nek karon mein mila." 

Aur agar yehi murad ho ke waqai Aap ne usi waqt maut mangi toh mumkin hai ke yeh baat is shariat mein jaiz ho. Chunancha Qatadah (R.H) ka qaul hai ke jab Aap ke tamam kaam ban gaye, aankhein thandi ho gayeen, mulk, maal, izzat, abru, khandan, baradri, baadshahat sab mil gaye toh Aap ko saleheen ki jamaat mein pahunchne ka ishtiyaq paida hua. 

Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain, yehi sab se pehle is dua ke mangne wale hain. Mumkin hai is se murad Ibn Abbas ki yeh ho ke is dua ko sab se pehle karne wale yaani khatimah Islam par hone ki dua ke sab se pehle mangne wale Aap hi the. Jaise ke yeh dua (Rabbighfirli wa liwalidayya) sab se pehle Hazrat Nuh (A.S) ne mangi thi. 

Bawajud is ke bhi agar yehi kaha jaye ke Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ne maut ki hi dua ki thi toh hum kehte hain ho sakta hai ke un ke deen mein jaiz ho. Hamare yahan toh sakht mamnu hai. Musnad mein hai Rasulullah ﷺ farmate hain: "Tum mein se koi kisi sakhti aur zarar se ghabra kar maut ki aarzu na kare, agar use aisi hi tamna karni zaroori hai toh yun kahe: 'A Allah! Jab tak meri hayat tere ilm mein mere liye behtar hai, mujhe zinda rakh aur jab tere ilm mein meri maut mere liye behtar ho, mujhe maut de de.'" 

Bukhari Muslim ki isi hadith mein hai ke "Tum mein se koi kisi sakhti ke nazil hone ki wajah se maut ki tamna hargiz na kare, agar woh nek hai toh us ki zindagi us ki nekiyan barhaye gi aur agar woh bad hai toh bohat mumkin hai ke zindagi mein kisi waqt tauba ki taufeeq ho jaye, balke yun kahe: 'A Allah! Jab tak mere liye hayat behtar hai toh mujhe zinda rakh.'"

Musnad Ahmad mein hai hum ek martaba Huzoor ﷺ ki majlis mein baithe hue thay aap ne hamein wa'z-o-naseehat ki aur hamare dil garma diye. Us waqt hum mein sab se zyada rone wale Hazrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqas ؓ thay, rote hi rote unki zuban se nikal gaya ki kaash ki main marjata aap ne farmaya Sa'd mere saamne maut ki tamanna karte ho? Teen martaba yahi alfaaz dohraye. Phir farmaya aye Sa'd agar tu jannat ke liye paida kiya gaya hai toh jis qadar umr barhegi aur nekiyan zyada hongi, tere haq mein behtar hai. Musnad mein hai aap farmate hain tum mein se koi hargiz hargiz maut ki tamanna na kare na uski dua kare isse pehle ki woh aaye. Haan agar koi aisa ho ki use apne aamal ka wusooq aur un par yaqeen ho. Suno tum mein se jo marta hai, uske aamal munqata hojate hain. Momin ke aamal uski nekiyan hi barhate hain. Yeh yaad rahe ki yeh hukm us museebat mein hai jo duniyawi ho aur usi ki zaat ke mutaliq ho. Lekin agar fitna mazhabi ho, museebat deeni ho, toh maut ka sawal jaaiz hai. Jaise ki Firon ke jadoo-garon ne us waqt dua ki thi jab ki Firon unhe qatal ki dhamkiyan de raha tha. Kaha tha ki Allah hum ko sabr ata kar aur hamein Islam ki halat mein maut de. Isi tarah Hazrat Maryam (Alaihas Salam) jab dard-e-zah se ghabra kar khajoor ke tane tale gayin toh besaakhta munh se nikal gaya ki kaash ki main isse pehle hi margayi hoti aur aaj toh logon ke zaban-o-dil se bhula di gayi hoti. Yeh aap ne us waqt farmaya jab maloom hua ki log unhe zina ki tohmat laga rahe hain, isliye ki aap khawand wali na theen aur hamal thhar gaya tha. Phir bacha paida hua tha aur duniya ne shor machaya tha ki Maryam bari buri aurat hai, na maan buri na baap badkaar. Pas Allah Ta'ala ne aap ki mukhlisi kardi aur apne bande Hazrat Isa ؑ ko gahware mein zuban di aur makhlooq ko zabardast mojiza aur zahir nishaan dikha diya salawatullahi wa salamuhu alaiha. Ek hadis mein ek lambi dua ka zikr hai jismein yeh jumla bhi hai ki Allah jab tu kisi qaum ke sath fitne ka irada kare toh mujhe us fitne mein mubtala karne se pehle hi duniya se utha le. Huzoor ﷺ farmate hain do cheezon ko insaan apne haq mein buri jaanta hai; maut ko buri jaanta hai aur maut momin ke liye fitne se behtar hai. Maal ki kami ko insaan apne liye burai khayal karta hai halanki maal ki kami hisab ki kami hai. Al-gharz deeni fitnon ke waqt talab-e-maut jaaiz hai. Chunanche Hazrat Ali ؓ ne apni khilafat ke aakhri zamane mein jab dekha ki logon ki shararatein kisi tarah khatam nahi hotin aur kisi tarah ittefaq naseeb nahi hota toh dua ki ki Ilal-Alameen mujhe ab tu apni taraf qabz karle. Yeh log mujh se aur main unse tang aa chuka hoon. Hazrat Imam Bukhari ؒ par bhi jab fitnon ki ziyadti hui aur deen ka sambhalna mushkil ho para aur ameer-e-Khurasan ke sath bare ma'rke pesh aaye toh aap ne janaab-e-Bari se dua ki ki Allah ab mujhe apne paas bula le.

Ek hadis mein hai ke fitnon ke zamanon mein insaan qabr ko dekh kar kahega kash ke main is jagah hota kyunke fitnon, balaon, zalzalon aur sakhtiyon ne har ek maftoon ko fitne mein daal rakha hoga. 

Ibn-e-Jarir mein hai ke jab Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ne apne un beton ke liye jin se bahut se qusoor sarzad ho chuke thay, istighfar kiya to Allah ne un ka istighfar qubool kiya aur unhein bakhsh diya. 

Hazrat Anas (R.A) farmate hain ke jab sara khandan Misr mein jama ho gaya to baradaran-e-Yوسف ne ek roz aapas mein kaha ke hum ne abaa jaan ko jitna sataya hai zahir hai, hum ne bhai Yوسف par jo zulm tode hain, zahir hain. Ab goya dono buzurg hamein kuch na kahein aur hamari khata se darguzar farma jaaein. Lekin kuch khayal bhi hai ke Allah ke yahan hamari kaisi dargat banegi? 

Aakhir yeh thehri ke aao abaa ji ke paas chalein aur un se iltijaaein karein. Chunacha sab mil kar aap ke paas aaye. Us waqt Hazrat Yوسف (A.S) bhi baap ke paas baithe hue thay, aate hi unhon ne yak zaban kaha ke huzoor hum aap ke paas ek aise ahem amr ke liye aaj aaye hain ke is se pehle kabhi aise ahem kaam ke liye aap ke paas nahi aaye thay, abaa ji aur ae bhai sahib hum is waqt aisi museebat mein mubtala hain aur hamare dil is qadar kapkapa rahe hain ke aaj se pehle hamari aisi halat kabhi nahi hui. 

Al-gharz kuch is tarah narmi aur lajajat ki ke dono buzurgon ka dil bhar aaya, zahir hai ke anbiya ke dilon mein tamam makhlooq se zyada raham aur narmi hoti hai. Poocha ke aakhir tum kya kehte ho aur aisi tum par kya bapta padi hai? Sab ne kaha aap ko khoob maloom hai ke hum ne aap ko kis qadar sataya, hum ne bhai par kaise zulm-o-sitam dhaye? 

Dono ne kaha haan maloom hai, phir? 

Kaha kya yeh durust hai ke aap dono ne hamari taqseer maaf farma di? 

Haan bilkul durust hai, hum dil se maaf kar chuke hain. 

Tab larko ne kaha, aap ka maaf kar dena bhi besood hai jab tak ke Allah Ta'ala hamein maaf na kar de. 

Poocha achha phir mujh se kya chahte ho? 

Jawab diya yahi ke aap hamare liye Allah se bakhshish talab farmayen, yahan tak ke bazariya-e-wahi aap ko maloom ho jaye ke Allah ne hamein bakhsh diya to albatta hamari ankhon mein noor aur dil mein suroor aa sakta hai warna hum to dono jahan se gaye guzre hain. 

Us waqt aap khade ho gaye, qibla ki taraf mutawajjo hue, Hazrat Yوسف (A.S) aap ke peeche khade hue, bade hi khushoo-o-khuzoo ke sath janab-e-bari mein gudguda kar duayein shuru keen. Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) dua karte thay aur Hazrat Yوسف (A.S) ameen kehte thay. 

Kehte hain ke bees saal tak dua maqbool na hui. Aakhir bees saal tak jab ke bhaiyon ka khoon Allah ke khof se khushk hone laga, tab wahi aayi aur qubooliyat-e-dua aur bakhshish-e-farzandan ki basharat sunayi gayi, balki yeh bhi farmaya gaya ke Allah ka wada hai ke tere baad nubuwwat bhi unhein milegi. 

Yeh qaul Hazrat Anas (R.A) ka hai aur is mein do rawi zaeef hain: Yazeed Raqashi, Salih Marri. 

Suddi (R.H) farmate hain ke Hazrat Yaqub (A.S) ne apni maut ke waqt Hazrat Yوسف (A.S) ko wasiyat ki ke mujhe Ibrahim o Ishaq ki jagah mein dafn karna.

Chanacha ba'd az intiqal Aap ne yeh wasiyat poori ki aur mulk-e-Sham ki zameen mein aap ke baap dada ke paas dafan kiya. Alaihimus Salatu Wasalam

Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ka tamam-o-kamaal qissa bayan farma kar kis tarah bhaiyon ne un ke sath burai ki aur kis tarah un ki jaan talaf karni chahi aur Allah ne unhein kis tarah bachaya aur kis tarah auj-o-taraqqi par pohanchaya, ab apne Nabi (ﷺ) se farmata hai ke yeh aur is jaisi aur cheezein sab hamari taraf se tumhein di jati hain taakh log in se naseeshat hasil karein aur aap ke mukhalifein ki bhi aankhein khulein aur un par hamari hujjat qaim ho jaye. To us waqt kuch un ke paas thode hi tha, jab woh Hazrat Yusuf (A.S) ke sath khula dao fareeb kar rahe thay, kunwe mein dalne ke liye sab mustaid ho gaye thay, sirf hamare batane sikhane se tujhe yeh waqeat maloom hue. Jaise Hazrat Maryam (A.S) ke qisse ko bayan farmate hue irshad hua hai ke jab woh qalamein dal rahe thay ke Maryam ko kaun pale to us waqt un ke paas na tha, al-kh. Hazrat Musa ko apni baatein samjha rahe thay to wahan na tha, isi tarah Ahl-e-Madyan ka mamla bhi tujh se poshida hi tha, Mala-e-Aala ki aapas ki guftugu mein to maujud na tha. Yeh sab hamari taraf se ba-zariya wahi tujhe bataya gaya, yeh khuli daleel hai teri risalat-o-nubuwwat ki ke guzishta waqeat tu is tarah khol khol kar logon ke samne bayan karta hai ke goya tune aap ba-chashm-e-khud dekhe hain aur tere samne hi guzre hain. Phir yeh waqeat naseehat-o-ibrat, hikmat-o-mau'izat se pur hain, jin se insano ki deen-o-duniya sanwar sakti hai. Bawajud is ke bhi aksar log iman se kore rahe jate hain, go tu lakh chahe ke yeh momin ban jayein aur aayat mein hai: Wa in tuti' akthara man fil-ardi yudillooka 'an sabilillah, in yattabi'una illaz-zanna wa in hum illa yakhrusun (Surah Al-An'am: 116) - Agar tu insano ki aksriyat ki itaat karega toh woh tuje Allah ki rah se behka aur bhatka dein ge. Bahut se waqeat ke bayan ke baad har ek waqey ke sath Quran ne farmaya hai ke go is mein bada zabardast nishan hai lekin phir bhi aksar log manne wale nahi. Aap jo kuch bhi jafa-kashi kar rahe hain aur Allah ki makhlooq ko rah-e-haq dikha rahe hain, is mein aap ka apna duniyawi nafa hargiz maqsood nahi, aap in se koi ujrat aur koi badla nahi chahte balke yeh sirf Allah ki raza-joi ke liye makhlooq ke nafa ke liye hai. Yeh to tamam jahan ke liye sarasar zikr hai ke woh rah-e-raast payein, naseehat hasil karein, ibrat pakrein, hidayat-o-nijaat payein.

Jaise Hazrat Maryam (A.S) ke qisse ko bayan farmate hue irshad hua hai ke jab woh qalamein dal rahe thay ke Maryam ko kaun pale to us waqt un ke paas na tha, al-kh. Hazrat Musa ko apni baatein samjha rahe thay to wahan na tha, isi tarah Ahl-e-Madyan ka mamla bhi tujh se poshida hi tha, Mala-e-Aala ki aapas ki guftugu mein to maujud na tha. Yeh sab hamari taraf se ba-zariya wahi tujhe bataya gaya, yeh khuli daleel hai teri risalat-o-nubuwwat ki ke guzishta waqeat tu is tarah khol khol kar logon ke samne bayan karta hai ke goya tune aap ba-chashm-e-khud dekhe hain aur tere samne hi guzre hain. Phir yeh waqeat naseehat-o-ibrat, hikmat-o-mau'izat se pur hain, jin se insano ki deen-o-duniya sanwar sakti hai. Bawajud is ke bhi aksar log iman se kore rahe jate hain, go tu lakh chahe ke yeh momin ban jayein aur aayat mein hai: Wa in tuti' akthara man fil-ardi yudillooka 'an sabilillah, in yattabi'una illaz-zanna wa in hum illa yakhrusun (Surah Al-An'am: 116) - Agar tu insano ki aksriyat ki itaat karega toh woh tuje Allah ki rah se behka aur bhatka dein ge. Bahut se waqeat ke bayan ke baad har ek waqey ke sath Quran ne farmaya hai ke go is mein bada zabardast nishan hai lekin phir bhi aksar log manne wale nahi. Aap jo kuch bhi jafa-kashi kar rahe hain aur Allah ki makhlooq ko rah-e-haq dikha rahe hain, is mein aap ka apna duniyawi nafa hargiz maqsood nahi, aap in se koi ujrat aur koi badla nahi chahte balke yeh sirf Allah ki raza-joi ke liye makhlooq ke nafa ke liye hai. Yeh to tamam jahan ke liye sarasar zikr hai ke woh rah-e-raast payein, naseehat hasil karein, ibrat pakrein, hidayat-o-nijaat payein.

Bayan ho raha hai Qudrat ki bohot si nishaniyan, Wahdaniyat ki bohot si gawahiyan, din raat un ke samne hain, phir bhi aksar log nihayat be-parwahi aur sabak-sari se un mein kabhi ghor-o-fikr nahi karte. Kya yeh itna wasi' asman, kya yeh is qadr phaili hui zameen, kya yeh roshan sitare, yeh gardish wala suraj, chand, yeh darakht aur yeh pahad, yeh khetiyan aur sabziyan, yeh talatum barpa karne wale samandar, yeh bazoor chalne wali hawayen, yeh mukhtalif qasam ke rangarang mewey, yeh alag alag ghale aur Qudrat ki beshumar nishaniyan ek aqalmand ko is qadr bhi kaam nahi asaktein? Ke woh un se apne Allah ki jo Ahad hai, Samad hai, Fard hai, Wahid hai, La shareek hai, Qadir-o-Qayyum hai, Baqi aur Kafi hai, us zaat ko pehchan lein aur us ke namon aur sifat ke qayil hojayein? Balki un mein se aksariyat ki zehniyat toh yahan tak bigad chuki hai ke Allah par iman hai phir shirq se dast-bardari nahi. Asman-o-zameen, pahad aur darakht ka, insan aur din ka khaliq Allah mante hain, lekin phir bhi us ke siwa dusron ko us ke sath iska shareek thehrate hain. Yeh mushrikeen hajj ko aate hain, ahram bandh kar labaik pukarte hue kehte hain ke Allah tera koi shareek nahi, jo bhi shareek hain, un ka khud ka malik bhi tu hai aur un ki malkiyat ka malik bhi tu hi hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke jab woh itna kehte hain ke hum hazir hain Ilahi tera koi shareek nahi toh An-Hazrat ﷺ farmate hain bas bas, yaani ab aage kuch na kaho. Fi-l-waqiat shirq zulm-e-azeem hai ke Allah ke sath dusre ki bhi ibadat. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Ibn Mas'ood ؓ ne Risalat-Panah ﷺ se sawal kiya ke sab se bada gunah kya hai? Aap ne jawab diya ke tera Allah ke sath shareek thehrana halanki usi akele ne tujhe paida kiya hai. Isi tarah isi ayat ke taht mein munafiqein bhi dakhil hain. Un ke amal ikhlas wale nahi hote balki woh riyakari hote hain aur riyakari bhi shirq hai. Quran ka farman hai ayat: (Inna-l-munafiqeena yukhadi'oonallaha wa huwa khadi'uhum wa iza qamoo ila-ssalati qamoo kusala yura'oonan-nassa wa la yazkuroon-allaha illa qaleela) (Surah An-Nisa: 142), munafiq Allah ko dhoka dena chahte hain halanki Allah ki taraf se khud dhoke mein hain. Yeh namaz ko bade hi sust ho kar khade hote hain, sirf logon ko dikhana maqsood hota hai, zikrullah toh baraye naam hota hai. Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke ba'az shirq bohot halke aur poshida hote hain, khud karne wale ko bhi pata nahi chalta. Chunache Hazrat Huzaifa ؓ ek bimar ke pas gaye, us ke bazu par ek dhaga bandha hua dekh kar aap ne use tod diya aur yehi ayat padhi ke imandar hote hue bhi mushrik bante ho? Hadith Sharif mein hai Allah ke siwa dusre ke naam ki jis ne qasam khai woh mushrik hogaya. Mulaiza ho Tirmidhi Sharif. Huzoori ﷺ ka farman hai ke jhaar-phoonk, dore-dhage aur jhoote taweez shirq hain. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko tawakkal ke ba'is sab sakhtiyon se dur kar deta hai.

(Abu Dawood waghaira) Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A ki biwi sahiba farmati hain ke Hazrat Abdullah ki aadat thi, jab kabhi bahar se aate zor se khankhartey, thoktey ke ghar waley samajh jayein aur aap unhein kisi aisi halat mein na dekh payein ke bura lagey. Aik din usi tarah aap aaye us waqt mere paas aik burhiya thi jo wajah-e-bimari ke mujh par dam jhaar karne ko aayi thi maine aap ki khankhar ki aawaz suntey hi usay charpai taley chupa diya aap aaye mere paas meri charpai par baith gaye aur mere gale mein dhaga dekh kar pucha ke yeh kya hai? Maine kaha is mein dam kara ke maine bandh liya hai. Aap ne usay pakad kar tod diya aur farmaya Abdullah ka ghar shirk se beniyaz hai. Khud maine Rasulullah ﷺ se suna hai ke jhaar phoonk taweezat aur doray dhagay shirk hain. Maine kaha yeh aap kaise farmate hain meri aankh dukh rahi thi, main fulaan yahudi ke paas jaya karti thi, woh dam jhara kar deta tha to sukoon ho jata tha, aap ne farmaya teri aankh mein shaitan choka mara karta tha aur us ki phoonk se woh ruk jata tha tujhe yeh kafi tha ke woh kehti jo Rasulullah ﷺ ne sikhaya hai dua: (Idhhibil-bas Rabban-nasi ishfi wa antash-shafi la shifa'a illa shifa'uka shifa'an la yughadiru saqaman) (Musnad Ahmad). Musnad Ahmad ki aur hadis mein Isa bin Abdulrahman se riwayat hai ke Abdullah bin Hakim bimar padey. Hum un ki ayadat ke liye gaye, un se kaha gaya ke aap koi dora dhaga latka lein to acha ho aap ne farmaya main dora dhaga latkaon? Halankke Rasulullah ﷺ ka farman hai jo shakhs jo cheez latkaye woh usi ke hawale kar diya jata hai. Musnad mein hai jo shakhs koi dora dhaga latkaye us ne shirk kiya. Aik riwayat mein hai jo shakhs aisi koi cheez latkaye, Allah us ka kaam pura na kare aur jo shakhs usay latkaye Allah usay latka hua hi rakhe. Aik Hadis-e-Qudsi mein hai Allah Ta'ala farmata hai main tamam shareekon se zyada beniyaz aur be-parwah hoon jo shakhs apne kisi kaam mein mera koi shareek tehraye main usay aur us ke shareek ko chhod deta hoon. (Muslim). Musnad mein hai Qayamat ke din jab ke awwal akhir sab jama honge, Allah ki taraf se aik munadi nida karega ke jis ne apne amal mein shirk kiya hai, woh us ka sawab apne shareek se talab kar le, Allah Ta'ala tamam shuraka se badh kar shirk se beniyaz hai. Musnad mein hai aap farmate hain mujhe tum par sab se zyada dar chhotey shirk ka hai, logon ne pucha woh kya hai? Farmaya riya-kari, Qayamat ke din logon ko jazay-e-amal di jayegi. Us waqt Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga ke hey riya karo tum jao aur jin ke dikhane sunane ke liye tum ne amal kiye they, unhi se apna ajr talab karo aur dekho ke woh detey hain ya nahi? Musnad mein hai aap farmate hain jo shakhs koi bad-shaguni le kar apne kaam se laut jaye woh mushrik ho gaya. Sahaba R.A ne daryaft kiya Huzoor ﷺ phir is ka kaffara kya hai?

Aap ne farmaya yeh kehna dua (Allahumma la khaira illa khairuka wala taira illa tairaka wala ilaha ghairuk) yaani اے اللہ sab bhalaayiyan sab naik shagoon tere hi haath mein hain, tere siwa koi bhalaaiyon aur naik shagooniyon wala nahi. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari R.A ne apne ek khutba mein farmaya ke logo shirk se bacho woh to cheenti ki chaal se zyada poshida cheez hai, is par Hazrat Abdullah bin Harb aur Hazrat Qais bin Musabib khade ho gaye aur kaha ya toh aap is ki daleel pesh keejiye ya hum jayen aur Hazrat Umar R.A se aap ki shikayat karein. Aap ne farmaya lo daleel lo. Hamein An-Hazrat ﷺ ne ek din khutba sunaya aur farmaya logo! shirk se bacho woh to cheenti ki chaal se bhi zyada poshida hai pas kisi ne aap se poochha ke phir is se bachao kaise ho sakta hai? Farmaya yeh dua padha karo dua (Allahumma inna na'uzu bika an nushrika bika shai'an na'lamuhu wa nastaghfiruka lima la na'lam). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh sawal karne wale Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique R.A the. Aap ne poochha tha ke ya Rasoolallah shirk toh yehi hai ke Allah ke sath doosre ko pukara jaye. Is hadith mein dua ke alfaaz yeh hain ayat (Allahumma inni a'uzu bika an ushrika bika wa ana a'lamu wa astaghfiruka lima la a'lam) (Musnad Abu Ya'la). Abu Dawood waghera mein hai ke Hazrat Siddique Akbar R.A ne An-Hazrat ﷺ se arz kiya ke mujhe koi aisi dua sikhaiye jise main subh sham aur sote waqt padha karoon toh aap ne farmaya yeh dua padh dua (Allahumma fatiras-samawati wal-ardi 'alimal-ghaibi wash-shahadati rabba kulli shai'in wa malikahu, ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta, a'uzu bika min sharri nafsi wa min sharrish-shaitani wa shirkih). Ek riwayat mein hai ke mujhe Huzoor ﷺ ne yeh dua padhni sikhai is ke aakhir mein yeh alfaaz bhi hain dua (wa an uqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an aw ajurrahu ila muslim).

Jaise irshad hai ayat (Afaminallazeena makarus-sayyi'ati an yakhsifal-lahu bihimul-arda aw ya'tiyahumul-'azabu min haisu la yash'uroon) (16. An-Nahl: 45) yaani makariyan aur buraiyan karne wale kya is baat se nidar ho gaye hain ke Allah Ta'ala unhein zameen mein dhensa de ya aisi jagah se azaab la de ke unhein shaoor bhi na ho ya unhein lette baithte hi pakad le ya hoshiyar kar ke thaam le. Allah kisi baat mein aajiz nahi, yeh toh sirf uski rehmat o raafat hai ke gunah karein aur phalein phoolen. Farman-e-Allah hai ke bastiyon ke gunehgar is baat se be-khatre ho gaye hain ke unke paas raton ko unke sote hue hi azaab aa jayen ya din dhaade balke hanste khelte hue azaab aa dhamkein Allah ke makr se be-khauf na hona chahiye aise log sakht nuqsaan uthate hain.
