Kya yeh itna wasi' asman, kya yeh is qadr phaili hui zameen, kya yeh roshan sitare, yeh gardish wala suraj, chand, yeh darakht aur yeh pahad, yeh khetiyan aur sabziyan, yeh talatum barpa karne wale samandar, yeh bazoor chalne wali hawayen, yeh mukhtalif qasam ke rangarang mewey, yeh alag alag ghale aur Qudrat ki beshumar nishaniyan ek aqalmand ko is qadr bhi kaam nahi asaktein? Ke woh un se apne Allah ki jo Ahad hai, Samad hai, Fard hai, Wahid hai, La shareek hai, Qadir-o-Qayyum hai, Baqi aur Kafi hai, us zaat ko pehchan lein aur us ke namon aur sifat ke qayil hojayein? Balki un mein se aksariyat ki zehniyat toh yahan tak bigad chuki hai ke Allah par iman hai phir shirq se dast-bardari nahi. Asman-o-zameen, pahad aur darakht ka, insan aur din ka khaliq Allah mante hain, lekin phir bhi us ke siwa dusron ko us ke sath iska shareek thehrate hain. Yeh mushrikeen hajj ko aate hain, ahram bandh kar labaik pukarte hue kehte hain ke Allah tera koi shareek nahi, jo bhi shareek hain, un ka khud ka malik bhi tu hai aur un ki malkiyat ka malik bhi tu hi hai. Sahih Muslim Sharif mein hai ke jab woh itna kehte hain ke hum hazir hain Ilahi tera koi shareek nahi toh An-Hazrat ﷺ farmate hain bas bas, yaani ab aage kuch na kaho. Fi-l-waqiat shirq zulm-e-azeem hai ke Allah ke sath dusre ki bhi ibadat. Bukhari-o-Muslim mein hai Ibn Mas'ood ؓ ne Risalat-Panah ﷺ se sawal kiya ke sab se bada gunah kya hai? Aap ne jawab diya ke tera Allah ke sath shareek thehrana halanki usi akele ne tujhe paida kiya hai. Isi tarah isi ayat ke taht mein munafiqein bhi dakhil hain. Un ke amal ikhlas wale nahi hote balki woh riyakari hote hain aur riyakari bhi shirq hai. Quran ka farman hai ayat: (Inna-l-munafiqeena yukhadi'oonallaha wa huwa khadi'uhum wa iza qamoo ila-ssalati qamoo kusala yura'oonan-nassa wa la yazkuroon-allaha illa qaleela) (Surah An-Nisa: 142), munafiq Allah ko dhoka dena chahte hain halanki Allah ki taraf se khud dhoke mein hain. Yeh namaz ko bade hi sust ho kar khade hote hain, sirf logon ko dikhana maqsood hota hai, zikrullah toh baraye naam hota hai. Yeh bhi yaad rahe ke ba'az shirq bohot halke aur poshida hote hain, khud karne wale ko bhi pata nahi chalta. Chunache Hazrat Huzaifa ؓ ek bimar ke pas gaye, us ke bazu par ek dhaga bandha hua dekh kar aap ne use tod diya aur yehi ayat padhi ke imandar hote hue bhi mushrik bante ho? Hadith Sharif mein hai Allah ke siwa dusre ke naam ki jis ne qasam khai woh mushrik hogaya. Mulaiza ho Tirmidhi Sharif. Huzoori ﷺ ka farman hai ke jhaar-phoonk, dore-dhage aur jhoote taweez shirq hain. Allah Ta'ala apne bandon ko tawakkal ke ba'is sab sakhtiyon se dur kar deta hai.

(Abu Dawood waghaira) Hazrat Abdullah bin Masood R.A ki biwi sahiba farmati hain ke Hazrat Abdullah ki aadat thi, jab kabhi bahar se aate zor se khankhartey, thoktey ke ghar waley samajh jayein aur aap unhein kisi aisi halat mein na dekh payein ke bura lagey. Aik din usi tarah aap aaye us waqt mere paas aik burhiya thi jo wajah-e-bimari ke mujh par dam jhaar karne ko aayi thi maine aap ki khankhar ki aawaz suntey hi usay charpai taley chupa diya aap aaye mere paas meri charpai par baith gaye aur mere gale mein dhaga dekh kar pucha ke yeh kya hai? Maine kaha is mein dam kara ke maine bandh liya hai. Aap ne usay pakad kar tod diya aur farmaya Abdullah ka ghar shirk se beniyaz hai. Khud maine Rasulullah ﷺ se suna hai ke jhaar phoonk taweezat aur doray dhagay shirk hain. Maine kaha yeh aap kaise farmate hain meri aankh dukh rahi thi, main fulaan yahudi ke paas jaya karti thi, woh dam jhara kar deta tha to sukoon ho jata tha, aap ne farmaya teri aankh mein shaitan choka mara karta tha aur us ki phoonk se woh ruk jata tha tujhe yeh kafi tha ke woh kehti jo Rasulullah ﷺ ne sikhaya hai dua: (Idhhibil-bas Rabban-nasi ishfi wa antash-shafi la shifa'a illa shifa'uka shifa'an la yughadiru saqaman) (Musnad Ahmad). Musnad Ahmad ki aur hadis mein Isa bin Abdulrahman se riwayat hai ke Abdullah bin Hakim bimar padey. Hum un ki ayadat ke liye gaye, un se kaha gaya ke aap koi dora dhaga latka lein to acha ho aap ne farmaya main dora dhaga latkaon? Halankke Rasulullah ﷺ ka farman hai jo shakhs jo cheez latkaye woh usi ke hawale kar diya jata hai. Musnad mein hai jo shakhs koi dora dhaga latkaye us ne shirk kiya. Aik riwayat mein hai jo shakhs aisi koi cheez latkaye, Allah us ka kaam pura na kare aur jo shakhs usay latkaye Allah usay latka hua hi rakhe. Aik Hadis-e-Qudsi mein hai Allah Ta'ala farmata hai main tamam shareekon se zyada beniyaz aur be-parwah hoon jo shakhs apne kisi kaam mein mera koi shareek tehraye main usay aur us ke shareek ko chhod deta hoon. (Muslim). Musnad mein hai Qayamat ke din jab ke awwal akhir sab jama honge, Allah ki taraf se aik munadi nida karega ke jis ne apne amal mein shirk kiya hai, woh us ka sawab apne shareek se talab kar le, Allah Ta'ala tamam shuraka se badh kar shirk se beniyaz hai. Musnad mein hai aap farmate hain mujhe tum par sab se zyada dar chhotey shirk ka hai, logon ne pucha woh kya hai? Farmaya riya-kari, Qayamat ke din logon ko jazay-e-amal di jayegi. Us waqt Allah Ta'ala farmaye ga ke hey riya karo tum jao aur jin ke dikhane sunane ke liye tum ne amal kiye they, unhi se apna ajr talab karo aur dekho ke woh detey hain ya nahi? Musnad mein hai aap farmate hain jo shakhs koi bad-shaguni le kar apne kaam se laut jaye woh mushrik ho gaya. Sahaba R.A ne daryaft kiya Huzoor ﷺ phir is ka kaffara kya hai?

Aap ne farmaya yeh kehna dua (Allahumma la khaira illa khairuka wala taira illa tairaka wala ilaha ghairuk) yaani اے اللہ sab bhalaayiyan sab naik shagoon tere hi haath mein hain, tere siwa koi bhalaaiyon aur naik shagooniyon wala nahi. Musnad Ahmad mein hai ke Hazrat Abu Musa Ash'ari R.A ne apne ek khutba mein farmaya ke logo shirk se bacho woh to cheenti ki chaal se zyada poshida cheez hai, is par Hazrat Abdullah bin Harb aur Hazrat Qais bin Musabib khade ho gaye aur kaha ya toh aap is ki daleel pesh keejiye ya hum jayen aur Hazrat Umar R.A se aap ki shikayat karein. Aap ne farmaya lo daleel lo. Hamein An-Hazrat ﷺ ne ek din khutba sunaya aur farmaya logo! shirk se bacho woh to cheenti ki chaal se bhi zyada poshida hai pas kisi ne aap se poochha ke phir is se bachao kaise ho sakta hai? Farmaya yeh dua padha karo dua (Allahumma inna na'uzu bika an nushrika bika shai'an na'lamuhu wa nastaghfiruka lima la na'lam). Ek aur riwayat mein hai ke yeh sawal karne wale Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique R.A the. Aap ne poochha tha ke ya Rasoolallah shirk toh yehi hai ke Allah ke sath doosre ko pukara jaye. Is hadith mein dua ke alfaaz yeh hain ayat (Allahumma inni a'uzu bika an ushrika bika wa ana a'lamu wa astaghfiruka lima la a'lam) (Musnad Abu Ya'la). Abu Dawood waghera mein hai ke Hazrat Siddique Akbar R.A ne An-Hazrat ﷺ se arz kiya ke mujhe koi aisi dua sikhaiye jise main subh sham aur sote waqt padha karoon toh aap ne farmaya yeh dua padh dua (Allahumma fatiras-samawati wal-ardi 'alimal-ghaibi wash-shahadati rabba kulli shai'in wa malikahu, ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta, a'uzu bika min sharri nafsi wa min sharrish-shaitani wa shirkih). Ek riwayat mein hai ke mujhe Huzoor ﷺ ne yeh dua padhni sikhai is ke aakhir mein yeh alfaaz bhi hain dua (wa an uqtarifa 'ala nafsi su'an aw ajurrahu ila muslim). 

Farman hai ke kya in mushrikeen ko is baat ka khauf nahi hai ke agar Allah ko منظور ho toh charon taraf se azaab-e-Ilahi unhein is tarah aa ghere ke unhein pata bhi na chale. Jaise irshad hai ayat (Afaminallazeena makarus-sayyi'ati an yakhsifal-lahu bihimul-arda aw ya'tiyahumul-'azabu min haisu la yash'uroon) (16. An-Nahl: 45) yaani makariyan aur buraiyan karne wale kya is baat se nidar ho gaye hain ke Allah Ta'ala unhein zameen mein dhensa de ya aisi jagah se azaab la de ke unhein shaoor bhi na ho ya unhein lette baithte hi pakad le ya hoshiyar kar ke thaam le. Allah kisi baat mein aajiz nahi, yeh toh sirf uski rehmat o raafat hai ke gunah karein aur phalein phoolen. Farman-e-Allah hai ke bastiyon ke gunehgar is baat se be-khatre ho gaye hain ke unke paas raton ko unke sote hue hi azaab aa jayen ya din dhaade balke hanste khelte hue azaab aa dhamkein Allah ke makr se be-khauf na hona chahiye aise log sakht nuqsaan uthate hain.

Dawat-e-Wahdaniyat: Allah Ta'ala apne Rasool ﷺ ko, jinhein tamam jino-ins ki taraf bheja hai, hukum deta hai ke logon ko khabar kar do ke mera maslak, mera tariq, meri sunnat yeh hai ke Allah ki wahdaniyat ki dawat aam kar do. Poore yaqein, daleel aur baseerat ke saath. Mein is taraf sab ko bula raha hoon, mere jitne pairu hain, woh bhi isi taraf sab ko bula rahe hain; shar'i, naqli aur aqli daleelon ke saath is taraf dawat dete hain. Hum Allah ki pakeezagi bayan karte hain, uski ta'zeem, taqdees, tasbeeh o tahleel bayan karte hain; usay shareek se, nazeer se, adeel se, wazeer se, musheer se aur har tarah ki kami aur kamzori se paak maante hain. Na uski aulaad maanein, na biwi, na sathi, na hum jins. Woh un tamam buri baaton se paak aur buland o bala hai. Asmaan o zameen aur un ki saari makhlooq uski hamd o tasbeeh kar rahi hai lekin log un ki tasbeeh samajhte nahi, Allah bara hi Haleem aur Ghafoor hai.

Rasool aur Nabi sirf mard hi hue hain bayan farmata hai ke Rasool aur Nabi mard hi bantay rahay nah ke auratein. Jamhoor Ahl-e-Islam ka yahi qaul hai ke nabuwat auraton ko kabhi nahi mili. Is ayat-e-karimah ka siyaq bhi isi par dalalat karta hai. Lekin baaz ka qaul hai ke Khalilullah Alaihis Salam ki biwi Hazrat Sarah, Musa Alaihis Salam ki walidah, Maryam bhi nabiyah thein. Malaika ne Hazrat Sarah ko un ke larkay Ishaq aur poutay Yaqub ki basharat di. Musa ki maan ki taraf unhein doodh pilanay ki wahi huwi. Maryam ko Hazrat Isa ki basharat farishtay ne di. Farishton ne Maryam se kaha ke Allah ne tujhe pasandeeda, pak aur bargazeeda karliya hai tamam jahan ki auraton par. Aye Maryam apnay Rab ki farmaan-bardari karti raho, is ke liye sajday kar aur ruku karnay walon ke sath ruku kar. Is ka jawab yeh hai ke itna toh hum mantay hain, jitna Quran ne bayan farmaya. Lekin is se un ki nabuwat sabit nahi hoti. Sirf itna farman ya itni basharat ya itnay hukm kisi ki nabuwat ke liye daleel nahi. Ahl-e-Sunnat wal-Jamaat ka aur sab ka mazhab yeh hai ke auraton mein se koi nabuwat wali nahi. Haan un mein Siddiqaat hain jaisa ke sab se ashraf-o-afzal aurat Hazrat Maryam ki nisbat Quran ne farmaya hai ayat (Wa ummuhu Siddiqah). Pas agar woh Nabi hotien toh is maqam mein wahi martaba bayan kiya jata. Ayat mein:

وَمَآ اَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ الْمُرْسَلِيْنَ اِلَّآ اِنَّهُمْ لَيَاْكُلُوْنَ الطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُوْنَ فِي الْاَسْوَاقِ ۭ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً ۭ اَتَصْبِرُوْنَ ۚ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيْرًا 20؀ (25۔ الفرقان :20)

Yaani tujh se pehlay jitnay Rasool hum ne bheje woh sab khana bhi khatay thay aur bazaron mein aamad-o-raft bhi rakhtay thay. Woh aisay nah thay ke khana khanay se pak hon, nah aisay thay ke kabhi marnay walay hi nah hon, hum ne un se apnay waaday pooray kiye, unhein aur un ke sath jinhein hum ne chaha, najat di aur musrif logon ko halak kardiya. Isi tarah aur ayat mein hai:

قُلْ مَا كُنْتُ بِدْعًا مِّنَ الرُّسُلِ وَمَآ اَدْرِيْ مَا يُفْعَلُ بِيْ وَلَا بِكُمْ ۭ اِنْ اَتَّبِــعُ اِلَّا مَا يُوْحٰٓى اِلَيَّ وَمَآ اَنَا اِلَّا نَذِيْرٌ مُّبِيْنٌ (46۔ الأحقاف :9)

Yaani main koi pehla Rasool toh nahi? Al-Kh. Yaad rahay ke ahl-e-qura se murad ahl-e-shehar hain nah ke badiyah nasheen woh toh baray kaj-tab aur bad-akhlaq hotay hain. Mashhoor-o-maroof hai ke shehri narm-tab aur khush-khulq hotay hain isi tarah bastiyon se door walay, paray kinaray rehnay walay bhi umuman aisay hi terhay tirchay hotay hain. Quran farmata hai:

اَلْاَعْرَابُ اَشَدُّ كُفْرًا وَّنِفَاقًا وَّاَجْدَرُ اَلَّا يَعْلَمُوْا حُدُوْدَ مَآ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي رَسُوْلِهٖ ۭوَاللّٰهُ عَلِيْمٌ حَكِيْمٌ (9۔ التوبہ :97)

Junglon ke rehnay walay baddu kufr-o-nifaq mein bohat sakht hain. Qatadah bhi yahi matlab bayan farmatay hain kyunke shehriyon mein ilm-o-hilm ziyada hota hai.

Aik hadith mein hai ke badia-nasheen a'rab mein se kisi ne An-Hazrat ﷺ ki khidmat mein hadiya pesh kiya, Aap ﷺ ne use badla diya lekin use us ne bahut kam samjha, Aap ﷺ ne aur diya aur diya yahan tak ke use khush kar diya. Phir farmaya mera to jee chahta hai ke siwaye Quraish aur Ansari aur Saqafi aur Dosi logon ke auron ka tuhfa qubool hi na karoon. 

Aik hadith mein Huzoor ﷺ ka farman hai ke woh momin jo logon se milay julae aur un ki aizaon par sabr kare, woh us se behtar hai jo na un se milay julae ho na un ki aizaon par sabr kare. 

Yeh jhutlane wale kya mulk mein chalte phirte nahin? Ke apne se pehle ke jhutlane walon ki halaton ko dekhein aur un ke anjam par ghor karein? Jaise farman hai ayat: 
(Afalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fatakoona lahum quloobun ya'qiloona biha aw azanun yasma'oona biha fa-innaha la ta'mal-absaru wa lakin ta'mal-quloobul-lati fis-sudoor) (22. Al-Hajj: 46) 
Yaani kya unhon ne zameen ki sair nahin ki ke un ke dil samajhdar hote, al-akhirat. Un ke kaan sun lete, un ki aankhein dekh litin ke un jaise gunahgaron ka kya hashr hota raha hai? Woh najat se mehroom rehte hain, azab-e-Ilahi unhein gharat kar deta hai, alam-e-akhirat un ke liye bahut hi behtar hai jo ehtiyat se zindagi guzar dete hain. Yahan bhi najat pate hain aur wahan bhi aur wahan ki najat yahan ki najat se bahut hi behtar hai. 

Wada-e-Ilahi hai ayat: 
(Inna lanan-suru rusulana wal-lazina amanoo fil-hayatid-dunya wa yawma yaqumul-ashhad) (40. Ghafir: 51) 
Hum apne rasoolon ki aur un par iman lane walon ki is dunya mein bhi madad farmate hain aur qayamat ke din bhi un ki imdad karenge, us din gawah khade honge, zalimon ke uzr be-sood rahenge, un par lanat barsegi aur un ke liye bura ghar hoga. 

Ghar ki izafat akhirat ki taraf ki. Jaise salat-ul-ula aur masjid-e-jami' aur aam-e-awwal aur barhat-ul-ula aur yawm-ul-khamis mein aisi hi izafat hai, arbi sheron mein bhi yeh izafat bakasrat aayi hai.

Jab mukhalifat urooj par ho Allah Ta'ala ka irshad hai ke uski madad uske rasoolon par bar-waqt utarti hai. Duniya ke jhatke jab zoron par hote hain, mukhalifat jab tan jati hai, ikhtilaf jab barh jata hai, dushmani jab poori hojati hai, Anbiya-e-Allah ko jab chaaron taraf se gher liya jata hai, ma'an Allah ki madad aa-pahunchti hai. 

Kuz-zibu aur Kazibu dono qiraaten hain, Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ki qiraat zaal ki tashdeed ke sath hai, chunacha Bukhari Sharif mein hai ke Hazrat Urwah bin Zubair (R.A) ne Hazrat Aisha (R.A) se poocha ke yeh lafaz kuz-zibu hai ya kazibu? Hazrat Aisha (R.A) ne farmaya kuz-zibu hai. Unhon ne kaha phir to yeh maana hue ke rasoolon ne guman kiya ke woh jhutlaye gaye to yeh guman ki kaun si baat thi yeh to yaqeeni baat thi ke woh jhutlaye jate the. Aap ne farmaya beshak yeh yaqeeni baat thi ke woh kuffar ki taraf se jhutlaye jate the lekin woh waqt bhi aaye ke iman dar ummati bhi aise zalzale mein dale gaye aur is tarah unki madad mein takheer hui ke rasoolon ke dil mein aayi ke ghaliban ab to hamari jama'at bhi hamein jhutlane lagi hogi. Ab madad-e-Rabb aayi aur unhein ghalib kiya gaya. Tum itna to khayal karo ke kuz-zibu kaise theek ho sakta hai? Ma'az Allah kya Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) Allah ki nisbat yeh bad-gumani kar sakte hain ke unhein Rabb ki taraf se jhutlaya gaya? 

Ibn Abbas ki qiraat mein kazibu hai. Aap iski daleel mein aayat (Hatta yaqool-ar-rasoolu wal-lazeena amano ma'ahu mata nasr-ullah, ala inna nasra-llahi qareeb) (Surah Al-Baqarah: 214) parh dete the ya'ani yahan tak ke anbiya aur imandar kehne lage ke Allah ki madad kahan hai? Yaad rakho madad-e-Rabb bilkul qareeb hai. 

Hazrat Aisha (R.A) iska sakhti se inkar karti thin aur farmaya karti thin ke Janab Rasoolullah An-Hazrat Muhammad Mustafa (ﷺ) se Allah Ta'ala ne jitne wade kiye, Aap ko kamil yaqeen tha ke woh sab yaqeeni aur hatmi hain aur sab poore ho kar hi rahenge aakhir dam tak kabhi na'uzubillah Aap ke dil mein yeh wahm hi paida nahi hua ke koi wada-e-Rabbani ghalat sabit hoga ya mumkin hai ke ghalat ho jaye ya poora na ho. Haan Anbiya (Alaihimas Salam) par barabar balayen aur aazmayishen aati rahin, yahan tak ke unke dil mein yeh khatra paida hone laga ke kahin mere manne wale bhi mujh se bad-guman ho kar mujhe jhutla na rahe hon. 

Ek shakhs Qasim bin Muhammad ke paas aa kar kehta hai ke Muhammad bin Ka'ab Qurzi kazibu parhte hain to aap ne farmaya ke unse keh do: Main ne Rasoolullah (ﷺ) ki zawja Siddiqa Aisha (R.A) se suna hai woh kuz-zibu parhti thin ya'ani unke manne walon ne unhein jhutlaya. 

Pas ek qiraat to tashdeed ke sath hai doosri takhfeef ke sath hai, phir iski tafseer mein Ibn Abbas (R.A) se to woh marwi hai jo upar guzar chuka. Ibn Mas'ood (R.A) se marwi hai ke Aap ne yeh aayat isi tarah parh kar farmaya yahi woh hai jo tu bura janta hai.

Yeh riwayat us riwayat ke khilaf hai, jise un dono buzurgon se auron ne riwayat kiya hai, is mein hai ke Ibn Abbas R.A ne farmaya jab Rasool na-umeed ho gaye ke un ki kaum un ki manegi aur kaum ne yeh samajh liya ke nabiyon ne un se jhoot kaha, usi waqt Allah ki madad aa pahunchi aur jise Allah ne chaha najat bakhshi. Isi tarah ki tafsir auron se bhi marwi hai. Ek naujawan Qurayshi ne Hazrat Saeed bin Jubair R.H se kaha ke Hazrat humein bataiye, is lafz ko kya padhein, mujh se to is lafz ki qirat ki wajah se mumkin hai ke is surat ka padhna hi chhoot jaye. Aap ne farmaya suno is ka matlab yeh ke ambiya is se mayoos ho gaye ke un ki kaum un ki baat manegi aur kaum wale samajh baithe ke nabiyon ne ghalat kaha hai yeh sun kar Hazrat Dahhak bin Muzahim bahut hi khush hue aur farmaya ke is jaisa jawab kisi zi-ilm ka main ne nahi suna agar main yahan se Yemen pahunch kar bhi aise jawab ko sunta to main ise bhi bahut aasan janta. Muslim bin Yasar R.H ne bhi aap ka yeh jawab sun kar uth kar aap se muanaqa kiya aur kaha Allah Ta'ala aap ki pareshaniyon ko bhi usi tarah door kar de, jis tarah aap ne hamari pareshani door farmai. Bahut se aur mafassir ne bhi yahi matlab bayan kiya hai balke Mujahid R.H ki to qirat zal ke zabar se hai yani kazzabu haan ba'

Ibrat-o-naseehat nabiyon ke waqiat, musalmanon ki najat, kafiron ki halakat ke qisse, aqalmandoon ke liye bari ibrat-o-naseehat wale hain. Yeh Quran banawati nahi balki agli asmani kitabon ki sachai ki daleel hai. In mein jo haqiqi baatein Allah ki hain un ki tasdeeq karta hai. Aur jo tehreef-o-tabdeeli hui hai use chhant deta hai un ki jo baatein baqi rakhne ki hain unhein baqi rakhta hai. Aur jo ahkam mansookh ho gaye unhein bayaan karta hai. Har ek halal-o-haram, mahboob-o-makrooh ko khol khol kar bayaan karta hai. Ta'at-e-wajibat, mustahabbat, muharramat, makroohaat waghera ko bayaan farmata hai ijmali aur tafsili khabrein deta hai. Allah Ta'ala Jalla 'Ala ki sifaat bayaan farmata hai aur bandon ne jo galtiyan apne khaliq ke bare mein ki hain un ki islah karta hai. Makhlooq ko is se rokta hai ki woh Allah ki koi sifat is ki makhlooq mein sabit karein. Pas yeh Quran momino ke liye hidayat-o-rahmat hai, un ke dil zalalat se hidayat aur jhoot se sach aur burai se bhalai ki rah pate hain aur Rabb-ul-Ibaad se duniya aur aakhirat ki bhalai hasil kar lete hain. Hamari bhi dua hai ki Allah Ta'ala hamein bhi duniya aakhirat mein aise hi momino ka sath de aur qayamat ke din jab ki bahut se chehre safed honge aur bahut se munh kale ho jayenge, hamein momino ke sath noorani chehron mein shamil rakhe Ameen. Alhamdulillah Surah Yusuf ki tafseer khatam ho gayi. Allah ka shukkar hai wahi tareefon ke laaiq hai aur usi se hum madad chahte hain.
